zh.tag: 让 AI 代理逆向分析二进制、应用与运行时行为的 MCP 工具集
zh.what: REA 是一个面向逆向工程的 MCP 服务，把 AI 代理接入分析原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集和网站的工具链。它能在没有源码的情况下剖析某个功能如何实现、给出证据与局限，并帮你在自己的项目里复刻。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现，包含 MCP 工具目录（docs/product-catalog.json）、多语言 README、官网与指南文档、Showcase 案例，以及可 npx 运行的 rea-agents 包。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 22.19+ 与 TypeScript，以 MCP 协议对接各类代理，通过 npm 包 rea-agents 分发，分析在本地执行。
zh.hot: 上线即登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜第 1，单日新增 4655 star、总数 17415，说明「让代理自动逆向」这一痛点切中了大量开发者。
uses: 想复刻竞品功能但拿不到源码的产品与前端工程师
需要分析二进制、Electron 或 .NET 程序的安全研究人员
希望给自家 AI 代理接入逆向能力的工具链开发者
想快速理解某网站或应用实现原理的技术学习者

en.tag: One MCP that lets agents reverse engineer binaries, apps, and runtime behavior
en.what: REA is an MCP server that connects AI agents to tooling for reverse engineering native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. It inspects features without source code, explains how they work with supporting evidence and stated limitations, and helps you rebuild them in your own project.
en.content: Written in TypeScript, the repo ships an MCP tool catalog (docs/product-catalog.json), multilingual READMEs, website and guide docs, showcase examples, and an npx-runnable rea-agents package.
en.stack: Built on Node.js 22.19+ and TypeScript, it speaks the MCP protocol to agent clients, is distributed as the npm package rea-agents, and runs analysis locally.
en.hot: It hit #1 on GitHub Trending with 4,655 stars added in a single day and 17,415 total, showing that agent-driven reverse engineering strikes a nerve with developers.
uses: Product and frontend engineers who want to clone a competitor feature without source access
Security researchers analyzing binaries, Electron apps, or .NET assemblies
Toolchain developers adding reverse-engineering skills to their own agents
Technical learners who want to understand how a site or app is implemented

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的语音工具集，提供类似 ElevenLabs 的功能，包括声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，所有处理都在用户自己的硬件上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码、文档、安装指南、架构说明和 API 文档，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Docker。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种开源 TTS/ASR 引擎（如 Coqui、Whisper 等），支持跨平台桌面环境与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，VoiceStudio 在隐私和成本敏感的用户中迅速走红，单日新增 1672 星，总星数达 16279，反映出对自主语音处理工具的高需求。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频配音或制作多语言音频，但不想依赖云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望语音数据完全留在本地，避免上传到第三方。
开发者：需要集成语音克隆或转录功能的 API，且要求离线运行。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行听力练习或生成自定义语音内容。

en.tag: Fully-local voice studio: clone, dub, transcribe & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice toolkit offering ElevenLabs-like features: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. No account, API key, or subscription required—everything runs on your own hardware.
en.content: The repository includes full application code, docs, installation guides, architecture, and API docs, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, offering both GUI and CLI tools.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging various open-source TTS/ASR engines (e.g., Coqui, Whisper), with cross-platform desktop support and Docker deployment.
en.hot: As a local-first ElevenLabs alternative, VoiceStudio is gaining rapid traction among privacy- and cost-conscious users, adding 1,672 stars in a day to reach 16,279 total, reflecting high demand for self-hosted voice tools.
uses: Content creators needing video dubbing or multilingual audio without cloud dependency.
Privacy-conscious users who want voice data to stay entirely on-device.
Developers seeking offline APIs for voice cloning or transcription integration.
Language learners leveraging 646-language support for listening practice or custom audio.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理压缩上下文窗口、沙箱化工具输出并持久化会话记忆
zh.what: Context Mode 是面向 AI 编码代理的上下文优化层，把工具输出放进沙箱处理，官方称可减少约 98% 的上下文占用。它同时持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP 与 hooks 在 17 个平台上统一路由，让代理在长任务中不丢状态、不爆窗口。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现，核心是 MCP 服务与 hooks 集成，附带 npm 包、插件市场入口、统计脚本与 Discord 社区链接。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，依赖 MCP 协议与各代理平台的 hooks 机制，通过 npm 分发，采用 ELv2 许可。
zh.hot: 月增 4034 star、总量 24069，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 月榜第 14，并在 Hacker News 拿到 570+ 分的第一名，上下文成本是当下代理开发最痛的议题。
uses: 重度使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等编码代理、常被上下文窗口限制的开发者
需要跨多个平台统一管理代理会话与记忆的团队
希望降低工具输出 token 成本、控制 API 账单的工程团队
为代理工具链做集成、想接入 MCP 生态的插件作者

en.tag: Context window optimization for AI coding agents: sandbox tool output, persist memory, route across platforms
en.what: Context Mode is a context-optimization layer for AI coding agents that sandboxes tool output, claiming roughly a 98% reduction in context usage. It also persists session memory and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, so agents keep state without blowing the window.
en.content: The repo is TypeScript-based, centered on an MCP server plus hook integrations, with an npm package, marketplace entry, stats script, and Discord community links.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the MCP protocol and platform hook systems, distributed via npm under the ELv2 license.
en.hot: With 24,069 stars and 4,034 added this month, it ranks 14th on GitHub Trending's TypeScript monthly list and hit #1 on Hacker News with 570+ points — context cost is the sharpest pain in agent development right now.
uses: Developers who lean on Claude Code, Cursor, and similar agents and keep hitting context limits
Teams needing unified session memory and routing across multiple agent platforms
Engineering teams trying to cut tool-output token costs and API bills
Toolchain integrators and plugin authors building on the MCP ecosystem

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的编辑级图表设计技能，42 种图表类型
zh.what: 这是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Factory Droid、Pi 等编码代理的图表设计技能包。它让代理直接产出编辑级质量的图表，而不是千篇一律的圆角方块和 Mermaid 风格图。输出为自包含的 HTML + SVG，无阴影、无构建步骤。
zh.content: 仓库包含 42 种图表类型的技能定义与模板，覆盖架构图、流程图、飞轮、Sankey、鱼骨图、Wardley 地图、看板、用户旅程、UML 类图、数据库 schema 等。每种类型提供 minimal light、minimal dark、full-editorial 三种静态变体，并附带截图与项目站点。
zh.stack: 以 HTML 和 SVG 为核心，输出完全自包含、无需 JavaScript 或外部图片依赖。技能可运行在支持 Agent Skills 的宿主中，并能重绘 draw.io、Mermaid、Excalidraw 源文件。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5 名，今日新增 825 star，总 star 达 45298。它精准击中开发者「让 AI 画图但结果很丑」的痛点，用编辑级审美替代 Mermaid 的廉价感。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理写文档、博客或技术方案的开发者
需要快速产出品牌一致架构图、流程图但不想打开 Figma 的工程师
希望把 draw.io、Mermaid、Excalidraw 旧图重绘成高质量版本的团队
对图表审美有要求、追求极简编辑风格的内容创作者

en.tag: Editorial-grade diagram design skill for coding agents, 42 diagram types
en.what: A diagram design skill for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. It makes agents output editorial-quality diagrams instead of generic rounded boxes or Mermaid slop, delivered as self-contained HTML + SVG with no shadows and no build step.
en.content: The repo ships skill definitions and templates for 42 diagram types, covering architecture, flowcharts, flywheels, Sankey, fishbone, Wardley maps, kanban, user journeys, UML class diagrams, and database schemas. Each type comes in three static variants — minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial — plus screenshots and a project site.
en.stack: Built on HTML and SVG, with fully self-contained output requiring no JavaScript or external image dependencies. The skill runs in Agent Skills-compatible hosts and can redraw draw.io, Mermaid, or Excalidraw sources.
en.hot: It hit #5 on GitHub Trending daily with 825 new stars today and 45,298 total. It nails the pain point of AI-generated diagrams looking ugly, replacing Mermaid cheapness with editorial-grade aesthetics.
uses: Developers using Claude Code, Codex, or similar agents for docs, blogs, or tech proposals
Engineers needing brand-consistent architecture or flow diagrams without opening Figma
Teams wanting to redraw old draw.io, Mermaid, or Excalidraw diagrams at higher quality
Content creators who care about editorial, minimalist diagram aesthetics

zh.tag: 开放 Agent 技能生态的 npx 命令行工具
zh.what: skills 是一个用于开放 Agent 技能生态的命令行工具，通过 npx 即可安装、使用和分发技能。它支持 OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 80 余种编码 Agent，让技能在它们之间通用。
zh.content: 仓库提供 npm 包 skills 的 CLI 源码，核心命令包括 skills add 和 skills use，并附带技能来源解析、私有仓库认证等逻辑。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，以 npm 包形式发布，依赖 Node.js 运行，支持 GitHub、GitLab、Azure Repos 及任意 git URL 作为技能来源。
zh.hot: 作为 Vercel Labs 出品的开放技能标准工具，它切中多 Agent 技能碎片化痛点，已获 34510 星，今日新增 190 星并登上日榜第 6。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等编码 Agent 的开发者，想统一管理和复用技能
希望把团队内部技能以私有仓库形式分发给多个 Agent 的工程团队
想快速试用某个技能而不安装、直接生成提示词注入 Agent 的用户

en.tag: The npx CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem
en.what: skills is a CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem, letting you install, use, and distribute skills via npx. It supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 75+ other coding agents, making skills portable across them.
en.content: The repo contains the TypeScript source of the skills npm CLI, with core commands like skills add and skills use, plus source resolution and private-repo auth logic.
en.stack: Built in TypeScript and published as an npm package running on Node.js, it supports GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, and any git URL as skill sources.
en.hot: As an open skill-standard tool from Vercel Labs, it tackles fragmented skills across agents, reaching 34,510 stars with 190 added today and ranking #6 on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers using coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex who want to manage and reuse skills uniformly
Engineering teams distributing internal skills from private repos to multiple agents
Users who want to try a skill without installing it by generating a prompt for their agent

zh.tag: 单张4GB显卡跑70B大模型的低显存推理方案
zh.what: AirLLM 通过分层流式加载权重，把大模型推理的显存占用压到极低，让 70B 模型在单张 4GB 显卡上运行，无需量化、蒸馏或剪枝。它还能在 4GB 以下跑 Kimi K3（2.8T）、6GB 跑 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（125B）、约 12GB 跑 DeepSeek-V3（671B），并新增了小显存训练支持。
zh.content: 仓库以 Jupyter Notebook 为主，包含快速上手示例、配置说明、MacOS 支持、示例 notebook 和 FAQ，核心是 airllm Python 包（可从 PyPI 安装）。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch/transformers 生态，依赖 Hugging Face 模型权重与 safetensors 分层加载，部分新模型需特定 transformers 构建。
zh.hot: 它直击大模型显存门槛这一痛点，让消费级显卡也能跑 70B 甚至更大模型，已积累 36508 颗星，今日新增 548 星并登上日榜第 7。
uses: 只有 4GB~12GB 显存消费级显卡、想本地跑大模型的个人开发者
需要在低显存设备上做 LLM 推理验证或原型实验的研究者
想低成本体验 Kimi K3、DeepSeek-V3 等超大开源模型的爱好者
希望在有限 VRAM 下微调 125B 级模型的小团队

en.tag: Run 70B LLMs on a single 4GB GPU without quantization
en.what: AirLLM dramatically reduces inference memory by streaming model weights layer by layer, letting a 70B LLM run on a single 4GB GPU without quantization, distillation, or pruning. It also runs Kimi K3 (2.8T) under 4GB, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B) on 6GB, and DeepSeek-V3 (671B) on ~12GB, and now supports training huge models on small VRAM.
en.content: The repo is mostly Jupyter Notebooks, with quickstart, configuration docs, MacOS notes, example notebooks, and an FAQ, centered on the airllm Python package installable from PyPI.
en.stack: Built on Python with PyTorch/transformers, relying on Hugging Face weights and layered safetensors loading; some new models need a specific transformers build.
en.hot: It tackles the GPU-memory barrier head-on, letting consumer cards run 70B+ models, and has reached 36,508 stars with 548 added today, ranking 7th on the daily trending list.
uses: Individual developers with only 4GB-12GB consumer GPUs who want to run LLMs locally
Researchers validating or prototyping LLM inference on low-VRAM devices
Enthusiasts wanting to try huge open models like Kimi K3 or DeepSeek-V3 cheaply
Small teams aiming to fine-tune 125B-class models under limited VRAM

zh.tag: 面向艺术家与影视创作者的交互式 AI 图像视频创作 IDE
zh.what: ArtCraft 是一款面向艺术家、设计师和影视创作者的 AI 创作引擎，被定位为「艺术家的 IDE」。它把提示词生成升级为可视化「手工创作」，让用户在 2D 中构图、在 3D 中搭建场景，并自由选择适合的生成模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ArtCraft 桌面应用的源码与开发文档，README 展示了 Image to Location、3D/2D 图像合成等核心功能演示，并提供下载、发布版本与从源码构建的入口。
zh.stack: 项目以 Rust 为主语言，构建桌面端创作工具，并集成多种第三方 AI 图像与视频生成模型。
zh.hot: 上线不久即收获 5355 颗星，今日新增 1465 星，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 第 2 名，说明「AI 生成 + 可视化创作工具」正切中创作者对可控性的强烈需求。
uses: 数字艺术家与插画师：用 2D/3D 合成精确控制构图与角色一致性
影视与动画创作者：在同一场景中规划多镜头、复用环境与虚拟演员
AI 绘画爱好者：把提示词工作流升级为可重复、可微调的可视化创作
Rust 与桌面应用开发者：研究高性能 AI 创作工具的实现方式

en.tag: An interactive AI image and video creation IDE for artists and filmmakers
en.what: ArtCraft is an AI creation engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers, positioned as "the IDE for artists." It turns prompting into crafting by letting users compose in 2D, stage scenes in 3D, and pick the models that fit their work.
en.content: The repo holds the source and dev docs for the ArtCraft desktop app, with README demos of features like Image to Location and 3D/2D image compositing, plus links to downloads, releases, and building from source.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it builds a desktop creation tool that integrates multiple third-party AI image and video generation models.
en.hot: It has already gathered 5,355 stars with 1,465 added today, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list, showing strong demand for controllable AI creation tools.
uses: Digital artists and illustrators: precisely control composition and character consistency with 2D/3D compositing
Film and animation creators: plan multiple shots in one consistent environment with virtual actors
AI art enthusiasts: upgrade prompt workflows into repeatable, fine-tunable visual crafting
Rust and desktop app developers: study how a high-performance AI creation tool is built

zh.tag: 跨平台 Xcode 替代，用 SwiftPM 在 Linux/Windows/macOS 构建部署 iOS 应用
zh.what: xtool 是一个跨平台的 Xcode 替代工具，允许开发者在 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 上使用 SwiftPM 构建、签名和安装 iOS 应用。它通过开放标准复现 Xcode 功能，并支持以编程方式与 Apple 开发者服务交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含 xtool 命令行工具（支持 setup、auth、sdk、new、dev、ds、devices、install 等子命令）以及可复用的 XKit 库，用于与 Apple 开发者服务和 iOS 设备交互。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift 语言开发，基于 SwiftPM 构建系统，依赖 Apple 开发者服务和 Darwin Swift SDK。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 1198 颗星，总星数达 9378，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 9 名，因其解决了在非 macOS 平台开发 iOS 应用的痛点而备受关注。
uses: 使用 Linux 或 Windows 进行 iOS 开发的开发者 —— 无需 Mac 即可构建和部署应用
希望用 SwiftPM 管理 iOS 项目的团队 —— 实现跨平台统一构建流程
需要自动化与 Apple 开发者服务交互的 CI/CD 场景 —— 通过 XKit 库编程控制

en.tag: Cross-platform Xcode replacement: build and deploy iOS apps with SwiftPM on Linux, Windows, and macOS
en.what: xtool is a cross-platform Xcode replacement that lets developers build, sign, and install iOS apps using SwiftPM on Linux, Windows, and macOS. It replicates Xcode functionality with open standards and supports programmatic interaction with Apple Developer Services.
en.content: The repository includes the xtool command-line tool (with subcommands like setup, auth, sdk, new, dev, ds, devices, install) and the reusable XKit library for interacting with Apple Developer Services and iOS devices.
en.stack: Primarily written in Swift, built on SwiftPM, and depends on Apple Developer Services and the Darwin Swift SDK.
en.hot: It gained 1,198 stars today, reaching 9,378 total, and ranked #9 on GitHub Trending daily, attracting attention for solving the pain point of iOS development on non-macOS platforms.
uses: Developers using Linux or Windows for iOS development — build and deploy apps without a Mac
Teams wanting to manage iOS projects with SwiftPM — unify build processes across platforms
CI/CD scenarios needing automated interaction with Apple Developer Services — programmatic control via XKit

zh.tag: 聚合61家免费模型与11款编码代理的统一网关
zh.what: 这是一个把 Claude Code、Codex、Cline、Aider 等 11 款编码代理与 61 家合规模型提供方打通的统一网关，宣称每月可提供 13 亿以上免费 token。它让用户在终端、IDE、手机或浏览器中自由切换多代理与多模型，并在某个提供方故障时自动切换下一个模型继续当前回合。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式发布，包含提供方接入层、模型目录、客户端适配器（CLI/IDE/浏览器会话）以及 RTK、Headroom 等可选优化集成，并配有 Pytest 测试与 CI 工作流。

zh.hot: 上线即获 58,085 星、日增 506 星并冲上 Python 日榜第 2，靠的是“免费额度 + 多代理多模型 + 自动故障转移”这一刚需组合，直击开发者对 AI 编码成本与可用性的痛点。
uses: 想低成本使用 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理的个人开发者
需要在多个模型提供方之间做容灾切换的团队
希望在 IDE、终端或手机浏览器统一管理 AI 编码会话的用户
关注 token 消耗优化、想压缩工具调用开销的重度使用者

en.tag: A unified gateway aggregating 61 free providers and 11 coding agents
en.what: A unified gateway that connects 11 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Aider, etc.) with 61 ToS-friendly model providers, claiming 1.3B+ free tokens per month. It lets users switch freely among multi-harness and multi-model setups from terminal, IDE, phone, or browser, and auto-fails over to the next configured model mid-turn when a provider goes down.
en.content: Shipped as a Python package, it contains a provider integration layer, a model catalog, client adapters (CLI/IDE/browser sessions), plus optional optimization integrations like RTK and Headroom, with Pytest tests and CI workflows.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.14 with uv for dependency management, Pytest for testing, Ty for type checking, Ruff for formatting, and Loguru for logging, under AGPL v3.
en.hot: It hit 58,085 stars with 506 added today, ranking #2 on the Python daily trending list, driven by the must-have combo of free quota, multi-agent/multi-model support, and automatic failover that targets developers' cost and reliability pain points.
uses: Individual developers wanting to use coding agents like Claude Code and Codex at low cost
Teams needing failover across multiple model providers
Users who want unified AI coding sessions across IDE, terminal, or mobile browser
Heavy users focused on token-usage optimization and compressing tool-call overhead

zh.tag: 输入主题或关键词，一键自动生成高清短视频的 AI 工作流工具
zh.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一站式 AI 短视频生成工具，只需提供视频主题或关键词，就能自动完成视频脚本撰写、素材匹配、字幕与背景音乐生成，并合成高清短视频。它把文案、配音、素材检索和剪辑串成一条自动化流水线，大幅降低短视频制作门槛。
zh.content: 仓库提供 WebUI 与 API 两种使用形态，附带界面预览截图、多语言 README（中/英/日）以及版本发布与问题反馈入口，核心为 Python 编写的自动化视频生成流程。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python（3.11+），支持 Windows/macOS/Linux，依赖 AI 大模型（如 Kimi K3）进行文案与关键词生成，并整合素材检索、TTS 配音与视频合成组件。
zh.hot: 已收获 13 万+ star，今日新增 341，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 Python 第 3 名；低门槛的“关键词出片”能力加上短视频创作刚需，使其持续吸引大量关注。
uses: 自媒体与短视频创作者，快速批量产出内容初稿
营销与电商运营人员，低成本制作产品推广视频
想学习 AI 工作流编排的 Python 开发者
需要 API 集成视频生成能力的应用开发者

en.tag: One-click AI workflow that turns a topic or keyword into an HD short video
en.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an all-in-one AI short-video generator: give it a topic or keyword and it automatically writes the script, matches footage, generates subtitles and background music, then renders an HD short video. It chains copywriting, voiceover, asset search and editing into one automated pipeline, greatly lowering the barrier to short-video production.
en.content: The repo ships both a WebUI and an API, with interface preview screenshots, multilingual READMEs (Chinese/English/Japanese), release and issue channels, and a Python-based automated video generation pipeline at its core.
en.stack: Primarily Python (3.11+), running on Windows/macOS/Linux, it relies on LLMs (e.g. Kimi K3) for script and keyword generation and integrates asset search, TTS voiceover and video compositing components.
en.hot: With 130k+ stars and 341 added today, it ranks 3rd on GitHub Trending (Python) daily; its low-barrier 'keyword-to-video' capability plus strong demand for short-video creation keeps drawing attention.
uses: Self-media and short-video creators who need to batch-produce draft content fast
Marketers and e-commerce operators making promo videos at low cost
Python developers wanting to learn AI workflow orchestration
App developers needing to integrate video generation via API

zh.tag: 把文档或主题一键转成原生可编辑 PPTX 的 AI 工具
zh.what: PPT Master 用 AI 把 PDF、DOCX、网页等文档或一个主题，自动提炼要点、组织叙事，生成真正的原生 PowerPoint 文件。生成结果不是图片或网页截图，而是可在 PowerPoint 里继续编辑的形状、转场、动画、图表和表格。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 实现，包含文档解析、内容规划、PPTX 生成与模板适配等模块，并提供中英文 README、版本与许可证徽章、赞助商说明及演示资源。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，围绕 python-pptx 等库生成原生 PPTX，并接入大模型 API（如 Kimi K3）做文档理解与内容编排。
zh.hot: 58745 颗星、今日新增 372，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Python 第 8 名；它切中「做 PPT 太耗时」的普遍痛点，且输出原生可编辑文件而非图片，实用性远超同类。
uses: 职场人士与学生：把报告、论文或资料快速变成可继续修改的演示文稿
咨询、销售与市场团队：根据文档或主题批量生成提案和汇报 PPT
需要品牌统一风格的用户：套用自有 .pptx 模板并自动生成图表、表格与配音
开发者与 AI 爱好者：研究文档理解、内容规划到 PPTX 生成的全链路实现

en.tag: AI that turns documents or topics into native, editable PowerPoint decks
en.what: PPT Master uses AI to read documents such as PDFs, DOCX files and web pages—or just a topic—and turn them into real, native PowerPoint decks. The output is not images or screenshots but editable shapes, transitions, animations, charts and tables you can keep refining in PowerPoint.
en.content: The repo is a Python project with modules for document parsing, content planning, PPTX generation and template adaptation, plus bilingual READMEs, version/license badges, sponsor notes and demo assets.
en.stack: Written in Python, it builds native PPTX via libraries like python-pptx and calls LLM APIs (e.g. Kimi K3) for document understanding and content structuring.
en.hot: With 58,745 stars and 372 added today, it ranks 8th on GitHub Trending's Python daily list. It hits the universal pain of time-consuming slide-making and outputs native editable files instead of images, making it far more practical than rivals.
uses: Professionals and students: turn reports, papers or materials into editable slide decks fast
Consulting, sales and marketing teams: batch-generate proposals and review decks from documents or topics
Users needing brand consistency: apply their own .pptx templates with auto charts, tables and narration
Developers and AI enthusiasts: study the full pipeline from document understanding to PPTX generation

zh.tag: 自托管、可扩展的多模型 AI 聊天与代理平台
zh.what: Open WebUI 是一个自托管的 AI 交互平台，为本地与云端模型提供统一、友好的聊天界面。它兼容 Ollama 与任意 OpenAI 兼容 API，可完全离线运行，并支持插件、RBAC 与代理构建。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 后端加前端 SPA 构成，包含 Docker/Kubernetes 部署配置、插件系统（Filters、Actions、Pipes、Tools、Skills）、RBAC 与用户组模块，以及演示截图和文档链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，支持 pip、uv、Docker（:ollama、:cuda 镜像）与 Kubernetes（kubectl、kustomize、helm）部署，并集成 Ollama、OpenAI 兼容 API、MCP 与 OpenAPI 工具服务。

uses: 想在本地或私有环境运行大模型并拥有 ChatGPT 式界面的个人用户
需要为团队统一接入 Ollama、OpenAI 等多种模型的企业与运维人员
希望基于插件、MCP 和 RBAC 构建定制 AI 代理与工作流的开发者

en.tag: Self-hosted, extensible multi-model AI chat and agent platform
en.what: Open WebUI is a self-hosted AI platform offering a unified, friendly chat interface for local and cloud models. It supports Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible API, runs fully offline, and adds plugins, RBAC, and agent building.
en.content: The repo contains a Python backend plus a frontend SPA, Docker/Kubernetes deployment configs, a plugin system (Filters, Actions, Pipes, Tools, Skills), RBAC and user-group modules, along with demo screenshots and docs links.
en.stack: Primarily Python, deployable via pip, uv, Docker (:ollama, :cuda images) and Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, helm), integrating Ollama, OpenAI-compatible APIs, MCP, and OpenAPI tool servers.
en.hot: With 155,020 stars, 157 added today, and a #5 daily ranking, it has become the go-to open-source frontend for local LLM users, balancing privacy, offline use, and multi-provider flexibility.

Teams and ops staff needing unified access to Ollama, OpenAI, and other providers
Developers building custom AI agents and workflows with plugins, MCP, and RBAC

zh.tag: 百度开源的一次性长文档 OCR 解析模型
zh.what: Unlimited-OCR 是百度推出的 OCR 模型，主打「一次性长程解析」，可对超长文档图像进行端到端识别与结构化解析。它被视为在 DeepSeek-OCR 基础上再进一步的尝试，支持整页乃至多页长文档的连贯理解。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型代码、推理脚本与示例资源，提供 Transformers、vLLM 推理支持，并附带 Hugging Face、ModelScope 模型页与 arXiv 论文链接。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Pillow、PyMuPDF 等，支持 CUDA GPU 推理，并已接入 vLLM 与 ms-swift 训练生态。
zh.hot: 作为百度出品的 OCR 新作，发布即获 2.7 万+ star，今日新增 225，登上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 6，长文档解析需求与 DeepSeek-OCR 话题热度共同推高关注。
uses: 需要批量数字化合同、论文、报表等长文档的企业与团队
构建 RAG 或文档问答系统、需要高质量 OCR 前处理的开发者
研究长上下文多模态与文档理解方向的研究人员
希望本地或私有化部署 OCR 能力的工程团队

en.tag: Baidu's open-source one-shot long-horizon OCR parsing model
en.what: Unlimited-OCR is a Baidu-released OCR model focused on one-shot long-horizon parsing, enabling end-to-end recognition and structured parsing of very long document images. It is positioned as a step beyond DeepSeek-OCR, handling coherent understanding across full pages and multi-page documents.
en.content: The repo contains model code, inference scripts and demo assets, with Transformers and vLLM inference support, plus links to Hugging Face, ModelScope model pages and the arXiv paper.
en.stack: Built in Python on PyTorch, Transformers, Pillow and PyMuPDF, supporting CUDA GPU inference and integrated with the vLLM and ms-swift ecosystems.
en.hot: As a new Baidu OCR release, it quickly reached 27k+ stars with 225 added today, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending Python daily, driven by long-document parsing demand and the DeepSeek-OCR buzz.
uses: Enterprises and teams digitizing long contracts, papers and reports at scale
Developers building RAG or document QA systems needing high-quality OCR preprocessing
Researchers working on long-context multimodal and document understanding
Engineering teams wanting local or private OCR deployment

zh.tag: 用编码代理对话式剪辑视频的开源技能包
zh.what: video-use 让你把原始素材丢进文件夹，然后通过 Claude Code 等编码代理对话完成剪辑，最终输出 final.mp4。它能自动去除口癖和废镜头、调色、加音频淡入淡出、烧录字幕并生成动画叠加，还支持跨会话记忆。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装说明 install.md、日常使用指南 SKILL.md、存放剪辑脚本的 helpers/ 目录，以及静态横幅资源；核心是注册到代理技能目录的编辑技能。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，依赖 ffmpeg 处理音视频，使用 ElevenLabs API 做转写，并可选集成 HyperFrames、Remotion、Manim 或 PIL 生成动画。

开发者与 AI 代理用户：想用 Claude Code 等代理自动化视频工作流
播客/访谈团队：自动去口癖、加字幕与调色
想搭建 VPS 或 Telegram 常驻剪辑流水线的人

en.tag: Open-source skill that edits videos conversationally with coding agents
en.what: video-use lets you drop raw footage into a folder and edit it conversationally through coding agents like Claude Code, producing a final.mp4. It removes filler words and dead space, color grades, adds audio fades, burns subtitles, and generates animation overlays, with cross-session memory.
en.content: The repo contains install.md, a daily-usage SKILL.md, a helpers/ directory holding the editing scripts, and static banner assets; the core is an editing skill registered into the agent's skills directory.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relying on ffmpeg for audio/video processing, ElevenLabs API for transcription, and optional integrations with HyperFrames, Remotion, Manim, or PIL for animations.
en.hot: With its novel chat-to-edit interaction and the browser-use team's backing, it has reached 28,876 stars, adding 95 today and ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's Python daily list.
uses: Content creators who want to quickly turn talking-head, tutorial, or travel footage into final cuts
Developers and AI agent users looking to automate video workflows with Claude Code and similar agents
Podcast and interview teams needing automatic filler removal, subtitles, and color grading
Anyone wanting an always-on editing pipeline on a VPS or Telegram

zh.tag: 跨平台聚合的 AI 代理搜索引擎，用真实互动数据打分

做市场或竞品调研、想抓取 Reddit/X 真实讨论的产品与运营人员
希望让 AI agent 接入多平台实时数据、构建自动化简报的开发者
关注预测市场赔率与社交媒体热度结合信号的投资者与交易员

en.tag: An AI agent-led search engine that scores the internet by real engagement, not editors
en.what: This is an AI agent skill that searches Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the web in parallel, scores results by upvotes, likes, and real-money odds, then has an AI judge synthesize a grounded brief. Instead of relying on editors, it mines what real people actually engage with and bet on.
en.content: The repo centers on a skill spec, with the runtime definition in skills/last30days/SKILL.md, plus install scripts, multilingual READMEs (including Simplified Chinese), and demo GIFs.

Product and marketing teams doing market or competitor research from genuine Reddit/X discussions
Developers who want their AI agent to pull real-time data from multiple platforms into automated briefs
Investors and traders tracking signals that combine prediction-market odds with social media buzz

zh.tag: 全能型跨平台下载器，协议与站点通吃
zh.what: Ghost-Downloader-3 是一款用 Python 编写的全能下载器，号称「你唯一需要的下载器」。它支持 HTTP、Magnet/BT、FTP、M3U8、MPEG-DASH、eD2k 等协议，并内置 YouTube、Bilibili、GitHub、HuggingFace 等站点加速。

经常下载 YouTube/Bilibili 视频、字幕与播放列表的内容创作者

需要跨 Windows/macOS/Linux/Android 一致体验的多平台用户

en.tag: An all-in-one cross-platform downloader covering every protocol and site
en.what: Ghost-Downloader-3 is an all-in-one downloader written in Python, billed as "the only downloader you need." It supports HTTP, Magnet/BT, FTP, M3U8, MPEG-DASH, and eD2k, plus built-in acceleration for YouTube, Bilibili, GitHub, and HuggingFace.
en.content: The repo contains the cross-platform desktop app source (Windows/macOS/Linux/Android), a browser extension, a Feature Packs plugin ecosystem, and multilingual READMEs and docs.

en.hot: With nearly 10k stars (9,850) and +70 today, it ranks 9th on GitHub Trending (Python daily); its "one app instead of five" protocol coverage and anti-bot capabilities draw a large audience.

Content creators frequently downloading YouTube/Bilibili videos, subtitles, and playlists
Power users integrating aria2-compatible RPC into third-party tools
Multi-platform users needing a consistent experience across Windows/macOS/Linux/Android

zh.tag: 面向语音与多模态模型的高性能推理服务框架

en.tag: A high-performance serving framework for audio and unified multimodal models
en.what: SGLang-Omni is a high-performance serving framework from the SGLang project, designed for audio models (TTS, ASR) and unified multimodal models. It provides efficient inference and streaming serving capabilities for speech synthesis, recognition, and unified multimodal processing.
en.content: The repo includes the core serving framework, the Voxt voice input tool, documentation, cookbooks, and examples, with Day-0 support for models like Fish Audio Drama 3.

Voice app developers: build real-time speech synthesis, recognition, or voice cloning applications

zh.tag: 英伟达开源的全双工语音对话模型，支持角色与音色控制
zh.what: PersonaPlex 是一个实时全双工语音到语音对话模型，可通过文本角色提示和音频音色条件来控制说话人的人格。它基于 Moshi 架构，用合成与真实对话混合训练，能产生自然、低延迟且人格一致的语音交互。

en.tag: Open-source framework turning HTML/CSS into deterministic MP4 videos, built for AI agents
en.what: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via CLI, as skills for AI coding agents, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, CLI tools, skill packages (SKILL.md), documentation, examples, and showcase pages. The core enables agents to generate videos by writing HTML, with support for seekable animations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, requires Node.js >= 22, distributed via npm, and integrates AI agent skill systems (e.g., Claude and Agents skills).
en.hot: With over 44k stars and 220 daily additions, it precisely meets the demand for AI-agent-driven video generation, seamlessly combining HTML authoring with video rendering, making it a star on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers: enable agents to automatically generate video content like product intros or tutorials.
Video creators: quickly produce customizable, deterministic videos by writing HTML, without traditional editing software.
Automation workflows: integrate video rendering into CI/CD or content pipelines for batch generation.
Frontend developers: leverage familiar HTML/CSS skills to create animations and video effects.

zh.tag: 把34家免费LLM聚合到一个OpenAI兼容端点
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 把数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到单个 /v1 端点，同时支持自定义 OpenAI 兼容的对话、嵌入、图像与音频端点。它通过智能路由为每个请求挑选可用模型，遇到限流自动故障转移，并加密存储密钥、跟踪各 key 用量以守住免费额度上限。
zh.content: 仓库为 TypeScript 项目，包含路由与故障转移核心、加密密钥存储、用量追踪、模型目录（474 个模型家族、635 个免费端点）、自更新签名模型源，以及 macOS/Windows/Docker/移动端安装方式与文档。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，提供 Docker 镜像（ghcr.io）与 CI，支持 OpenAI 兼容 API，并发布 macOS、Windows、Android、iOS 客户端。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1844 star、总数达 31831，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 20 名；它直击开发者想白嫖多家免费 LLM 额度却要逐个对接的痛点，一个端点即可统一调用。
uses: 个人开发者想低成本试验多家免费 LLM 模型
需要为本地编码助手或 CLI 提供统一 OpenAI 兼容后端的用户
想自托管、加密管理多平台 API key 并控制免费额度的团队
做 AI 应用原型、需要自动故障转移与多模型路由的开发者

en.tag: Aggregate 34 free LLM providers behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint
en.what: FreeLLMAPI aggregates the free tiers of dozens of LLM providers plus custom OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding, image and audio endpoints behind a single /v1 API. A router picks the best available model per request, fails over when a provider is rate-limited, stores keys encrypted, and tracks per-key usage to stay under every free-tier cap.
en.content: It's a TypeScript project containing the routing and failover core, encrypted key storage, usage tracking, a model catalog (474 model families, 635 free endpoints), a self-updating signed model feed, and install paths for macOS, Windows, Docker and mobile plus docs.
en.stack: Primary language is TypeScript, shipped as a Docker image (ghcr.io) with CI, exposing an OpenAI-compatible API, with macOS, Windows, Android and iOS clients.
en.hot: It gained 1,844 stars this month for a total of 31,831, ranking #20 on GitHub Trending monthly; it hits the pain point of juggling many free LLM tiers by unifying them behind one endpoint.
uses: Individual developers experimenting with many free LLM models at low cost
Users who need a unified OpenAI-compatible backend for local coding agents or CLIs
Teams wanting self-hosted, encrypted multi-provider key management within free-tier caps
Developers prototyping AI apps who need automatic failover and multi-model routing

zh.tag: 面向 iOS 用户的友好侧载工具，轻松安装 SideStore 并管理配对文件。
zh.what: iloader 是一个跨平台的图形化工具，帮助用户将 SideStore 或其他 IPA 应用侧载到 iOS 设备上。它简化了 Apple ID 登录、证书导入和配对文件管理的过程，让非技术用户也能轻松完成侧载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的桌面应用源码，提供图形界面，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。主要功能包括安装 SideStore、导入 IPA、管理配对文件以及查看和撤销开发证书。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，可能使用 Electron 或类似框架构建跨平台桌面应用。依赖 usbmuxd 与 iOS 设备通信，并需要 Apple ID 进行签名。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 43 颗星，总星数达 3921，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript）第 9 名。其热度源于解决了 iOS 侧载的痛点，提供了官方且易用的工具，受到越狱和侧载社区的欢迎。
uses: iOS 用户希望安装 SideStore 或其他第三方应用，但不想使用复杂的命令行工具。
开发者需要管理多个 iOS 设备的配对文件和开发证书。
越狱社区成员寻找官方且安全的侧载解决方案。
普通用户想绕过 App Store 安装 IPA 文件，但缺乏技术背景。

en.tag: User-friendly sideloader for iOS, easily install SideStore and manage pairing files.
en.what: iloader is a cross-platform GUI tool that helps users sideload SideStore or other IPA apps onto iOS devices. It simplifies Apple ID login, certificate import, and pairing file management, making sideloading accessible to non-technical users.
en.content: The repository contains the TypeScript source code for a desktop application with a graphical interface, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. Key features include installing SideStore, importing IPAs, managing pairing files, and viewing/revoking development certificates.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, likely using Electron or a similar framework for cross-platform desktop apps. It relies on usbmuxd to communicate with iOS devices and requires an Apple ID for signing.
en.hot: The project gained 43 stars today, reaching 3,921 total stars and ranking 9th on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its popularity stems from solving iOS sideloading pain points with an official, easy-to-use tool, welcomed by the jailbreak and sideloading community.
uses: iOS users who want to install SideStore or other third-party apps without using complex command-line tools.
Developers who need to manage pairing files and development certificates for multiple iOS devices.
Jailbreak community members looking for an official and secure sideloading solution.
Regular users who want to install IPA files outside the App Store but lack technical expertise.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理通过数千个现成爬虫抓取任意网站数据的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: Apify MCP Server 是一个基于 Model Context Protocol 的服务，让 AI 代理调用 Apify Store 上数千个现成的爬虫、抓取器和自动化工具，从社交媒体、搜索引擎、地图、电商等任意网站提取数据。它支持 OAuth，可直接用 URL 接入 Claude.ai、VS Code 等客户端。
zh.content: 仓库提供 MCP 服务器实现，包含托管服务 mcp.apify.com、npm 包 @apify/actors-mcp-server，以及文档、配置示例和多种客户端接入说明。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，发布为 npm 包 @apify/actors-mcp-server，依赖 Apify 平台与 Actors 生态，支持 OAuth、Streamable HTTP 及 x402/Skyfire 等代理支付。
zh.hot: 作为连接 AI 代理与海量爬虫能力的 MCP 网关，它踩中了代理工具链爆发的风口，已获 11042 星，今日新增 200，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 10。
uses: 需要为 AI 代理接入实时网页数据抓取能力的开发者
构建市场调研、竞品监控或舆情分析自动化流程的团队
使用 Claude、Cursor、VS Code 等 MCP 客户端并想扩展数据源的用户

en.tag: MCP server that lets AI agents scrape any website via thousands of ready-made Actors
en.what: Apify MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol service that lets AI agents extract data from social media, search engines, maps, e-commerce sites and any other website using thousands of ready-made scrapers and automation tools from Apify Store. It supports OAuth so clients like Claude.ai or VS Code can connect with just a URL.
en.content: The repo ships the MCP server implementation, the hosted service at mcp.apify.com, the npm package @apify/actors-mcp-server, plus docs, config examples and client integration guides.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript and published as the npm package @apify/actors-mcp-server, it relies on the Apify platform and Actor ecosystem and supports OAuth, Streamable HTTP and agentic payments like x402/Skyfire.
en.hot: As an MCP gateway connecting AI agents to massive scraping power, it rides the agent-tooling boom with 11,042 stars and 200 added today, ranking 10th on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Developers who need to give AI agents real-time web scraping capabilities
Teams building automated market research, competitor monitoring or sentiment analysis pipelines
Users of MCP clients like Claude, Cursor or VS Code who want to extend their data sources

zh.tag: 面向编码代理的上下文压缩插件，小窗口省 token 撑超长会话
zh.what: billion-context 是一个上下文压缩插件，让编码代理在 100K 的小上下文窗口下也能稳定工作。它把历史对话压缩到约五分之一的 token 量，同时保持压缩质量，从而支持单会话持续数月、累计几十亿 token 的超长任务。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现，作为 npm 包发布（billion-context），提供 CLI 安装方式，并适配 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini CLI、Kimi、Qwen Code、Copilot CLI、TRAE 等多种代理客户端。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，通过 npm 分发（npm install -g billion-context），依赖 Node.js 环境，并以插件形式接入各类编码代理的命令行工具。
zh.hot: 本周新增 246 颗星、总数达 711，冲上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 18 名；长会话与 token 成本是代理用户的普遍痛点，而它同时给出省 token 与超长会话的方案，因此快速走红。
uses: 长期使用 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理、常被上下文窗口截断的开发者
需要单会话连续数周/数月推进大型项目的团队与个人
对 API token 成本敏感、希望降低调用开销的用户
想为自研代理接入上下文压缩能力的工具开发者

en.tag: A context-compression plugin for coding agents: small windows, 5x token savings, month-long sessions
en.what: billion-context is a context-compression plugin that keeps coding agents stable even inside a small 100K context window. It shrinks conversation history to roughly one-fifth of the tokens while preserving quality, enabling single sessions that last months and span billions of tokens.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript implementation published as the npm package billion-context, installed via a CLI command, with adapters for many agent clients such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Kimi, Qwen Code, Copilot CLI, and TRAE.
en.stack: Primary language is TypeScript, distributed via npm (npm install -g billion-context), requiring a Node.js environment and plugging into the CLI tools of various coding agents.
en.hot: It gained 246 stars this week for a total of 711, landing at #18 on the GitHub Trending TypeScript weekly chart; long sessions and token costs are widespread pain points for agent users, and it addresses both token savings and ultra-long sessions at once.
uses: Developers who run coding agents like Claude Code or Codex daily and keep hitting context limits
Teams and individuals pushing large projects across weeks or months in a single session
Users sensitive to API token costs who want to cut per-call overhead
Tool builders who want to add context compression to their own agents

zh.tag: 用 Git 仓库统一管理团队 AI 资产并自动同步的 CLI
zh.what: TeamAI 把团队的技能（skills）、规则、Agent、经验沉淀、模型配置、MCP 等 AI 资产集中存放在一个 Git 仓库里。成员只需初始化一次，之后最新的团队 AI 资产会自动同步到各自的 AI 工具中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的 CLI 源码、可被 AI 工具加载的 teamai skill 目录、多语言 README（中/英/日/韩/泰）以及 logo 等资源文件。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，通过 npm 全局安装（teamai-cli），依赖 Git 托管服务（GitHub、GitLab、GitCode、CNB、TGit 或私有 Git）做资产同步。
zh.hot: 作为腾讯开源的团队级 AI 资产治理工具，它切中团队协作中 AI 配置难以共享的痛点，已收获 5426 stars，今日新增 37，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 12 名。
uses: 希望统一管理团队 AI 技能、规则与 MCP 配置的研发团队
想让新成员一键接入团队 AI 资产、免去重复配置的团队负责人
使用 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 工具并想共享 skills 的开发者
需要私有化部署、用自建 Git 托管 AI 资产的企业

en.tag: A CLI that manages and auto-syncs a team's AI assets via a Git repo
en.what: TeamAI stores a team's skills, rules, agents, learnings, models, MCP servers and other AI assets in a single Git repo. A teammate initializes once, and the latest team AI assets sync automatically afterwards.
en.content: It contains the TypeScript CLI source, a loadable teamai skill directory for AI tools, multi-language READMEs (EN/ZH/JA/KO/TH), and asset files like the logo.
en.stack: Built in TypeScript and installed globally via npm (teamai-cli), relying on Git hosts (GitHub, GitLab, GitCode, CNB, TGit or private Git) for asset syncing.
en.hot: As Tencent's open-source tool for team-level AI asset governance, it tackles the pain of sharing AI configs across a team, with 5,426 stars, +37 today, ranking 12th on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Engineering teams wanting unified management of AI skills, rules and MCP configs
Team leads onboarding new members to team AI assets without manual setup
Developers using AI tools like Claude or Cursor who want to share skills
Enterprises needing private, self-hosted Git for AI asset management

zh.tag: 免费开源自托管的 WhatsApp API 网关
zh.what: OpenWA 是一个免费开源的 WhatsApp API 网关，让开发者通过 REST API 与 Webhook 完全掌控自己的消息基础设施，避免供应商锁定和隐藏收费。它支持多会话并发、可插拔架构，并提供完整的可视化管理面板。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NestJS 后端服务、React 管理面板、Docker 部署配置、API 示例与文档，以及可选的官方插件（如 Chatwoot、Typebot、n8n 集成）。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 22 LTS 与 NestJS 构建，使用 TypeScript 编写；数据库可选 SQLite/PostgreSQL，媒体存储支持本地或 S3，缓存可选 Redis 或禁用，并原生支持 Docker。
zh.hot: 作为免费自托管的 WhatsApp 网关，它切中了开发者对消息基础设施自主可控的刚需，加上 Docker 零配置部署与插件生态，已收获 15385 颗星，今日新增 168 星并登上 TypeScript 日榜第 11 名。
uses: 需要自建 WhatsApp 消息通道、避免第三方 API 收费的开发者
希望将 WhatsApp 接入 Chatwoot、Typebot、n8n 等自动化流程的团队
需要多会话并发管理、Webhook 与 API Key 控制的中小企业
想用 Docker 快速搭建私有消息网关并自行掌控数据的运维人员

en.tag: Free, open-source, self-hosted WhatsApp API gateway
en.what: OpenWA is a free, open-source WhatsApp API gateway that gives developers full control over their messaging infrastructure via REST APIs and webhooks, without vendor lock-in or hidden paywalls. It supports concurrent multi-session operation, a pluggable architecture, and a full management dashboard.
en.content: The repo ships a NestJS backend, a React dashboard, Docker deployment configs, API examples and docs, plus optional official plugins such as Chatwoot, Typebot and n8n integrations.
en.stack: Built on Node.js 22 LTS with NestJS and written in TypeScript; database options include SQLite/PostgreSQL, media storage can be local or S3, cache can be Redis or disabled, and it is Docker-native.
en.hot: As a free self-hosted WhatsApp gateway, it hits a real need for developer-controlled messaging infrastructure; with zero-config Docker deployment and a plugin ecosystem, it has reached 15,385 stars, gaining 168 today and ranking 11th on the TypeScript trending daily list.
uses: Developers who want a self-hosted WhatsApp messaging channel without third-party API fees
Teams integrating WhatsApp with automation tools like Chatwoot, Typebot or n8n
SMBs needing multi-session management with webhooks and API key control
Ops engineers who want a Docker-based private gateway with full data ownership

zh.tag: 让 AI 编码代理更懂 Supabase 与 Postgres 的技能包
zh.what: 这是 Supabase 官方推出的 Agent Skills 集合，把 Supabase 全产品线用法和 Postgres 最佳实践封装成代理可自动发现、按需调用的技能文件夹。安装后，AI 代理在遇到相关任务时会自动加载对应指令、脚本与参考资料，从而更准确高效地写代码。
zh.content: 仓库以技能文件夹形式组织，目前包含 supabase（覆盖数据库、Auth、Edge Functions、Realtime、Storage、Vectors、Cron、Queues 及客户端库与 SSR 集成）和 supabase-postgres-best-practices（按影响优先级划分 8 大类性能优化指南）两个技能。

uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 代理开发 Supabase 项目的工程师

在 Next.js、SvelteKit、Astro 等框架中做 Supabase Auth 与 SSR 集成的全栈团队
希望用统一技能包规范团队 AI 编码流程的技术负责人

en.tag: Agent Skills that make AI coding agents fluent in Supabase and Postgres
en.what: This is Supabase's official collection of Agent Skills that packages Supabase product usage and Postgres best practices into folders agents can discover and invoke on demand. Once installed, AI agents automatically load the relevant instructions, scripts, and references for the task, producing more accurate and efficient code.

uses: Engineers building Supabase projects with AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot
Backend developers who want agents to follow Postgres indexing, RLS, and pooling best practices automatically
Full-stack teams integrating Supabase Auth and SSR in Next.js, SvelteKit, or Astro
Tech leads standardizing their team's AI coding workflow with a shared skill pack

zh.tag: 开源生成式 UI 框架：让 AI 回答变成可交互工具
zh.what: Open Intelligent UI 是一个开源聊天界面，让 AI 根据问题自动选择纯文本、原生组件或自定义交互式 UI 来作答。用户可以探索 3D 解释、并排比较选项，甚至现场生成计算器、规划器等可用工具。

zh.tag: 终端优先的开源编码代理 CLI，任意模型随处运行
zh.what: OpenClaude 是一个开源的编码代理命令行工具，面向云端与本地模型提供商。它统一了提示词、工具调用、子代理、MCP、斜杠命令与流式输出，让开发者在一个终端工作流里切换不同后端。

en.tag: Open-source terminal-first coding-agent CLI that runs anywhere with any LLM
en.what: OpenClaude is an open-source coding-agent CLI for cloud and local model providers. It keeps one terminal-first workflow—prompts, tools, agents, MCP, slash commands, and streaming output—while letting you switch between backends.
en.content: Written in TypeScript, the repo ships the CLI core, provider adapters for each backend, the MCP and tool system, docs assets, and a VS Code extension.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript/Node.js and published to npm as @twigpine/openclaude; it integrates OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini, GitHub Models, Codex OAuth, Ollama, and the MCP protocol.
en.hot: With its 'runs anywhere, uses anything' open positioning, it has reached 33,836 stars, adding 59 today and ranking 16th on GitHub Trending's daily TypeScript list.
uses: Developers who prefer a terminal workflow and want to code with any LLM
Teams that need to switch freely between local Ollama and cloud models
Engineers extending custom toolchains via MCP and slash commands
Individual developers pairing the CLI with its VS Code extension

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程代理提供持久记忆层，告别重复解释
zh.what: agentmemory 是一个面向 AI 编程代理的持久记忆系统，让代理记住项目上下文、偏好与历史决策，无需每次重新说明。它基于 iii engine 构建，通过 MCP 协议接入各类编码代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 TypeScript 实现、banner 等资源文件，以及覆盖 30 多种语言的多语言 README 文档（含简繁中文、日韩、欧洲多语种等）。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 为主语言，构建在 iii engine 之上，通过 MCP 协议与 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot CLI、Gemini CLI、Codex CLI 等客户端集成。
zh.hot: 近 3 万 star 且今日仍在增长，切中代理「失忆」这一普遍痛点，加上多语言文档与设计文档 gist 的病毒式传播，迅速登上 TypeScript 日榜。
uses: 日常使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等编码代理的开发者，希望代理记住项目上下文
需要跨会话保持偏好与决策一致性的团队协作场景
研究 AI 代理记忆、知识图谱与混合检索的工程师
希望为自建 MCP 客户端接入持久记忆能力的工具作者

en.tag: Persistent memory layer for AI coding agents, no more re-explaining
en.what: agentmemory is a persistent memory system for AI coding agents, letting them retain project context, preferences, and past decisions instead of re-explaining every session. Built on the iii engine, it plugs into coding agents via the MCP protocol.
en.content: The repo contains the core TypeScript implementation, asset files like the banner, and README docs localized into 30+ languages (including Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and many European languages).
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the iii engine and integrated via MCP with clients like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, and Codex CLI.
en.hot: With nearly 29.4k stars and still climbing today, it hits the universal pain of agent amnesia, boosted by multilingual docs and a viral design-doc gist, landing it on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Developers using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar agents who want persistent project context
Teams needing consistent preferences and decisions across sessions
Engineers researching agent memory, knowledge graphs, and hybrid search
Tool builders wanting to add persistent memory to custom MCP clients

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编程工具 Token 用量与成本监控桌面挂件
zh.what: Token Monitor 是一个本地优先的桌面挂件，实时展示 44+ 款 AI 编程工具（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、OpenClaw 等）的 token 用量、费用、额度限制与会话活动。它支持多设备同步、历史趋势，以及按工具、设备、模型、会话或项目维度拆分统计。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面应用源码（Windows/macOS/Linux）、各工具图标资源、演示 GIF 与截图，以及英文、简中、繁中、韩、日、葡等多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，基于 Electron 类桌面框架构建，直接读取各工具本地数据目录（如 ~/.claude/projects/、~/.codex/、~/.local/share/opencode/）并做本地解析与同步。
zh.hot: AI 编程工具爆发让开发者普遍关心 token 花费与额度，而市面缺少统一监控方案；项目上线不久即获 2974 stars，今日新增 125，冲上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 4。
uses: 同时使用多款 AI 编程工具、想统一查看 token 花费与额度的开发者
需要按项目或模型核算 AI 成本、做预算控制的团队与个人
在多个设备上使用 AI 工具、希望同步用量数据的重度用户
关注本地数据隐私、不愿把用量上传到第三方云端的用户

en.tag: Local-first desktop widget tracking token usage and costs across 44+ AI coding tools
en.what: Token Monitor is a local-first desktop widget that shows live token usage, costs, limits, and session activity across 44+ AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and OpenClaw. It offers multi-device sync, historical trends, and breakdowns by tool, device, model, session, or project.
en.content: The repo contains the cross-platform desktop app source (Windows/macOS/Linux), tool icon assets, demo GIFs and screenshots, plus READMEs in English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and Portuguese.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built as an Electron-style desktop app that reads each tool's local data directories (e.g. ~/.claude/projects/, ~/.codex/, ~/.local/share/opencode/) for local parsing and sync.
en.hot: As AI coding tools explode, developers urgently need unified visibility into token spend and limits; the project quickly reached 2,974 stars, adding 125 today to rank #4 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript).
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding tools who want one view of token spend and limits
Teams and individuals budgeting AI costs by project or model
Heavy users who work across several machines and want synced usage data
Privacy-conscious users who prefer local-first data over third-party cloud uploads

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的最快浏览器，共享登录态且互不打扰
zh.what: ego lite 是一款专为 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude Code）设计的浏览器，让代理在独立的 Space 工作区中执行网页自动化任务，同时你可以继续用自己的浏览器窗口，互不干扰。它直接复用你真实的登录状态和标签页，无需额外配置，零成本上手。
zh.content: 仓库包含 macOS 应用安装包（Apple Silicon 与 Intel 版）、多语言 README、文档站点与演示视频，核心是 ego-browser 代理接口。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主，提供 macOS 原生应用，通过 ego-browser 接口与 AI 代理通信；Windows 处于封闭测试，Linux 在路线图中。
zh.hot: 上线即获 17,313 颗星、今日新增 101 星并登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 3，说明开发者对「代理专用浏览器」这一痛点需求强烈。
uses: 使用 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 代理做网页自动化的开发者
需要代理复用真实登录态、又不想被打断日常浏览的用户
希望降低 token 消耗、提升自动化速度的团队
关注 AI 代理与浏览器交互形态的研究者

en.tag: The fastest browser built for AI agents, sharing your logged-in state without disturbing you
en.what: ego lite is a browser designed for AI agents like Codex or Claude Code, letting them run web automation in isolated Spaces while you keep browsing in your own. It reuses your real logins and tabs with zero config and zero cost, so agents and humans never fight over the browser.
en.content: The repo ships macOS installers (Apple Silicon and Intel), multilingual READMEs, documentation, a demo video, and the core ego-browser agent interface.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript with a native macOS app, communicating with AI agents via the ego-browser interface; Windows is in closed beta and Linux is on the roadmap.
en.hot: With 17,313 stars, 101 added today, and a #3 spot on GitHub Trending's JavaScript daily list, it clearly hits a strong developer pain point for agent-native browsers.
uses: Developers running web automation with AI agents like Codex or Claude Code
Users who need agents to reuse real logins without interrupting their own browsing
Teams aiming to cut token usage and speed up automation
Researchers exploring how AI agents interact with browsers

zh.tag: 浏览器内实时运行GPT-2的交互式Transformer可视化教学工具
zh.what: Transformer Explainer 是一个交互式可视化工具，旨在帮助任何人学习 GPT 等基于 Transformer 的模型工作原理。它直接在浏览器中运行一个实时的 GPT-2 模型，让你输入自己的文本，并实时观察 Transformer 的内部组件和操作如何协同预测下一个 token。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的可视化 Web 应用源码，基于 Vite 构建，并附有演示视频、研究论文和本地运行指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，依赖 Node.js v20+ 和 NPM v10+，通过 Vite 进行开发构建，并在浏览器中运行 GPT-2 模型。
zh.hot: 凭借直观的交互式可视化，让普通人也能在浏览器中实时探索 GPT-2 的内部机制，加上来自佐治亚理工的学术背景和 CHI 论文，该项目已获得 8930 颗星，今日新增 26 星，位列 JavaScript 日榜第 8。
uses: AI 初学者和爱好者 —— 通过动手实验直观理解 Transformer 和 LLM 的内部工作原理。
教育工作者和学生 —— 在课堂或自学中用作演示和探索 Transformer 架构的交互式教具。
NLP 开发者和研究者 —— 快速验证和观察 GPT-2 模型在具体输入下的注意力与预测行为。

en.tag: Interactive visualization tool that runs a live GPT-2 model in your browser to explain Transformers
en.what: Transformer Explainer is an interactive visualization tool designed to help anyone learn how Transformer-based models like GPT work. It runs a live GPT-2 model right in your browser, allowing you to experiment with your own text and observe in real time how internal components and operations work together to predict the next token.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the visualization web app, built with Vite, along with a demo video, research paper, and local setup instructions.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, requiring Node.js v20+ and NPM v10+, built with Vite, and runs a GPT-2 model in the browser.
en.hot: With intuitive interactive visualization that lets anyone explore GPT-2's internals in real time in the browser, plus academic backing from Georgia Tech and a CHI paper, it has earned 8,930 stars, with 26 added today, ranking 8th on the JavaScript daily trending list.
uses: AI beginners and enthusiasts — intuitively understand how Transformers and LLMs work internally through hands-on experimentation.
Educators and students — use as an interactive teaching tool to demonstrate and explore Transformer architecture in classrooms or self-study.
NLP developers and researchers — quickly validate and observe GPT-2's attention and prediction behavior on specific inputs.

zh.tag: 跨平台 Electron 影视动漫流媒体与下载桌面应用，零广告零追踪
zh.what: Streambert 是一款基于 Electron 的跨平台桌面应用，可以流式播放和下载全球的电影、电视剧与动漫。它内置字幕管理、观看库、每日热门推荐和界面自定义，并承诺永久无广告、无追踪。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 JavaScript 编写的 Electron 应用源码，包含主进程与渲染层、public 下的 logo 等静态资源，以及 screenshots 目录中的热门、剧集、电影、动漫、下载、字幕等界面截图。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 JavaScript 和 Electron 为核心，视频源主要来自 VidSrc，也支持 videasy 和 vidking，影视元数据、图片与搜索由 TMDB API 提供。
zh.hot: 凭借“零广告零追踪 + 一站式看片下载”的直白卖点，项目已积累 6261 颗星，今日再涨 28 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 JavaScript 第 5 名。
uses: 想免费观看和下载全球影视动漫、又不想被广告打扰的普通用户
需要在多平台（Windows/macOS/Linux）统一管理观影库和字幕的影迷
希望研究 Electron 桌面应用、流媒体聚合或 TMDB 集成方式的开发者

en.tag: Cross-platform Electron desktop app to stream and download movies, TV series and anime, ad-free and tracker-free
en.what: Streambert is a cross-platform Electron desktop app for streaming and downloading movies, TV series and anime from around the world. It bundles subtitle management, a watch library, daily trending discovery and UI customization, with a promise of no ads or trackers ever.
en.content: The repo holds the JavaScript Electron app source, including main and renderer layers, static assets such as the logo under public, and a screenshots folder showing trending, series, movie, anime, download and subtitle views.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript and Electron, it mainly pulls video streams from VidSrc with optional videasy and vidking sources, while metadata, images and search come from the TMDB API.
en.hot: With its blunt pitch of zero ads, zero tracking and one-stop streaming plus downloading, it has reached 6,261 stars, gaining 28 more today and ranking 5th on the GitHub Trending daily JavaScript list.
uses: Everyday users who want to watch and download global movies and anime without ads
Movie fans who need a unified watch library and subtitle manager across Windows, macOS and Linux
Developers curious about Electron desktop apps, streaming aggregation or TMDB integration

zh.tag: 学习通自动刷课脚本，稳定播放与自动切节
zh.what: 这是一个针对超星学习通平台的浏览器自动化脚本，能够自动播放课程视频、视频结束后切换到下一小节，并在章节测验页面尝试受限跳转。它聚焦于稳定播放与课程导航，不叠加复杂的后台保活或通知功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含控制台直接执行版 v3_optimized.js、Tampermonkey 油猴版 v3_optimized.user.js，以及用于生成油猴版的构建脚本 scripts/build-userscript.mjs 和验证脚本 tests/verify-v3.mjs。
zh.stack: 纯 JavaScript 编写，依赖浏览器控制台或 Tampermonkey 运行，使用 Node.js 脚本进行构建与语法验证。
zh.hot: 学习通是大学生常用平台，刷课需求旺盛，该脚本以稳定性和简洁性获得 2759 星，今日新增 21 星，登上 JavaScript 日榜第 10 名。
uses: 需要自动完成学习通视频课程的大学生
对浏览器自动化脚本感兴趣的前端开发者
希望研究页面行为与媒体播放控制的调试人员

en.tag: Auto course-playing script for Xuexitong with stable playback and auto-advance
en.what: This is a browser automation script for the Chaoxing Xuexitong platform that automatically plays course videos, advances to the next section after a video ends, and attempts limited skipping on quiz pages. It focuses on stable playback and course navigation without adding complex background keep-alive or notification features.
en.content: The repo contains a console-executable version v3_optimized.js, a Tampermonkey userscript v3_optimized.user.js, a build script scripts/build-userscript.mjs for generating the userscript, and a verification script tests/verify-v3.mjs.
en.stack: Written in pure JavaScript, runs in the browser console or via Tampermonkey, with Node.js scripts for building and syntax verification.
en.hot: Xuexitong is widely used by college students, creating strong demand for auto-course tools; this script gained 2,759 stars for its stability and simplicity, with 21 new stars today, ranking 10th on the JavaScript daily trending list.
uses: College students needing to auto-complete Xuexitong video courses
Front-end developers interested in browser automation scripts
Debuggers researching page behavior and media playback control

zh.tag: 用普通 WiFi 信号实现穿墙空间感知与生命体征监测
zh.what: RuView 把普通 WiFi 信号变成实时空间智能系统，可以检测人员存在、追踪移动、测量呼吸与心率，无需摄像头或可穿戴设备。它利用无线电波物理特性，能穿墙、在黑暗中工作，并原生接入主流智能家居生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心实现、ESP32 CSI 节点固件、预训练模型（Hugging Face 上的 wifi-densepose-pretrained）、AI 工具链 harness/ruview，以及 Home Assistant、Apple Home、Matter 等集成文档和用户指南。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，配合 ESP32 固件采集 WiFi CSI 数据，模型托管在 Hugging Face，并通过 MQTT、HAP-1.1、Matter 等协议对接智能家居平台。
zh.hot: 近 10 万 star、今日新增 261，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 2，凭借「用 WiFi 穿墙感知」这一反直觉且高实用性的概念迅速走红。
uses: 智能家居用户：无需摄像头即可实现房间级存在检测与生命体征联动
隐私敏感场景：在浴室、卧室等不便安装摄像头的空间做监护
健康与养老看护：非接触式监测呼吸、心率与跌倒等异常
硬件与嵌入式开发者：基于 ESP32 CSI 节点二次开发无线感知应用

en.tag: Turn commodity WiFi signals into through-wall spatial sensing and vital-sign monitoring
en.what: RuView turns ordinary WiFi signals into a real-time spatial intelligence system that detects presence, tracks movement, and measures breathing and heart rate without cameras or wearables. Leveraging radio-wave physics, it works through walls and in the dark, and integrates natively with major smart-home ecosystems.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust core, ESP32 CSI node firmware, pretrained models (wifi-densepose-pretrained on Hugging Face), an AI toolkit under harness/ruview, plus integration docs for Home Assistant, Apple Home, Matter, and a user guide.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with ESP32 firmware for WiFi CSI capture, models hosted on Hugging Face, and smart-home integration via MQTT, HAP-1.1, and Matter.
en.hot: With nearly 98k stars and 261 added today, it ranks #2 on GitHub Trending (Rust) thanks to the counterintuitive yet highly practical promise of through-wall WiFi sensing.
uses: Smart-home users: room-level presence detection and vitals without cameras
Privacy-sensitive spaces: monitoring bathrooms or bedrooms where cameras are unwanted
Health and elder care: contactless breathing, heart-rate, and fall monitoring
Hardware and embedded developers: build wireless sensing apps on the ESP32 CSI node

zh.tag: 把命令行输出压缩 60-90% 的 LLM Token 优化代理
zh.what: RTK 是一个 CLI 代理，拦截 shell 命令并在输出进入 AI 代理上下文前进行压缩、路由和过滤。它基于久经考验的 bash 输出压缩能力，可将常见开发命令的输出缩小最多 90%，从而显著降低 LLM Token 消耗。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Rust 项目，包含可执行 CLI 二进制、100+ 命令的压缩规则、架构文档（docs/contributing/ARCHITECTURE.md）以及多语言 README（中、英、法、日、韩、西、葡）。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，单一二进制、零依赖，开销低于 10ms，可通过 Homebrew 安装，采用 Apache-2.0 与 BUSL-1.1 双许可。
zh.hot: 凭借 83232 颗星和今日新增 124 星登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 第 3 名，切中 AI 代理 Token 成本痛点且零依赖易用。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理、希望降低 API Token 成本的开发者
需要压缩终端输出以适配 LLM 上下文窗口的团队
在 CI/CD 或本地开发中追求低开销命令行工具的用户

en.tag: CLI proxy that cuts LLM token usage by 60-90% on dev commands
en.what: RTK is a CLI proxy that intercepts shell commands and compresses, routes, and filters their output before it reaches your AI agent's context. Built on battle-tested bash-output compression, it shrinks common dev command output by up to 90%, dramatically cutting LLM token consumption.
en.content: The repo is a Rust project containing the CLI binary, compression rules for 100+ commands, architecture docs (docs/contributing/ARCHITECTURE.md), and multilingual READMEs (EN, ZH, FR, JA, KO, ES, PT).
en.stack: Written in Rust as a single zero-dependency binary with <10ms overhead, installable via Homebrew, dual-licensed under Apache-2.0 and BUSL-1.1.
en.hot: With 83,232 stars and 124 added today, it ranks #3 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily, hitting the AI-agent token-cost pain point with a zero-dependency, easy-to-adopt tool.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents who want to cut API token costs
Teams needing to compress terminal output to fit LLM context windows
Users wanting a low-overhead CLI tool for CI/CD or local development

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的高性能、低内存编码智能体运行框架
zh.what: jcode 是一个用 Rust 编写的编码智能体（coding agent）运行框架，把模型、工具调用与终端交互整合成一套可用的 CLI/TUI 工作流。它主打极致的内存效率与智能调度，让开发者在本机跑编码代理时更省资源、响应更快。
zh.content: 仓库提供跨平台安装脚本（macOS/Linux/Windows）、TUI 客户端、更新与自构建流程，以及官网、文档、SDK 和基准测试入口，并配有 Discord 社区。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 实现，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 三平台，提供 curl/PowerShell 安装、Homebrew 与源码构建，并暴露 SDK 供二次开发。
zh.hot: 凭借“最省内存 + 最智能”的定位和 Rust 带来的性能优势，项目已累积 20612 颗星，今日新增 161 星，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 第 2 名。
uses: 想在本机低成本运行编码智能体的个人开发者
对内存占用敏感、需要长时间跑代理的工程团队
希望基于 SDK 定制自有编码代理工作流的产品团队

en.tag: A high-performance, RAM-efficient coding agent harness written in Rust
en.what: jcode is a coding agent harness written in Rust that bundles model calls, tool use, and terminal interaction into one CLI/TUI workflow. It emphasizes extreme RAM efficiency and smarter orchestration so developers can run coding agents locally with fewer resources and faster responses.
en.content: The repo ships cross-platform install scripts (macOS/Linux/Windows), a TUI client, update and self-rebuild workflows, plus links to website, docs, SDK, and benchmarks, along with a Discord community.
en.stack: Core is implemented in Rust, targeting Linux, macOS, and Windows, with curl/PowerShell installers, Homebrew and source builds, and an SDK for extension.
en.hot: Positioned as the most RAM-efficient and most intelligent harness, it leverages Rust's performance to reach 20,612 stars, gaining 161 today and ranking #2 on GitHub Trending (Rust).
uses: Individual developers who want to run coding agents locally at low cost
Engineering teams sensitive to memory usage and running agents for long sessions
Product teams wanting to customize their own coding agent workflows via the SDK

zh.tag: Rust 编写的高性能 GraphRAG，把文档变成知识图谱
zh.what: EdgeQuake 是一个受 LightRAG 启发的 GraphRAG 实现，用 Rust 编写。它把文档转化为知识图谱，让检索与生成不只依赖相似文本块，而是返回带来源的答案。整套系统只需一个二进制文件和一个 Postgres，可对接云端或完全本地的任意 LLM。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 后端与 Web UI、REST API/Swagger、Docker 快速启动脚本 quickstart.sh，以及 docs 目录下的部署、认证与操作文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust（1.95+），使用 Postgres 作为存储，通过 Docker 一键部署，并支持 Ollama、LM Studio、oMLX、MLX-LM、llama.cpp 及 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 LLM 提供方。

uses: 需要在本地或私有环境搭建 GraphRAG 检索增强问答的开发者
希望用知识图谱替代纯向量检索、追求带来源答案的 AI 应用团队
偏好 Rust 高性能栈并想快速体验 GraphRAG 的技术爱好者

en.tag: High-performance GraphRAG in Rust that turns documents into knowledge graphs
en.what: EdgeQuake is a GraphRAG implementation inspired by LightRAG and written in Rust. It transforms documents into knowledge graphs so retrieval and generation return answers with sources, not just similar chunks. The whole system runs as one binary with one Postgres, and works with any LLM, cloud or fully local.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust backend with a web UI, a REST API with Swagger, a Docker quickstart script (quickstart.sh), and a docs folder covering deployment, auth, and operations.
en.stack: Written in Rust (1.95+) with Postgres for storage, deployed via Docker in one command, and supporting Ollama, LM Studio, oMLX, MLX-LM, llama.cpp as well as OpenAI and Anthropic providers.
en.hot: With Rust-level performance, a minimal one-binary/one-Postgres deployment, and flexible support for both local and cloud LLMs, it has reached 2,241 stars, gaining 28 today and ranking 5th on the GitHub Trending Rust daily list.
uses: Developers who want to run GraphRAG-based retrieval-augmented QA locally or in a private environment
AI application teams seeking knowledge-graph answers with sources instead of pure vector retrieval
Rust enthusiasts who want a high-performance stack and a quick GraphRAG hands-on experience

zh.tag: 一条命令打通 Google Workspace 全系 API，内置 AI 代理技能
zh.what: gws 是一个统一的 Google Workspace 命令行工具，覆盖 Drive、Gmail、Calendar、Sheets、Docs、Chat、Admin 等全部 Workspace API。它不在代码里写死命令列表，而是在运行时读取 Google Discovery Service 动态生成整个命令面，Google 新增接口即可自动支持。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 实现核心 CLI，同时提供 npm 包 @googleworkspace/cli 与 Nix flake 分发方式，并附带 40+ 个 AI agent skills 与结构化 JSON 输出能力。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，通过 npm 分发预编译二进制，依赖 Node.js 18+ 安装，认证基于 Google Cloud OAuth 凭据。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方 Workspace 组织下的项目，它把零散繁杂的 Workspace API 收敛成一条命令，还顺势内置 AI agent 技能，契合当下代理化工作流热潮，已斩获 31466 颗星并登上 Rust 日榜第 6。
uses: 需要在脚本或 CI 中批量操作 Drive、Gmail、Calendar 的开发者
想让 AI 代理直接读写 Google Workspace 数据的 agent 构建者
希望用统一 CLI 替代多套 SDK 样板代码的运维与自动化工程师

en.tag: One CLI for all of Google Workspace, with built-in AI agent skills
en.what: gws is a single command-line tool for the entire Google Workspace surface, covering Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Chat, Admin and more. Instead of shipping a static command list, it reads Google's Discovery Service at runtime and builds its command surface dynamically, so new API endpoints are picked up automatically.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust-based CLI core, distributed via the npm package @googleworkspace/cli and a Nix flake, plus 40+ AI agent skills and structured JSON output.
en.stack: Written in Rust, distributed as prebuilt binaries via npm, requires Node.js 18+ for install, and authenticates through Google Cloud OAuth credentials.
en.hot: Hosted under the official Google Workspace org, it collapses the sprawling Workspace APIs into one command and bundles AI agent skills, riding the agentic-workflow wave to 31,466 stars and No.6 on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Developers scripting bulk Drive, Gmail or Calendar operations in CI
Agent builders who want AI agents to read and write Google Workspace data directly
Ops and automation engineers replacing multiple SDK boilerplates with one CLI

zh.tag: Rust 开源 CAD，支持 2D/3D 与 DWG/DXF 原生读写
zh.what: Open CAD Studio 是一个用 Rust 构建的开源 CAD 应用，提供 2D 绘图和 3D 建模功能，支持桌面端和 Web 端。它能够原生读写 DWG 和 DXF 文件，无需转换服务，并利用 GPU 加速渲染。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CAD 应用源码，涵盖桌面端和 Web 端，提供统一的编辑核心。项目包含多语言 README、资源文件（如 logo）、示例工作区截图，以及用于 Web 部署的站点目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，并可能涉及 WebAssembly（用于 Web 端）、GPU 渲染库（如 wgpu）以及 DWG/DXF 解析库。具体依赖需查看 Cargo.toml。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 46 星，总星数达 1166，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 6。其亮点在于用 Rust 实现 CAD，提供原生 DWG/DXF 支持，填补了开源 CAD 领域的空白。
uses: 工程师和设计师需要免费、跨平台的 CAD 工具进行 2D 制图或 3D 建模。
开发者希望研究或扩展一个基于 Rust 的现代 CAD 应用，或贡献代码。

需要处理 DWG/DXF 文件但不想依赖商业软件或在线转换服务的用户。

en.tag: Open-source CAD in Rust: 2D/3D drawing, native DWG/DXF, GPU rendering
en.what: Open CAD Studio is an open-source CAD application built with Rust, offering 2D drafting and 3D modeling for desktop and web. It natively reads and writes DWG and DXF files without conversion services, with GPU-accelerated rendering.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the CAD app, covering desktop and web with a shared editing core. It includes multi-language READMEs, assets like logo, workspace screenshots, and a site directory for web deployment.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, likely using WebAssembly for the web version, GPU rendering libraries like wgpu, and DWG/DXF parsing crates. Specific dependencies are in Cargo.toml.
en.hot: The project is gaining traction on GitHub, with 46 stars today and 1166 total, ranking #6 on the Rust trending list. Its novelty lies in a Rust-based CAD with native DWG/DXF support, filling a gap in open-source CAD.
uses: Engineers and designers needing a free, cross-platform CAD tool for 2D drafting or 3D modeling.
Developers interested in studying or extending a modern Rust-based CAD application or contributing code.
Educational institutions or students learning CAD concepts with open-source software.
Users who need to handle DWG/DXF files without relying on commercial software or online conversion services.

zh.tag: 单人公司 AI 部门化运营指挥台
zh.what: FounderOS 是一个开源的单人企业运营指挥中心，把沟通、客户漏斗、社交增长、财务、知识图谱和一组具名 AI 代理整合到一块实时仪表盘上。它面向自由职业者、独立创业者或小团队中实际统筹全局的那个人，让 AI 代理承担各部门职能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 v2 版本的完整代码：SvelteKit 前端、Go(Gin) 后端、PostgreSQL+Redis 数据层，以及可选的 Electron 桌面壳；操作台视图位于 /os 路由下，并提供 make demo 一键加载四个工作区的演示数据。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，后端使用 Gin 框架，前端从 Next.js 迁移到 SvelteKit 2 (Svelte 5)，数据层采用 PostgreSQL + pgvector 与 Redis，知识/记忆层由 Elixir/OTP 编写的 Optimal Engine 提供，并可选 Electron 桌面端。
zh.hot: 作为单人创业与 AI 代理结合的新形态工具，它切中了独立开发者对“一人公司”运营自动化的需求，本周新增 77 star，总 star 达到 1024，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 TypeScript 分类第 15 名。
uses: 独立创业者与自由职业者，希望用 AI 代理分担日常运营事务
单人主导的小团队负责人，需要统一看板管理沟通、漏斗与财务
对 AI 代理编排和知识图谱感兴趣的技术开发者，可参考其架构实现
想搭建自己业务操作系统的开发者，可跟随官方 cohort 指导进行定制

en.tag: An AI-assisted command center for running a one-person company
en.what: FounderOS is an open-source command center for a one-person business, unifying comms, client funnel, social growth, finances, a knowledge graph, and a roster of named AI agents into one live dashboard. It targets freelancers, solopreneurs, and small teams where one person still runs point, letting AI agents cover the departments.
en.content: The repo contains the full v2 codebase: a SvelteKit frontend, a Go (Gin) backend, PostgreSQL + Redis data layer, and an optional Electron desktop shell; operator views live under /os, with a make demo command that seeds four workspaces of demo data.
en.stack: Primarily Go with the Gin framework on the backend, the frontend migrated from Next.js to SvelteKit 2 (Svelte 5), with PostgreSQL + pgvector and Redis for data, an Elixir/OTP-based Optimal Engine for knowledge/memory, and an optional Electron desktop shell.
en.hot: As a novel tool blending solo entrepreneurship with AI agents, it hits the demand for automating one-person company operations; it gained 77 stars this week for a total of 1,024, ranking 15th on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript chart.
uses: Solopreneurs and freelancers who want AI agents to handle daily operations
Leads of small teams where one person still runs point and needs a unified board for comms, funnel, and finances
Developers interested in AI agent orchestration and knowledge graphs who want to study its architecture
Builders who want to create their own business OS and can follow the official cohort guidance

zh.tag: 全自主AI代理系统，执行复杂渗透测试任务
zh.what: PentAGI 是一个全自主 AI 代理系统，能够自动执行复杂的渗透测试任务。它利用大语言模型驱动多个代理协作，完成从信息收集到漏洞利用的完整流程。

zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 1819 颗星，总星数达 28233，位列 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 2 名，反映出 AI 驱动安全工具的热度。
uses: 安全研究人员和渗透测试人员 —— 自动化执行重复性测试任务
AI 和网络安全爱好者 —— 探索 AI 在攻防场景中的应用
企业安全团队 —— 用于内部安全评估和红队演练

en.tag: Fully autonomous AI agent system for complex penetration testing
en.what: PentAGI is a fully autonomous AI agent system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks. It leverages LLMs to drive multiple agents that collaborate on the full workflow from reconnaissance to exploitation.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based core agent framework, Docker deployment configurations, LLM provider integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, etc.), and web UI and API access modules.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, relies on Docker for containerization, and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama.
en.hot: The project gained 1,819 stars today, reaching 28,233 total, and ranks #2 on GitHub Trending (Go daily), reflecting the surging interest in AI-driven security tools.

AI and cybersecurity enthusiasts — explore AI applications in offensive/defensive scenarios
Enterprise security teams — for internal security assessments and red team exercises

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 把 AI 编码代理当队友派活的开源自托管协作工作台
zh.what: Multica 是一个源码可得的协作工作台，让你像给同事派活一样把 issue 分配给 AI 编码代理：代理会领取任务、汇报进度、提出阻塞并交回等待评审。它可自托管，兼容你已在用的代理 CLI，不锁定厂商。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端与 Web 工作台（看板式任务流转），以及 apps/docs 文档站、自托管指南（SELF_HOSTING.md）、愿景文档和 CI 工作流等。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，配套 Web 前端与文档站；通过适配层对接 Claude Code、Codex 等现有代理 CLI，支持自托管部署。
zh.hot: 已积累约 5.27 万 star，今日再增 110，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 4；它切中了多代理并行时上下文丢失、需要人肉盯守的痛点。
uses: 同时运行多个编码代理、需要统一任务看板与进度追踪的工程团队
希望自托管、避免把代码与流程交给第三方 SaaS 的公司
想给 AI 代理建立 issue 领取、汇报、评审闭环的团队负责人
已在用 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI，想减少重复交代上下文的开发者

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents like teammates
en.what: Multica is a source-available workspace where you assign work to AI coding agents the way you'd assign it to a teammate: they pick up the issue, report progress, raise blockers, and hand it back for review. It is self-hostable, works with the agent CLIs you already use, and avoids vendor lock-in.
en.content: The repo holds a Go backend plus a web workspace with a kanban-style board, alongside an apps/docs site, a self-hosting guide (SELF_HOSTING.md), a vision doc, and CI workflows.
en.stack: Primarily Go with a web frontend and docs site; it integrates existing agent CLIs such as Claude Code and Codex through adapters and supports self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: It has gathered roughly 52.7k stars and added 110 today, ranking 4th on GitHub Trending's daily Go list, hitting the pain of lost context and babysitting when running many agents in parallel.
uses: Engineering teams running several coding agents who need one board for tasks and progress
Companies that want self-hosting and refuse to hand code and workflow to a third-party SaaS
Team leads building an issue-assign, report, review loop for AI agents
Developers already using CLIs like Claude Code and Codex who want to stop re-explaining context

zh.tag: 基于AI智能体集群的自主渗透测试工具，开源版XBOW替代方案
zh.what: 用一群AI智能体协作完成渗透测试：侦察、分类、利用、报告各司其职，通过ReAct推理串联BOLA/IDOR、JWT伪造、SSRF、注入等攻击链，并验证真实漏洞。支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和CTF三种模式。
zh.content: Go语言实现的CLI工具，内置7种以上原生安全工具，配有文档站点、演示GIF、路线图与Discord社区，当前处于alpha阶段。

zh.hot: 本月新增318星、总数2783星，登上GitHub Trending Go月榜第23名；作为闭源SaaS XBOW的开源自托管替代，切中安全圈对自主攻击AI的需求。

漏洞赏金猎人：在授权范围内自动化攻击链挖掘
红队与安全研究员：研究多智能体自主攻击与自适应评分机制
CTF选手：在比赛模式下快速尝试多种攻击路径

en.tag: Autonomous pentesting via a swarm of AI agents — an open-source XBOW alternative
en.what: Runs penetration tests with a swarm of AI agents handling recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting, chaining attacks like BOLA/IDOR, JWT forgery, SSRF, and injection via ReAct reasoning to prove real vulnerabilities. It supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes.
en.content: A Go-based CLI tool bundling 7+ native security tools, with a docs site, demo GIFs, a roadmap, and a Discord community; currently in alpha.
en.stack: Written in Go 1.24 under AGPL 3.0, with AI backends supporting Claude and local Ollama models.
en.hot: Gained 318 stars this month (2,783 total) and ranked #23 on GitHub Trending's monthly Go list; as an open, self-hosted alternative to the closed XBOW SaaS, it hits security teams' demand for autonomous offensive AI.
uses: Pentesters: speed up vulnerability discovery and exploitation validation with an AI swarm
Bug bounty hunters: automate attack-chain mining within authorized scope
Red teamers and security researchers: study multi-agent autonomous offense and adaptive scoring
CTF players: rapidly try multiple attack paths in competition mode

zh.tag: 为模型与算力提供开放可编程的决策路由层
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个面向 AI 代理的智能路由层，通过统一 API 为每次调用选择或组合最合适的模型。它根据用户策略在本地、私有与云端算力之间做决策，让代理框架专注于循环、工具与任务状态。

uses: AI 代理开发者：需要为多模型调用做统一路由与策略控制
平台/基础设施团队：希望在本地、私有与云端算力间灵活调度

en.tag: An open, programmable decision layer for models and compute
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is an intelligent routing layer for AI agents that selects or combines the best model for each call through a unified API. Guided by user policy, it decides among local, private, and cloud compute, letting agent harnesses focus on the loop, tools, and task state.

Platform/infra teams: want flexible scheduling across local, private, and cloud compute
Cost/latency-sensitive teams: dynamically pick models by quality, latency, and cost priorities
Multi-model application researchers: want to experiment with model selection and combination strategies

zh.tag: 阿里内部验证的混合架构 AI 代码审查 CLI 工具
