zh.tag: 让 Windows/Linux 也能拥有 AirPods 原生体验的桌面增强工具
zh.what: AirPodsDesktop 是一个用 C++ 编写的桌面增强程序，让 AirPods 在 Windows（以及开发中的 Linux）上获得接近苹果生态的使用体验。它提供电量显示、入耳检测、媒体播放控制和低延迟音频模式等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Qt 6 构建的桌面应用源码、资源图标与预览动图、Windows 构建说明文档，以及多语言 README（英文/简中/繁中）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 Qt 6.8.3 构建，依赖 spdlog、cxxopts、cpr 等库，支持 Windows 10 1809+ 与 Windows 11 x64。
zh.hot: 它解决了 AirPods 在 Windows 上体验残缺的痛点，3538 颗星说明跨平台用户需求强烈，今日仍登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 8 名。
uses: 在 Windows 上使用 AirPods 的用户，希望获得电量显示与入耳检测等原生功能
想要低延迟音频模式来改善游戏或影音体验的 AirPods 用户
关注 Qt/C++ 桌面开发、想学习跨平台硬件交互实现的开发者
愿意参与开源贡献、翻译或反馈问题的社区成员

en.tag: Bring native AirPods experience to Windows and Linux desktops
en.what: AirPodsDesktop is a C++ desktop enhancement program that brings an Apple-like AirPods experience to Windows (and Linux, work in progress). It offers battery display, ear detection, media playback control, and a low-latency audio mode.
en.content: The repo contains Qt 6 desktop app source code, icon and preview assets, Windows build documentation, and multilingual READMEs (English/Simplified Chinese/Traditional Chinese).
en.stack: Built mainly with C++ and Qt 6.8.3, depending on spdlog, cxxopts, cpr, and more; supports Windows 10 1809+ and Windows 11 x64.
en.hot: It solves the pain of AirPods feeling crippled on Windows; 3,538 stars show strong cross-platform demand, and it still ranks No.8 on GitHub Trending C++ daily.
uses: Windows users with AirPods who want native-like battery and ear-detection features
AirPods users seeking low-latency audio mode for gaming or media
Developers interested in Qt/C++ desktop development and cross-platform hardware interaction
Community members willing to contribute code, translations, or bug reports

zh.tag: 明日方舟全日常一键托管助手
zh.what: MAA 是一款基于图像识别技术的《明日方舟》游戏小助手，能够一键自动完成游戏内的全部日常任务，如理智作战、基建换班、自动公招等。它支持官服、B服及国际服等多个客户端，大幅减少玩家的重复操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心源码、多语言接口绑定（C、Python、Java、Rust、Golang 等）、详细的文档（VuePress 构建）以及资源文件。主要模块包括图像识别、任务调度、基建排班算法和公招识别等。
zh.stack: 项目主要使用 C++20 开发，依赖 OpenCV 进行图像处理，并借助多语言绑定（如 pybind11、JNI 等）提供跨语言接口。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: MAA 拥有超过 23.7k 的 Star 数，今日新增 27 星，并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（C++）第 9 名。其高热度源于《明日方舟》庞大的玩家群体对自动化日常任务的强烈需求，以及项目本身功能全面、持续更新。
uses: 《明日方舟》玩家：希望自动化完成日常任务，节省时间。
开发者：通过多语言接口集成 MAA 功能到自己的工具中。
游戏社区贡献者：参与图像识别算法优化或文档翻译。
多开玩家：同时管理多个游戏账号，提高效率。

en.tag: One-click daily task automation for Arknights
en.what: MAA is an image-recognition-based assistant for the game Arknights that automates all daily tasks with one click, including sanity farming, base management, and recruitment. It supports multiple clients such as the official, Bilibili, and international servers, significantly reducing repetitive player actions.
en.content: The repository contains the C++ core source code, multi-language API bindings (C, Python, Java, Rust, Golang, etc.), comprehensive documentation built with VuePress, and resource files. Key modules include image recognition, task scheduling, base scheduling algorithms, and recruitment recognition.
en.stack: The project is primarily developed in C++20, relies on OpenCV for image processing, and provides cross-language interfaces through bindings (e.g., pybind11, JNI). It supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.hot: MAA has over 23.7k stars, with 27 new stars today, and ranks 9th on GitHub Trending (C++) daily list. Its popularity stems from the strong demand among Arknights players for automating daily tasks, combined with its comprehensive features and active development.
uses: Arknights players: looking to automate daily tasks and save time.
Developers: integrating MAA features into their own tools via multi-language APIs.
Community contributors: participating in image recognition optimization or documentation translation.
Multi-account players: managing multiple game accounts efficiently.

zh.tag: 把 PS2 ELF 静态重编译成 C++ 并附带运行时的实验性工具
zh.what: PS2Recomp 是一个实验性的 PlayStation 2 静态重编译器与运行时工具，目标是让 PS2 游戏无需模拟器即可编译成原生 PC 版本。它解析 PS2 ELF 文件，把 MIPS R5900 指令逐条翻译成等价的 C++ 代码，再由配套运行时执行。
zh.content: 仓库由四个模块组成：ps2xAnalyzer 扫描 ELF 与函数并生成 TOML 配置，ps2xRecomp 解码 R5900 指令并生成 C++，ps2xRuntime 负责内存、函数注册、syscall 分发与硬件桩，ps2xIOP 处理 R3000A IRX 与虚拟 IOP 内核。
zh.stack: 使用 C++20 编写，构建依赖 CMake 3.20+，部分向量路径需要 SSE4/AVX 主机支持，目前主要在 MSVC 上测试，并配套 Ghidra 导出脚本。
zh.hot: 项目已积累 3432 颗星，今日新增 28 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 第 10 名，说明 PS2 原生移植这一小众但硬核的方向正吸引大量关注。
uses: 对 PS2 游戏原生移植与逆向工程感兴趣的研究者与爱好者
希望研究静态重编译与 MIPS R5900 指令翻译的技术开发者
想用 Ghidra 配合 TOML 配置为具体游戏做适配的 mod 制作者

en.tag: Experimental static recompiler that turns PS2 ELF binaries into C++ with a runtime
en.what: PS2Recomp is an experimental PlayStation 2 static recompiler and runtime tool aimed at producing native PC ports without a traditional emulator. It parses PS2 ELF files and translates MIPS R5900 instructions one-by-one into equivalent C++ code, which is then executed by a bundled runtime.
en.content: The repo is split into four modules: ps2xAnalyzer scans ELF files and functions to emit TOML config, ps2xRecomp decodes R5900 instructions and generates C++, ps2xRuntime hosts memory, function registration, syscall dispatch and hardware stubs, and ps2xIOP handles R3000A IRX execution plus a virtual IOP kernel.
en.stack: Written in C++20 with CMake 3.20+ as the build system, some vector paths require SSE4/AVX host support, currently tested mainly with MSVC, and it ships with a Ghidra export script.
en.hot: With 3,432 stars and 28 added today, it ranks 10th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list, showing strong interest in the niche but hardcore field of native PS2 porting.
uses: Researchers and hobbyists interested in native PS2 game porting and reverse engineering
Developers studying static recompilation and MIPS R5900 instruction translation
Modders who want to use Ghidra with TOML configs to adapt specific games

zh.tag: 将PS5可执行文件自动移植到Linux和Windows的工具
zh.what: AnyPS5 是一个将 PS5 可执行文件自动转换为 Linux 和 Windows 原生格式的工具。它通过重链接器和系统库实现动态链接，无需模拟器或独立运行时进程。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心重链接器（core/relinker）、系统 prx 库实现（core/libs/prx）、着色器重编译器（core/shader/recompiler）以及用户和开发者文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SDL 进行输入映射，并可选使用 SPIRV-Tools 验证着色器。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 2716 颗星，总星数达 11599，登上 GitHub 日榜第三名，因其创新的 PS5 游戏移植方案而备受关注。
uses: 游戏移植开发者和研究者，用于将 PS5 游戏移植到 PC 平台
游戏保存和兼容性爱好者，用于在 PC 上运行 PS5 游戏
技术研究人员，用于学习可执行文件转换和动态链接技术

en.tag: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
en.what: AnyPS5 is a tool that automatically converts PS5 executables to native formats for Linux and Windows. It uses a relinker and system library implementations for dynamic linking, with no emulation or separate runtime process.
en.content: The repository includes a core relinker (core/relinker), system prx library implementations (core/libs/prx), a shader recompiler (core/shader/recompiler), and user and developer documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on SDL for input mapping and optionally uses SPIRV-Tools for shader validation.
en.hot: With 2,716 stars added today and a total of 11,599 stars, it ranks 3rd on GitHub Trending daily, attracting attention for its innovative PS5 game porting approach.
uses: Game porting developers and researchers for porting PS5 games to PC
Game preservation and compatibility enthusiasts for running PS5 games on PC
Technical researchers for studying executable conversion and dynamic linking

zh.tag: 来自 Matt Pocock 的日常工程代理技能集，小而可组合
zh.what: 这是 Matt Pocock 从自己 .agents 目录中整理出的代理技能（skills）集合，面向真实工程开发而非“氛围编程”。它刻意做得小巧、易改、可组合，兼容任意模型，并基于多年工程经验。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本和技能文件为主，包含可直接安装的 skill 定义、ADR 决策记录（如以 Claude Code 插件形式发布）以及配套安装说明。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主要语言，通过 Claude Code 插件市场或 npx skills 安装，可接入 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理。
zh.hot: 今日新增 876 star、总 star 超 27 万并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 9，反映开发者对可控、可改的代理技能方案需求旺盛。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理的工程师，希望用可组合技能提升日常开发效率
对 GSD、BMAD、Spec-Kit 等重流程方案不满，想要保留控制权的开发者
喜欢 fork 和魔改工具链、把技能变成自己资产的技术玩家

en.tag: Matt Pocock's daily agent skills: small, composable, real engineering
en.what: A collection of agent skills pulled straight from Matt Pocock's own .agents directory, aimed at real engineering rather than vibe coding. They are deliberately small, easy to adapt, composable, and model-agnostic, grounded in decades of engineering experience.
en.content: The repo is mostly Shell scripts and skill files, including installable skill definitions, ADRs (such as shipping as a Claude Code plugin), and setup docs.
en.stack: Shell is the main language; installs via the Claude Code plugin marketplace or npx skills, and works with Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents.
en.hot: With 876 stars added today, over 273k total, and a #9 spot on GitHub Trending daily, it shows strong demand for controllable, hackable agent skills.
uses: Engineers using Claude Code, Codex, or similar coding agents who want composable skills for daily work
Developers frustrated with heavy process frameworks like GSD, BMAD, or Spec-Kit and wanting to keep control
Tinkerers who like to fork and customize tooling, making the skills their own

zh.tag: 用自然语言驱动 Web 与移动端应用的 AI 端到端测试框架
zh.what: e2e 是一个面向 Web 和移动应用的端到端测试框架。你只需用自然语言描述目标，AI 代理就会自动操作应用完成该目标，并可在同一测试中用定位器和断言校验结果。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SDK、运行器与 CLI 主包 e2e，以及 @e2e-dev/web（基于 Playwright 的浏览器引擎）和 @e2e-dev/mobile 等子包，并提供 Vite、Next.js、Astro、Expo、SwiftUI、Flutter 等示例项目。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 编写，通过 npm 分发，浏览器引擎基于 Playwright 驱动 Chromium、Firefox 与 WebKit，模型侧支持自带订阅、API Key 或本地模型。
zh.hot: 本周新增 6564 颗 star，总量达 8734，冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 13 名；AI 代理自动生成并回放测试的玩法切中了测试自动化的痛点。
uses: 前端与移动端 QA 工程师，希望用自然语言快速编写稳定的端到端测试
需要覆盖 Web 与移动多端的团队，可复用同一套测试与断言写法
想降低模型调用成本、让代理步骤可回放的工程团队
正在评估 AI 测试工具链、关注 Playwright 生态的开发者

en.tag: AI-driven end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps
en.what: e2e is an end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps. You describe a goal in natural language and an agent drives the app to reach it, while locators and assertions in the same test verify the result.
en.content: The repo ships the main e2e SDK, runner and CLI, plus sub-packages like @e2e-dev/web (Playwright-based browser engine) and @e2e-dev/mobile, along with example projects for Vite, Next.js, Astro, Expo, SwiftUI and Flutter.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript and distributed via npm, it uses Playwright to drive Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, and supports bring-your-own subscription, API key or local model.
en.hot: It gained 6,564 stars this week for a total of 8,734, landing at #13 on GitHub Trending weekly; its AI-agent test generation and replay taps a real pain point in test automation.
uses: QA engineers who want to write stable e2e tests quickly in natural language
Teams covering both web and mobile that can reuse one test and assertion style
Engineering teams wanting replayable agent steps to cut model-call costs
Developers evaluating AI testing tooling and following the Playwright ecosystem

zh.tag: Epic Games 出品的原生多进程图形调试器，自带 RDI 调试信息格式与 RAD 链接器
zh.what: RAD Debugger 是一个原生、用户态、支持多进程的图形化调试器，目前仅支持本地 Windows x64 + PDB 调试，未来计划扩展到 Linux 与 DWARF。除调试器本体外，项目还包含自定义的 RAD Debug Info（RDI）格式和面向超大工程的 RAD Linker。
zh.content: 仓库以 C 源码为主，核心包括 src/lib_rdi（RDI 格式定义与解析）、src/lib_rdi_make（RDI 构造与序列化库）以及 radbin 工具，可把 PDB 等原生调试信息转换为 RDI 并输出文本转储。
zh.stack: 使用 C 语言编写，依赖 Windows x64 平台与 PDB 调试信息，构建产物包含调试器可执行文件与 radbin 工具，RAD Linker 面向 x64 PE/COFF 二进制。
zh.hot: 作为 Epic Games 开源的调试器项目，它直击大型工程调试与链接性能痛点，已积累约 7940 star，今日新增 90 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 7 名。
uses: Windows 平台 C/C++ 开发者，需要多进程图形化调试体验
处理超大可执行文件、被 PDB 32 位表溢出困扰的工程团队
对调试信息格式（RDI/DWARF/PDB）与链接器实现感兴趣的工具链研究者
希望参与 ALPHA 阶段项目、提交 issue 与复现用例的开源贡献者

en.tag: Epic Games' native, multi-process graphical debugger with its own RDI debug info format and RAD linker
en.what: RAD Debugger is a native, user-mode, multi-process graphical debugger, currently limited to local-machine Windows x64 debugging with PDBs, with Linux and DWARF support planned. Beyond the debugger itself, the project also ships a custom RAD Debug Info (RDI) format and the RAD Linker for very large projects.
en.content: The repo is mostly C source, centered on src/lib_rdi (RDI format definition and parsing), src/lib_rdi_make (an in-progress RDI construction/serialization library), and the radbin utility that converts native debug info such as PDB into RDI and dumps it as text.
en.stack: Written in C, it targets Windows x64 with PDB debug info; build outputs include the debugger executable and the radbin utility, while RAD Linker targets x64 PE/COFF binaries.
en.hot: As an Epic Games open-source debugger, it targets real pain points in large-project debugging and linking, with roughly 7,940 stars, 90 added today, and a #7 spot on GitHub Trending's daily list.
uses: Windows C/C++ developers who want a multi-process graphical debugging experience
Teams with huge executables suffering from PDB 32-bit table overflows
Toolchain researchers interested in debug info formats (RDI/DWARF/PDB) and linker internals
Open-source contributors willing to file issues and repro cases for an ALPHA-stage project

zh.tag: 为各类 AI 代理提供跨会话持久记忆与上下文注入
zh.what: claude-mem 是一个为 AI 编码代理提供持久化记忆的中间层：它会捕获代理在会话中的所有操作，用 AI 压缩成精炼记忆，并在后续会话中自动注入相关上下文。支持 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等多种代理。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现，包含会话捕获、AI 压缩、记忆存储与上下文注入等模块，并提供面向多种代理的适配与配置。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js 生态，需接入 AI 模型进行摘要压缩，并针对不同代理提供集成适配层。
zh.hot: 今日新增 578 star、总数近 9.8 万并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8，说明「让代理记住上下文」是当前 AI 编码工具链的刚需痛点。
uses: 长期使用 Claude Code 等代理、希望避免重复交代背景的开发者
需要跨会话延续项目上下文的 AI 编码工作流用户
想为自研代理接入记忆层、减少重复提示的工程团队
研究代理记忆与上下文压缩机制的技术爱好者

en.tag: Persistent cross-session memory and context injection for AI agents
en.what: claude-mem is a persistent memory layer for AI coding agents: it captures everything an agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. It works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode and more.
en.content: Implemented in TypeScript, the repo contains modules for session capture, AI compression, memory storage, and context injection, plus adapters and configuration for multiple agents.
en.stack: Primary language is TypeScript on the Node.js ecosystem; it relies on AI models for summarization and provides integration adapters for different agents.
en.hot: With 578 stars added today, nearly 98k total, and a #8 spot on GitHub Trending daily, it shows that 'making agents remember context' is a pressing need in today's AI coding toolchain.
uses: Developers using Claude Code and similar agents who want to avoid re-explaining context
Users of AI coding workflows that need project context to persist across sessions
Engineering teams adding a memory layer to custom agents to cut repeated prompting
Enthusiasts studying agent memory and context-compression mechanisms

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与插件集合
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方维护的插件规范与插件仓库，定义了 agent 插件如何以独立目录加 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单的形式组织。仓库同时收录了一批面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的官方插件，覆盖代码审查、任务编排、学习记忆等场景。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件是一个独立目录，各自带有 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单，README 用表格列出插件名、作者、分类与描述。已收录 teaching、continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、thermos、create-plugin、ralph-loop、orchestrate、pstack、advisor、grok-voice 等十余个插件。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，插件以清单文件加目录结构的形式分发，部分插件依赖 Cursor SDK 与 CLI 能力。整体是围绕 Cursor agent 生态的插件化扩展方案。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4683 star，总 star 达 7254，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 3 名。Cursor 官方亲自下场定义插件规范，加上 agent 工具链正处风口，让开发者迅速涌入关注。
uses: Cursor 深度用户：想用官方插件扩展 agent 的代码审查、编排与学习能力
插件开发者：需要遵循官方规范脚手架并发布自己的 agent 插件
团队工程负责人：关注 CI、代码评审与本地自动化的内部工作流插件
AI 工具链研究者：想了解 agent 插件规范与生态的组织方式

en.tag: Cursor plugin spec and official plugin collection
en.what: This is Cursor's official plugin specification and plugin collection, defining how agent plugins are structured as standalone directories with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest. It also ships a set of official plugins for popular developer tools, frameworks, and SaaS products, covering code review, task orchestration, and learning memory.
en.content: Each plugin lives in its own directory at the repo root with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest, and the README tabulates name, author, category, and description. It already includes a dozen-plus plugins such as teaching, continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, thermos, create-plugin, ralph-loop, orchestrate, pstack, advisor, and grok-voice.
en.stack: The primary language is TypeScript, and plugins are distributed as manifest files plus directory structures, with some relying on the Cursor SDK and CLI capabilities. Overall it is a plugin-based extension scheme around the Cursor agent ecosystem.
en.hot: It gained 4,683 stars this month for a total of 7,254, reaching No. 3 on GitHub Trending's monthly chart. Cursor itself stepping in to define the plugin spec, amid the agent tooling boom, quickly drew developer attention.
uses: Heavy Cursor users: extend agent code review, orchestration, and learning via official plugins
Plugin developers: scaffold and publish their own agent plugins following the official spec
Team engineering leads: interested in internal workflow plugins for CI, code review, and local automation
AI tooling researchers: want to understand how agent plugin specs and ecosystems are organized

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理获得本地 CAD 建模与制造能力
zh.what: text-to-cad 是一个为 AI 代理提供本地 CAD 工作流的插件，能将文本描述转化为 STEP、GLB、STL 或 3MF 格式的 3D 模型。它还支持可制造性设计检查、生成工程图纸，并连接主流的 3D 打印、钣金和 CNC 加工服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Python 包 cadgen（已发布到 PyPI）和配套的文档应用（apps/docs），提供代理插件/技能定义、CAD 生成与检查逻辑，以及安装和使用指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11+，依赖 build123d 0.11 和 Open CASCADE 7.9 进行几何建模，通过 uv 运行；文档部分使用 Node.js 20+。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models without expensive post-training
en.what: Heretic is a tool that automatically removes censorship (aka 'safety alignment') from transformer-based language models. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to find high-quality ablation parameters, minimizing refusals while preserving the original model's intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains Python source code, a command-line tool, configuration files, and example scripts for automating the abliteration process. It also includes tools for publishing models to Hugging Face and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, it depends on PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna, and supports most dense models, multimodal models, and MoE architectures.
en.hot: With 33,960 stars and 1,287 new stars this week, ranking 12th on the Python weekly trending list, it's popular for automatically and efficiently removing model censorship without expensive training.
uses: AI researchers and developers — need to remove model censorship for safety research or building unrestricted applications.

zh.content: 仓库以 Python 实现，包含智能体建模、数字世界构建与预测报告生成等核心模块，并提供 Docker 部署、中英文双语文档、Discord/X/Instagram 社区入口与 DeepWiki 文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，支持 Docker 构建部署，依赖多智能体仿真与大模型推理能力，并配有 Discord 社区与 DeepWiki 文档支持。
zh.hot: 以「群体智能预测万物」的宏大叙事和可交互数字沙盘概念吸引关注，本周新增 1861 star，累计 77475 star，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜 Python 第 12 名。
uses: 政策与公关团队：在零风险数字沙盘中预演舆情与政策效果
金融与投资研究者：从市场信号推演未来走势与风险情景
AI 智能体开发者：研究多智能体社会演化与群体涌现机制
科幻与叙事创作者：上传故事设定，生成可交互的平行世界

en.tag: A multi-agent swarm intelligence engine that rehearses the future in a digital sandbox
en.what: MiroFish is a general-purpose prediction engine built on multi-agent technology. It extracts seed information from real-world material such as breaking news, policy drafts, or financial signals, then automatically constructs a high-fidelity parallel digital world where thousands of agents with independent personalities, long-term memory, and behavioral logic interact and socially evolve. Users can inject variables from a god's-eye view to deduce future trajectories and receive prediction reports.
en.content: Implemented in Python, the repo contains core modules for agent modeling, digital-world construction, and prediction report generation, plus Docker deployment, bilingual docs, Discord/X/Instagram community links, and DeepWiki documentation.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, with Docker-based build and deployment, relying on multi-agent simulation and LLM reasoning, backed by a Discord community and DeepWiki docs.
en.hot: Its grand vision of "predicting anything with swarm intelligence" and an interactive digital sandbox concept draw attention, adding 1,861 stars this week for 77,475 total and ranking 12th on GitHub Trending's weekly Python chart.
uses: Policy and PR teams: rehearse public-opinion and policy outcomes at zero risk in a digital sandbox
Finance and investment researchers: deduce market trends and risk scenarios from signals
AI agent developers: study multi-agent social evolution and collective emergence
Sci-fi and narrative creators: upload story settings to generate interactive parallel worlds

zh.tag: 跨平台 AI 编码代理控制台，手机也能遥控本机 Agent
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个「Agent 控制台」，让你用手机、网页或桌面应用远程操控本机已安装的编码代理。它兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Grok Build、OpenCode 和 Google Antigravity，只要这些工具在本机配置好就能被接管。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 安装脚本、本地服务端、Web 应用、Electron 桌面端，以及 iOS/Android 移动端配套，另有 AUR 等打包目录。

想自托管、可 fork 定制编辑器体验的团队
对 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 工作流已熟悉的重度用户

en.tag: A cross-platform control surface for AI coding agents on your machine
en.what: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface" that lets you drive the coding agents installed on your machine from a mobile app, web app, or Electron desktop app. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Google Antigravity as long as they're set up locally.
en.content: The repo ships a CLI installer, a local server, a web app, an Electron desktop client, companion iOS/Android apps, plus packaging directories such as AUR.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built around a Node server with web/Electron frontends that hook into each agent's local CLI login.
en.hot: It raced to 26.2k stars shortly after launch and added 241 today, riding its pitch of one interface for every coding agent plus a truly forkable open codebase.
uses: Developers juggling multiple coding agents who want one unified entry point
People who need to check in on and steer agent tasks from phone or tablet
Teams that want a self-hosted, forkable editor experience
Heavy users already comfortable with Claude Code, Codex, and similar CLI workflows

zh.tag: 把 Claude Code 与 Codex 编排成一支持久化多智能体团队的 harness 管理框架
zh.what: OpenRig 是一个多智能体编排框架，用 YAML 定义你的智能体团队，一条命令即可启动。它把 Claude Code 和 Codex 放进同一个 rig 里统一管理，让你与 lead agent 对话，由它协调各团队专家并汇总结果与待决策事项。
zh.content: 仓库包含 npm 包 @openrig/cli、TUI 界面（以图/表格展示各 seat 的运行时、模型、上下文与状态）、YAML 团队配置、docs 参考文档（getting-started、help 等）以及 README 演示动图。

zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6，单日新增 737 star、总数达 2448，说明开发者对「把多个编码 agent 编成团队」这一痛点需求强烈。
uses: 同时使用 Claude Code 与 Codex 的开发者，希望统一编排而非开一堆终端会话
需要多智能体协作完成仓库级改动的团队与个人工程师
想用 YAML 声明式管理 agent 团队、关注上下文持久化的进阶用户
在 macOS/Linux 上做 AI 编码工作流实验、愿意接受早期工具折腾成本的探索者

en.tag: A multi-agent harness that runs Claude Code and Codex together as one persistent team
en.what: OpenRig is a multi-agent orchestration harness: define your agent team in YAML and boot it with one command. It runs Claude Code and Codex inside the same rig as a single system, letting you talk to a lead agent that coordinates specialists and surfaces results and decisions.
en.content: The repo ships the @openrig/cli npm package, a TUI that renders rigs as graphs and seat tables with runtime, model, context and state, YAML team configs, reference docs (getting-started, help) and README demo GIFs.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, runs on Node.js 22/24 with tmux, installable via npm or Bun, uses SQLite for state checks, and currently supports only macOS and Linux.
en.hot: It hit #6 on GitHub Trending with 737 stars in a single day and 2,448 total, showing strong demand for turning multiple coding agents into an organized team.
uses: Developers using both Claude Code and Codex who want unified orchestration instead of scattered terminal sessions
Teams and solo engineers needing multi-agent collaboration on repository-level changes
Advanced users who want declarative YAML agent teams with persistent context
macOS/Linux experimenters exploring AI coding workflows who accept early-stage tooling friction

Content creators: make gameplay videos with OBS overlays and custom styles
Developers: build on React + Tauri or write plugins/CSS themes

团队需要批量生成个性化营销或数据视频

en.tag: A framework for making videos programmatically with React
en.what: Remotion lets you define every frame of a video using React components, treating code as the single source of truth. It supports agentic video creation, interactive drag-and-drop editing, and data-connected batch rendering.

Teams needing to batch-generate personalized marketing or data videos
Creators using AI coding agents to produce videos quickly
Companies building custom video editors or design-system asset libraries

en.what: InvokeAI is a creative engine for Stable Diffusion models, letting professionals, artists, and enthusiasts generate and iterate on visual media. It offers an industry-leading local WebUI and serves as the foundation for multiple commercial products.

Obsidian users who want to turn their vault into an AI memory hub
Engineers who want to stop re-explaining context and let AI collaboration knowledge compound

en.tag: A local-first AI agent running open-weight models on your own machine via llama.cpp
en.what: Atomic Agent is a local-first AI agent whose control loop and all state live on your machine. It drives your browser, reads and edits files, runs approved shell commands, remembers context across sessions, and calls external tools over MCP.

安全审计人员，需在本地快速检索敏感数据而不外传
已有 Elasticsearch 客户端、想零改造接入本地搜索的工程师

en.tag: Local autoindexed search for AI agents, 40x fewer tokens than grep
en.what: XERJ is a local AI search engine that indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs with a single command for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory. It is Elasticsearch-compatible so existing clients just work, letting coding agents stop reading files one by one and wasting tokens.
en.content: The repo centers on a single static Rust binary with a CLI, autoindex pipeline, BM25+kNN hybrid retrieval, native MCP interface and a /__memory agent-memory module, plus benchmarks, case studies and user-feedback folders.
en.stack: Built in Rust with no JVM, offline lexical embedder by default and an opt-in ~90MB neural embedder; it is Elasticsearch API-compatible and natively supports MCP and llms.txt.
en.hot: It gained 1,041 stars this week for 3,693 total, ranking #4 on GitHub Trending's weekly Rust list; its token-saving agent-search pitch hits the cost pain of AI coding, with a case study showing 2.7x fewer output tokens.
uses: AI coding agent developers who want to cut token use from reading files one by one
Teams needing local RAG or agent memory over code, logs and PDFs
Security auditors who must search sensitive data locally without sending it out
Engineers with existing Elasticsearch clients who want local search with zero changes

zh.tag: 面向端侧部署的高性能 AI 推理引擎
zh.what: uzu 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能 AI 模型推理引擎，目标是让开发者把模型直接部署进 App，实现零延迟、数据不出端、无推理成本。它提供统一的高层 API 和模型配置，并支持 Apple 设备的统一内存。

zh.hot: 本周新增 321 star、总数达 2153，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 13 名，反映出端侧推理与隐私优先 AI 部署正成为开发者关注热点。
uses: 想在移动端或桌面 App 内本地运行大模型的开发者
关注数据隐私、不愿把用户数据发往云端的团队
需要零延迟、无按次推理成本 AI 能力的应用场景
希望用 Rust 构建高性能推理服务的工程师

en.tag: A high-performance inference engine for on-device AI deployment
en.what: uzu is a high-performance AI inference engine written in Rust that lets developers deploy models directly inside their apps with zero latency, full data privacy, and no inference costs. It offers a simple high-level API, unified model configurations, and leverages unified memory on Apple devices.

Teams prioritizing data privacy and avoiding cloud data transfer
Apps needing zero-latency AI with no per-inference cost
Engineers building high-performance inference services in Rust

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的经典 Photoshop 风格桌面图像编辑器，原生支持 PSD/PSB
zh.what: PhotoSuite 是一款原生桌面图像编辑器，界面与操作逻辑致敬经典 Adobe Photoshop，并原生读写 PSD/PSB 文件。目标是实现与 Photoshop 之间完整的 PSD 往返编辑，包括图层效果与智能对象/滤镜，目前仍在开发中。

希望参与开源图像编辑器、贡献工具与滤镜功能的贡献者

en.tag: A Rust-written desktop image editor faithful to classic Photoshop, with native PSD/PSB support
en.what: PhotoSuite is a native desktop image editor that mirrors classic Adobe Photoshop's workflow and natively reads and writes PSD/PSB files. It aims for full Photoshop-to-PhotoSuite PSD round trips, including layer effects and smart objects/filters, and is still a work in progress.

Developers needing to read/write PSD/PSB, who can study its PSD parsing and compositing code
Engineers curious about Rust desktop GUI, image-processing engines and cross-platform packaging
Contributors wanting to help build tools and filters for an open-source image editor

en.tag: A lightweight open-source agent harness in Rust, pluggable into any LLM or memory
en.what: OpenHuman is an open-source agent harness that bills itself as the fastest, cheapest and most efficient option. Its core is written in Rust, keeping it lightweight and modular, and it plugs into whatever LLM, memory or search engine you already run.

zh.what: Bevy 是一个用 Rust 编写的免费开源游戏引擎，采用数据驱动的实体组件系统（ECS）架构，提供完整的 2D 和 3D 功能。它设计简单易用，同时具备高度模块化和并行性能。

独立游戏团队寻找开源、可定制的游戏引擎

en.what: Bevy is a free and open-source game engine built in Rust, featuring a data-driven Entity Component System (ECS) architecture with full 2D and 3D capabilities. It is designed to be simple for newcomers yet infinitely flexible and fast.

zh.what: Koharu 是一个用 Rust 构建的漫画翻译工具，结合目标检测、OCR、图像修复和 LLM 实现从识别到翻译再到排版的自动化流程。所有视觉模型和语言模型都在本地运行，保护用户数据隐私。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码、多语言文档（英/日/中）、安装指南、模型配置说明以及基于 WebGPU 的画布编辑器。支持项目化管理、选择性处理流水线、校对审阅和分层 PSD 导出。
zh.stack: 核心使用 Rust 编写，集成 WebGPU 画布、本地 GGUF 推理、多模态 OCR 模型和生成式修复模型，同时支持托管 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 凭借本地优先的隐私保护、Rust 的高性能和完整的漫画翻译工作流，Koharu 在 GitHub 上获得 6030 星，本周新增 306 星，登上 Rust 周榜第 11 名。

注重隐私的用户，希望所有 OCR 和翻译在本地完成
Rust 和 AI 开发者，研究多模态模型在漫画领域的落地
需要处理 PDF、压缩包等多格式漫画项目的团队

en.tag: Local-first ML-powered manga translator written in Rust
en.what: Koharu is a manga translation tool built in Rust that combines object detection, OCR, inpainting, and LLMs to automate the full translation pipeline. It runs all vision models and LLMs locally to keep user data private and secure.

en.stack: Built primarily in Rust, integrating a WebGPU canvas, local GGUF inference, multimodal OCR models, and generative inpainting models, with optional hosted LLM providers.
en.hot: With its local-first privacy, Rust performance, and complete manga translation workflow, Koharu has earned 6,030 stars, adding 306 this week and ranking 11th on the Rust weekly trending list.

Privacy-conscious users who want all OCR and translation done locally
Rust and AI developers exploring multimodal models for manga
Teams handling multi-format manga projects like PDFs and archives

zh.tag: Rust 编写的开源跨平台文件浏览器，用虚拟分布式文件系统统一管理多设备存储
zh.what: Spacedrive 把用户自己掌控的硬盘、服务器、移动设备和云盘整合成一个私有文件系统，让文件不必存放在别人的服务器上也能被搜索、访问和共享。它提供跨设备浏览、备份状态查看、历史版本恢复和按自己规则分享等能力，全程无托管账号、无厂商控制面、无遥测。

需要跨设备搜索、备份状态查看和历史版本恢复的开发者或家庭用户
想基于 Rust 虚拟分布式文件系统做二次开发或集成的工程师

en.tag: An open-source cross-platform file explorer powered by a virtual distributed filesystem in Rust
en.what: Spacedrive unifies the drives, servers, devices, and clouds you control into one private filesystem, so your files can stay useful without living on someone else's computer. It offers cross-device browsing, backup awareness, history recovery, and sharing on your own terms, with no hosted account, vendor control plane, or telemetry.
en.content: The repo contains a desktop app built from a Rust core and TypeScript frontend, plus nightly CLI and daemon builds; the README shows cross-device file browsing screenshots and links to docs.spacedrive.com and Discord.
en.stack: The core virtual distributed filesystem is written in Rust with a TypeScript UI layer, licensed under Apache-2.0, and ships nightly CLI/daemon builds.
en.hot: With about 39k stars and 98 added this week, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending's Rust weekly list, showing steady interest in data sovereignty and self-hosted storage.
uses: Self-hosters who want to unify multiple devices, drives, and clouds into one private filesystem
Privacy-conscious users who don't want personal files on cloud vendors' computers
Developers or families needing cross-device search, backup awareness, and history recovery
Engineers wanting to build on or integrate the Rust virtual distributed filesystem

zh.tag: 跨 50+ 编程工具统一管理 AI 代理技能库的桌面应用
zh.what: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于集中管理、同步和整理 AI 代理技能（skills）。它把散落在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 多种工具里的技能统一到一个中央库中，并支持跨设备备份与同步。

uses: 同时使用多个 AI 编程工具的开发者，想统一管理散落的技能

想从市场发现并一键安装热门技能的 AI 代理使用者
希望让代理自动安装、部署技能到其他工具的进阶用户

en.tag: A desktop app to manage AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools
en.what: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app for managing, syncing, and organizing AI agent skills. It consolidates skills scattered across 50+ tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini CLI into one central library with backup and multi-device sync.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust desktop app source plus UI demos for the Library, Marketplace, Global/Agent/Project Workspaces, backup & sync, and settings, with the default skill library at ~/.skills-manager.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust as a cross-platform desktop app; it pulls skills from Git repos, local folders, .zip/.skill archives, and the skills.sh marketplace.
en.hot: It has quickly gained 5,739 stars with 56 added today, ranking #5 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily, hitting the pain point of fragmented skill management across many tools.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding tools who want one place to manage scattered skills
Users who need to sync and back up AI agent skill configs across devices
AI agent users who want to discover and one-click install popular skills from a marketplace
Advanced users who want agents to auto-install and deploy skills to other tools

zh.tag: 微软开源的跨平台沙箱代码执行系统，策略驱动分层隔离
zh.what: MXC 是一个用于在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上安全运行不可信代码（如模型输出、插件和工具）的沙箱执行系统。它通过统一的容器模型和类型化 SDK，提供从操作系统原生进程沙箱到完整虚拟机的多种隔离后端。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心引擎、多语言 SDK（Rust/.NET/Node）、各平台后端实现（ProcessContainer、Windows Sandbox、LXC、Bubblewrap、Seatbelt、MicroVM 等）以及文档和诊断工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 Rust、.NET 和 Node.js SDK；依赖各平台原生隔离机制（如 Windows 作业对象、Linux 命名空间、macOS Seatbelt）及可选虚拟化后端。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方开源的沙箱项目，它解决了 AI 时代运行不可信代码的安全痛点，今日新增 135 星，登上 GitHub Rust 日榜第 3 名。
uses: AI 应用开发者 —— 安全执行模型生成的代码或插件
平台工程师 —— 在 CI/CD 或云环境中隔离不可信工作负载
安全研究人员 —— 分析恶意软件或测试隔离策略
工具链构建者 —— 为应用集成跨平台沙箱执行能力

en.tag: Microsoft's cross-platform sandboxed code execution system with policy-driven layered isolation
en.what: MXC is a sandboxed code execution system for safely running untrusted code (such as model output, plugins, and tools) on Windows, Linux, and macOS. It offers multiple containment backends, from OS-native process sandboxes to full VMs, behind a unified containment model and typed SDKs.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core engine, multi-language SDKs (Rust/.NET/Node), platform-specific backend implementations (ProcessContainer, Windows Sandbox, LXC, Bubblewrap, Seatbelt, MicroVM, etc.), plus documentation and diagnostic tools.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with SDKs for Rust, .NET, and Node.js; it relies on platform-native isolation mechanisms (e.g., Windows Job Objects, Linux namespaces, macOS Seatbelt) and optional virtualization backends.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official open-source sandbox project, it addresses the security pain point of running untrusted code in the AI era, gaining 135 stars today and ranking 3rd on GitHub's daily Rust trending list.
uses: AI application developers — safely execute model-generated code or plugins
Platform engineers — isolate untrusted workloads in CI/CD or cloud environments
Security researchers — analyze malware or test isolation policies
Toolchain builders — integrate cross-platform sandboxed execution into apps

zh.tag: 默认开启 HTTPS 的快速可扩展多平台 Web 服务器
zh.what: Caddy 是一个用 Go 编写的开源 Web 服务器与服务器平台，支持 HTTP/1、HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3。它最大的特点是默认自动为站点申请并续期 TLS 证书，让「每个站点都上 HTTPS」变得开箱即用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Caddy 核心服务器代码、模块化插件体系、命令行工具，以及大量文档与示例配置；采用 Apache-2.0 许可，由 CertMagic 提供证书自动化能力。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，核心依赖包括 CertMagic（自动 HTTPS）、quic-go（HTTP/3）等；以单一静态二进制分发，跨平台运行，配置可用 Caddyfile 或原生 JSON。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 上最受欢迎的 Go Web 服务器之一，Caddy 已积累 77,499 颗星，今日再增 93 星并登上 Go 日榜第一，说明「自动 HTTPS + 简洁配置」的刚需持续吸引开发者。
uses: 运维与后端开发者：快速部署带 HTTPS 的网站或 API 服务
个人开发者与自托管爱好者：用极简配置托管个人站点和反代
需要 HTTP/3 或自动证书管理的团队：替代 Nginx/Apache 的现代方案
学习 Go 与网络服务器架构的工程师：阅读模块化服务器实现

en.tag: Fast, extensible multi-platform web server with automatic HTTPS by default
en.what: Caddy is an open-source web server and server platform written in Go, supporting HTTP/1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3. Its standout feature is automatic TLS certificate issuance and renewal by default, making HTTPS the zero-config norm for every site.
en.content: The repo contains the core Caddy server, its modular plugin system, the CLI tool, plus extensive docs and example configs; it is Apache-2.0 licensed and relies on CertMagic for certificate automation.
en.stack: Written in Go, with key dependencies like CertMagic (automatic HTTPS) and quic-go (HTTP/3); it ships as a single static binary, runs cross-platform, and is configured via Caddyfile or native JSON.
en.hot: As one of the most popular Go web servers on GitHub, Caddy has reached 77,499 stars, gaining 93 more today and topping the Go daily trending list — proof that 'automatic HTTPS plus simple config' remains a strong draw.
uses: DevOps and backend developers: quickly deploy HTTPS-enabled sites or APIs
Indie developers and self-hosters: host personal sites and reverse proxies with minimal config
Teams needing HTTP/3 or automatic cert management: a modern Nginx/Apache alternative
Engineers studying Go and server architecture: read a modular server implementation

zh.tag: Docker 官方出品的 YAML 声明式 AI Agent 构建与运行工具
zh.what: docker-agent 让你用 YAML 声明式配置创建并运行可协作的 AI 智能体，无需写代码即可完成复杂任务。它作为 docker CLI 插件运行，支持多智能体编排、丰富的工具生态和多种模型提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 插件源码、examples/ 示例目录、docs/ 文档与演示 GIF，以及用于打包分享 Agent 的 OCI 注册表集成。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，作为 docker CLI 插件分发；支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、AWS Bedrock、Mistral、xAI 及 Docker Model Runner，并集成 MCP 工具与 BM25/向量混合检索 RAG。
zh.hot: 作为 Docker 工程团队官方项目，它把 Agent 构建标准化为 YAML 并复用 Docker 生态，发布即冲上 GitHub Go 日榜第 1，单日新增 766 star，总 star 达 4251。
uses: 希望用 YAML 快速搭建 AI Agent 而无需写代码的开发者
需要多智能体协作与 MCP 工具集成的团队
想通过 OCI 注册表打包、分发和复用 Agent 配置的工程师
已在 Docker 生态中、想本地运行模型或接入云 API 的用户

en.tag: Docker's declarative YAML-based AI agent builder and runtime
en.what: docker-agent lets you create and run collaborative AI agents through declarative YAML configs, with no coding required. It runs as a docker CLI plugin and supports multi-agent orchestration, a rich tool ecosystem, and multiple model providers.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based CLI plugin source, an examples/ directory, docs/ with a demo GIF, and OCI registry integration for packaging and sharing agents.
en.stack: Written in Go and distributed as a docker CLI plugin; supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, Mistral, xAI, and Docker Model Runner, with MCP tools and BM25/embedding hybrid RAG.
en.hot: As an official Docker Engineering project, it standardizes agent building as YAML and reuses the Docker ecosystem, hitting #1 on GitHub's Go daily trending with 766 stars added in a day and 4,251 total.
uses: Developers who want to build AI agents quickly with YAML and no code
Teams needing multi-agent collaboration and MCP tool integration
Engineers who want to package, distribute, and reuse agent configs via OCI registries
Docker ecosystem users running local models or cloud APIs

zh.tag: 本地一键运行开源大模型的工具与运行时
zh.what: Ollama 是一个让用户在本地快速下载、运行和管理开源大模型的工具，支持 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、DeepSeek、gpt-oss、Qwen、Gemma 等主流模型。它把模型权重、推理引擎和 REST API 打包成一条命令即可上手的体验，无需手动配置环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务与 CLI、模型拉取与量化管理逻辑、REST API 服务端，以及面向 Python/JavaScript 的官方客户端库和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，底层推理后端基于 llama.cpp，提供 REST API，并配有 Python（ollama-python）和 JavaScript（ollama-js）SDK，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 181930 颗星和本月新增 2820 星，Ollama 已成为本地运行开源模型的事实标准，其极简安装与对 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot 等编码代理的集成持续吸引开发者。
uses: 希望在本地或私有环境运行开源大模型的开发者与研究者
需要为编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot）提供本地模型后端的团队
想快速搭建个人 AI 助手并接入 WhatsApp、Telegram、Slack 等平台的用户
在 macOS、Windows、Linux 或 Docker 上部署模型服务的基础设施工程师

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with a single command
en.what: Ollama is a tool that lets users download, run, and manage open-source LLMs locally with a single command, supporting models like Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, and Gemma. It bundles model weights, an inference engine, and a REST API into a zero-config experience.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core server and CLI, model pulling and quantization management, a REST API server, plus official Python/JavaScript client libraries and a Docker image.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it uses llama.cpp as the inference backend, exposes a REST API, and ships Python (ollama-python) and JavaScript (ollama-js) SDKs, with support for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker.
en.hot: With 181,930 stars and 2,820 added this month, Ollama has become the de facto standard for running open models locally, and its minimal install plus integrations with coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot keep drawing developers.
uses: Developers and researchers who want to run open-source LLMs locally or in private environments
Teams needing a local model backend for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot
Users building personal AI assistants connected to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, and more
Infrastructure engineers deploying model services on macOS, Windows, Linux, or Docker

zh.tag: 懂你 AI 代理在干什么的终端窗口管理器
zh.what: TUIOS 是一个用 Go 编写的现代终端复用器与窗口管理器，在现有终端内提供 vim 风格模态操作、多窗格、工作区与 BSP 平铺布局。它通过守护进程让会话跨重启存活、可跨机器连接，并让窗格里的编码代理上报状态、互相通信，统一收进一个 Inbox。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、docs/ 文档目录（入门、快捷键、BSP 平铺、布局模式、配置、Hooks、主题等）、品牌与演示素材，以及 tuios.dev 上的完整文档和 WebAssembly 在线体验版。
zh.stack: 基于 Charm 技术栈（Bubble Tea v2、Lipgloss v2），采用事件驱动渲染实现近乎零空闲 CPU 占用，支持 kitty 图形协议与无闪烁图片透传，依赖 Go 工具链。
zh.hot: 上线即获 4317 颗星、今日新增 147，位列 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 2，还被评为 Terminal Trove 周度工具；它切中了多代理编码时代对终端会话管理与代理状态可视化的真实需求。
uses: 同时运行多个编码代理、需要统一查看其状态的开发者
习惯 tmux/vim 模态操作、想要更现代终端复用体验的用户
需要跨机器保持长会话、断线重连的远程开发者
希望用 Hooks 和主题深度定制终端工作流的进阶用户

en.tag: A terminal window manager that knows what your coding agents are doing
en.what: TUIOS is a modern terminal multiplexer and window manager written in Go, offering a vim-like modal interface with multiple panes, workspaces and BSP tiling inside your existing terminal. A daemon keeps sessions alive across restarts, reaches sessions on other machines, and lets coding agents in panes report state and message each other through one Inbox.
en.content: The repo ships Go source, a docs/ folder (getting started, keybindings, BSP tiling, layout modes, configuration, hooks, themes), brand and demo assets, plus full documentation and a WebAssembly guided tour at tuios.dev.
en.stack: Built on the Charm stack (Bubble Tea v2, Lipgloss v2) with event-driven rendering for near-zero idle CPU, kitty graphics protocol and flicker-free image passthrough, all on the Go toolchain.
en.hot: It has quickly reached 4,317 stars with 147 added today, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending (Go) and earning Terminal Trove's Tool of the Week; it hits a real need for session management and agent-state visibility in the multi-agent coding era.
uses: Developers running multiple coding agents who need a unified view of their state
Users who like tmux/vim modal workflows but want a more modern multiplexer
Remote developers needing long-lived sessions that survive restarts and span machines
Power users who want to customize workflows deeply with hooks and themes

zh.tag: 高性能中国古诗词 API 服务，支持 REST 与 GraphQL
zh.what: 这是一个基于 Go 语言构建的高性能中国古诗词 API 服务，提供近 40 万首唐诗、宋词、元曲等诗词数据。支持 REST 和 GraphQL 接口，并具备简繁体双语切换、全文搜索、随机诗词、分类过滤等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端服务代码、Docker 配置、Makefile 以及作为 Git Submodule 管理的诗词数据集。提供 REST 和 GraphQL 接口实现，并附带在线演示站点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖包括用于 API 的框架（如 Gin 或 Echo）、GraphQL 库、数据库（如 SQLite 或 PostgreSQL）以及 Docker 容器化。
zh.hot: 该项目本周新增 441 颗星，总星数达 3358，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Go）第 7 名。其高性能、易用性和丰富的诗词数据吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：快速集成古诗词功能到自己的应用中，无需自建数据集。
教育工作者：用于制作诗词学习工具或课堂演示。
文化爱好者：通过 API 探索和检索中国古典诗词。
爬虫练习者：利用提供的爬虫练习场功能进行数据抓取练习。

en.tag: High-performance Chinese poetry API service with REST and GraphQL
en.what: A high-performance Chinese poetry API service built in Go, offering nearly 400,000 poems from Tang, Song, Yuan dynasties and more. It supports both REST and GraphQL interfaces, with features like simplified/traditional Chinese switching, full-text search, random poems, and category filtering.
en.content: The repository contains Go backend service code, Docker configuration, Makefile, and a poetry dataset managed as a Git submodule. It provides REST and GraphQL API implementations, along with an online demo site.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with dependencies including web frameworks (e.g., Gin or Echo), GraphQL libraries, databases (e.g., SQLite or PostgreSQL), and Docker containerization.
en.hot: The project gained 441 stars this week, reaching a total of 3,358 stars, and ranked 7th on GitHub Trending weekly (Go). Its high performance, ease of use, and rich poetry data have attracted significant developer attention.
uses: Developers: quickly integrate Chinese poetry features into their apps without building a dataset.
Educators: use for creating poetry learning tools or classroom demonstrations.
Culture enthusiasts: explore and search classical Chinese poetry via API.
Crawler learners: practice data scraping using the provided crawler playground.

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供 OAuth2/OIDC 认证的反向代理
zh.what: OAuth2 Proxy 是一个开源的反向代理，可为 Web 应用加上 OAuth2 / OIDC 登录认证。它既能独立部署，也能作为中间件嵌入已有的反向代理或负载均衡架构中，拦截请求并把未登录用户重定向到身份提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的代理核心、各身份提供商（Google、Microsoft Entra ID、GitHub、login.gov 及通用 OIDC）的实现、文档站点与本地环境示例配置。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 编写，依赖标准 OAuth2/OIDC 协议库，提供多架构预编译二进制，可容器化部署。
zh.hot: 作为自托管应用统一登录的成熟方案，它已积累约 1.5 万 star，本周仍新增 28 star 并进入 Go 周榜第 16 名，说明企业内网与自建服务的认证需求持续旺盛。
uses: 运维/平台工程师为内网自建服务统一接入企业 SSO
开发者想给没有内置登录的 Web 应用快速加上 OAuth2/OIDC 认证
需要在 Kubernetes Ingress 或 Nginx 前做统一身份校验的团队

en.tag: A reverse proxy that adds OAuth2/OIDC authentication to your web apps
en.what: OAuth2 Proxy is an open-source reverse proxy that adds OAuth2/OIDC authentication to web applications. It can run standalone or as middleware inside existing reverse proxies and load balancers, intercepting requests and redirecting unauthenticated users to an identity provider.
en.content: The repo contains the Go proxy core, provider implementations (Google, Microsoft Entra ID, GitHub, login.gov and generic OIDC), a docs site, and example local-environment configs.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, relying on standard OAuth2/OIDC libraries, shipping prebuilt binaries for many architectures and deployable as a container.
en.hot: As a mature way to add single sign-on to self-hosted apps, it has around 15k stars and still gained 28 this week, ranking 16th on the Go weekly trending list, showing steady demand for auth in internal and self-hosted services.
uses: Ops/platform engineers adding corporate SSO to internal self-hosted services
Developers wanting to quickly add OAuth2/OIDC login to apps lacking built-in auth
Teams needing centralized identity checks in front of Kubernetes Ingress or Nginx

zh.tag: 开源跨平台红队对抗模拟与 C2 框架
zh.what: Sliver 是一个开源、跨平台的对抗模拟与红队框架，供各类组织在授权下开展安全测试。其植入体支持 mTLS、WireGuard、HTTP(S) 和 DNS 等多种命令与控制（C2）通道，并可在 macOS、Windows、Linux 上执行后渗透操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Sliver 服务端与客户端、植入体生成与编译逻辑、多种 C2 传输实现，以及原生/Shellcode 载荷、反射加载、BOF/COFF 执行等模块，并配有 GitHub Actions 自动发布与 lint 工作流。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 Go 编译器进行植入体动态编译，支持 amd64 与 arm64 架构，采用 GPLv3 许可证。
zh.hot: 作为成熟的红队 C2 框架，Sliver 已积累 12091 颗星，今日新增 47 星并登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 4 名，持续受到安全研究社区关注。
uses: 红队与渗透测试人员开展授权安全评估
蓝队与防御方研究攻击者 TTP 以改进检测
安全教学与 CTF 场景中的对抗模拟演练

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform adversary emulation and C2 framework
en.what: Sliver is an open-source, cross-platform adversary emulation and red team framework for authorized security testing. Its implants support command-and-control over mTLS, WireGuard, HTTP(S), and DNS, with post-exploitation capabilities across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.content: The repo contains the Sliver server and client, implant generation and compilation logic, multiple C2 transport implementations, plus native/shellcode payloads, reflective loading, and BOF/COFF execution modules, with GitHub Actions for autorelease and linting.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on the Go compiler for dynamic implant compilation, supports amd64 and arm64 architectures, and is licensed under GPLv3.
en.hot: As a mature red-team C2 framework, Sliver has accumulated 12,091 stars, gaining 47 today and ranking 4th on GitHub Trending's Go daily list, keeping it in the security community spotlight.
uses: Red teams and pentesters conducting authorized security assessments
Blue teams and defenders studying adversary TTPs to improve detection
Security training and CTF scenarios for adversary emulation exercises

zh.tag: 极简易用的通行密钥 OIDC/OAuth 2.0 身份提供商
zh.what: Pocket ID 是一个自托管的 OpenID Connect 认证与 OAuth 2.0 身份提供商，让用户用通行密钥（passkey）登录你的各类应用。它只支持 passkey 登录、不设密码，目标是比 Keycloak、ORY Hydra 更简单易用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端源码、前端界面、Docker 部署配置与文档，并提供在线 Demo 供试用。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用 Docker 部署，遵循 OpenID Connect 与 OAuth 2.0 标准，认证基于 WebAuthn/passkey。
zh.hot: 本周新增 162 star、总数约 9.5k，登上 Go 周榜第 10；在自托管社区对轻量、无密码认证需求上升的背景下，它凭简单易用和官方认证快速走红。
uses: 自托管爱好者，想为家庭实验室的多个服务统一登录入口
中小团队，需要比 Keycloak 更轻量的 OIDC/OAuth 2.0 方案
重视安全、希望用 Yubikey 等硬件密钥无密码登录的用户
开发者，为自建应用快速接入标准身份认证

en.tag: A dead-simple passkey-only OpenID Connect & OAuth 2.0 provider
en.what: Pocket ID is a self-hosted OpenID Connect Certified and OAuth 2.0 provider that lets users sign in to your applications with passkeys. It supports passkey-only authentication with no passwords, aiming to be far simpler than Keycloak or ORY Hydra.
en.content: The repo ships the Go server source, a web frontend, Docker deployment configs and docs, plus an online demo to try it out.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, deployed via Docker, built on the OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 standards with WebAuthn/passkey authentication.
en.hot: It gained 162 stars this week for ~9.5k total, ranking 10th on the Go weekly trending list, boosted by growing demand for lightweight, passwordless self-hosted auth.
uses: Self-hosters wanting a single sign-on for their homelab services
Small teams needing a lighter OIDC/OAuth 2.0 option than Keycloak
Security-minded users who want passwordless login with hardware keys like Yubikey
Developers adding standards-based auth to their own apps quickly

zh.tag: 面向开源模型的终端软件工厂式编码代理
zh.what: CodeAF 是一个为开源模型打造的编码代理框架（harness），目标是让 DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM、Kimi、MiniMax、Ollama 等开源模型以更低成本达到接近前沿的编码能力。它把多个代理任务集中到一个窗口里，你只需分派工作、查看各项目进展，并在需要判断时介入。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的单一可执行文件，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，另有安装脚本、文档指南（docs/GUIDE.md）、基准测试说明以及截图与宣传素材。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，编译成无额外依赖的单二进制；通过接入 DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM、Kimi、MiniMax、Ollama 等开源模型 API 工作，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 本周新增 119 star、总数 401，登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 8；主打在 DeepSWE 基准上以最低单问题成本超越 Claude Code、Codex 等十个 harness，切中开源模型降本增效的痛点。
uses: 想用开源模型替代高价闭源编码代理、控制 API 成本的开发者
需要同时管理多个项目、多个代理任务的独立开发者或小团队
在终端/服务器/手机等多端分派编码工作、希望集中查看进度的工程师
关注开源模型编码能力、想复现或对比 harness 基准的研究者

en.tag: A terminal-based software factory coding harness for open models
en.what: CodeAF is a coding harness built for open models, aiming to get frontier-grade coding out of DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Ollama and more at a fraction of the cost. It funnels many agent tasks into one window where you hand off work, watch progress across projects, and step in only when your judgment is needed.
en.content: The repo ships a single Go binary for macOS, Linux and Windows, plus install scripts, a docs guide (docs/GUIDE.md), benchmark notes, and screenshots/promo assets.
en.stack: Written in Go as one small dependency-free binary; it plugs into open model APIs such as DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax and Ollama, under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: It gained 119 stars this week (401 total) and hit #8 on GitHub Trending's weekly Go list; its claim of topping DeepSWE among ten harnesses at the lowest cost per solved issue, beating Claude Code and Codex, taps the demand for cheaper open-model coding.
uses: Developers who want to replace pricey closed coding agents with open models and control API costs
Solo devs or small teams juggling multiple projects and agent tasks at once
Engineers who dispatch coding work from terminal, server or phone and want one place to track progress
Researchers comparing or reproducing coding-harness benchmarks on open models

zh.tag: 覆盖30+协议并内置自主AI Agent的一体化终端
zh.what: uniTerm 是一款跨平台一体化终端工具，把 SSH、RDP、SFTP、数据库、Kubernetes 等 30 多种远程访问协议整合到一个应用里。它还内置 AI Agent，可以自主执行多轮 shell 命令，帮助用户完成运维和排障任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的桌面应用源码、构建脚本与资源文件，按功能划分为终端、文件传输、远程桌面、数据库、容器等模块，并提供多语言 README 与用户指南。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用 Wails 等桌面框架构建跨平台 GUI，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Android；依赖涵盖 SSH、RDP、VNC、数据库驱动及 Kubernetes 客户端库。
zh.hot: 项目已获 774 颗星，今日新增 20 星并登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 5 名，说明“终端 + AI Agent”这一组合正切中运维自动化的需求。
uses: 运维工程师：用统一终端管理服务器、数据库与 Kubernetes 集群
开发者：在本地与远程环境间切换，并用 AI Agent 自动执行命令
网络与系统管理员：通过 RDP/VNC/串口等协议维护异构设备
喜欢尝鲜的终端用户：想体验 AI 驱动的自动化 shell 工作流

en.tag: All-in-one terminal with 30+ protocols and a built-in autonomous AI agent
en.what: uniTerm is a cross-platform all-in-one terminal that unifies 30+ remote-access protocols such as SSH, RDP, SFTP, databases and Kubernetes in a single app. It also ships a built-in AI agent that autonomously runs multi-turn shell commands for ops and troubleshooting.
en.content: The repo contains the Go desktop app source, build scripts and assets, organized into modules for terminal, file transfer, remote desktop, database and containers, plus multilingual READMEs and a user guide.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go and built with a desktop framework such as Wails for cross-platform GUI on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android; dependencies span SSH, RDP, VNC, database drivers and Kubernetes client libraries.
en.hot: With 774 stars and 20 added today, it ranks 5th on GitHub Trending's daily Go list, showing that the 'terminal + AI agent' combo hits a real ops-automation need.
uses: DevOps engineers managing servers, databases and Kubernetes clusters from one terminal
Developers switching between local and remote environments while letting the AI agent run commands
Network and sysadmins maintaining heterogeneous devices via RDP, VNC or serial
Early adopters curious about AI-driven automated shell workflows

zh.tag: 让 Claude 等 AI 代理直接读写你个人 WhatsApp 的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: 这是一个面向 WhatsApp 的 Model Context Protocol 服务器，通过 WhatsApp Web 多设备 API 直接连接你的个人账号。你可以用它搜索和阅读聊天记录（含图片、视频、文档、音频），查找联系人，并向个人或群组发送消息和媒体文件。所有消息本地存储在 SQLite 中，只有代理通过工具访问时才会发送给 LLM。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 Go 编写的 WhatsApp 桥接程序（whatsapp-bridge）和一个 Python 实现的 MCP 服务器（whatsapp-mcp-server），并附带示例截图与配置说明。
zh.stack: 桥接层使用 Go 和 whatsmeow 库对接 WhatsApp Web 多设备 API；MCP 服务器使用 Python 3.6+ 与 UV 管理，消息本地存于 SQLite，可选依赖 FFmpeg 处理音频。
zh.hot: 它把最私密的通讯工具 WhatsApp 接入了 AI 代理，切中个人助理自动化的刚需，加上 MCP 生态正热，已收获 6538 星，今日新增 59 星并登上 Go 日榜第 13。
uses: 想让 Claude 或 Cursor 帮自己搜索、总结和回复 WhatsApp 聊天记录的个人用户
需要自动处理群组消息、发送媒体文件的内容运营或社群管理者
研究 MCP 协议与 AI 代理工具链集成的开发者
希望本地存储聊天数据、仅在需要时才交给 LLM 的隐私敏感用户

en.tag: An MCP server that lets AI agents like Claude read and send your personal WhatsApp messages
en.what: This is a Model Context Protocol server for WhatsApp that connects directly to your personal account via the WhatsApp Web multidevice API. You can search and read your chats (including images, videos, documents, and audio), look up contacts, and send messages or media to individuals and groups. All messages are stored locally in SQLite and only sent to an LLM when the agent accesses them through tools you control.
en.content: The repo mainly contains a Go-based WhatsApp bridge (whatsapp-bridge) and a Python MCP server (whatsapp-mcp-server), along with example screenshots and setup instructions.
en.stack: The bridge uses Go with the whatsmeow library to talk to the WhatsApp Web multidevice API; the MCP server runs on Python 3.6+ managed by UV, stores messages locally in SQLite, and optionally uses FFmpeg for audio.
en.hot: It plugs the highly personal WhatsApp into AI agents, hitting a real need for personal-assistant automation, and rides the hot MCP ecosystem—now at 6,538 stars with 59 added today, ranking 13th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Individuals who want Claude or Cursor to search, summarize, and reply to their WhatsApp chats
Community managers or content operators who need to automate group messages and send media files
Developers exploring MCP protocol and AI agent toolchain integrations
Privacy-conscious users who want chats stored locally and shared with an LLM only when needed

zh.tag: 基于 Elm 架构的 Go 终端 UI 框架
zh.what: Bubble Tea 是一个用 Go 编写的终端用户界面（TUI）框架，基于 Elm 架构的函数式、有状态设计。它适合构建从简单到复杂的终端应用，支持内联、全窗口或混合模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心代码、教程、示例和文档，以及升级指南。还有配套的 Bubbles 组件库。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖标准库和少量外部库。基于 Elm 架构，包含高性能单元格渲染器、颜色降采样、键盘鼠标处理等特性。
zh.hot: Bubble Tea 在 GitHub 上拥有超过 45,000 颗星，今日新增 53 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 6 名。其优雅的设计和活跃的社区使其成为终端应用开发的热门选择。
uses: Go 开发者构建终端应用，如 CLI 工具、仪表盘等
需要跨平台 TUI 的团队，利用其高性能渲染和输入处理
学习 Elm 架构和函数式编程的开发者
希望快速原型设计终端界面的爱好者

en.tag: A Go TUI framework based on The Elm Architecture
en.what: Bubble Tea is a Go framework for building terminal user interfaces (TUIs), based on the functional, stateful design of The Elm Architecture. It suits simple to complex terminal apps, supporting inline, full-window, or mixed modes.
en.content: The repo contains the core framework code, tutorials, examples, docs, and an upgrade guide. There's also a companion Bubbles component library.
en.stack: Built in Go, depending on the standard library and a few external packages. Based on Elm Architecture, it features a high-performance cell-based renderer, color downsampling, keyboard/mouse handling, and more.
en.hot: Bubble Tea has over 45,000 stars on GitHub, with 53 new stars today, ranking 6th on the Go trending list. Its elegant design and active community make it a popular choice for terminal app development.
uses: Go developers building terminal apps like CLI tools and dashboards
Teams needing cross-platform TUIs with high-performance rendering and input handling
Developers learning Elm Architecture and functional programming
Hobbyists prototyping terminal interfaces quickly

zh.tag: 2美元ESP32-C3上的Pi-hole级DNS广告拦截器，无需PSRAM
zh.what: 这是一个运行在廉价ESP32-C3开发板上的DNS广告拦截器，功能类似Pi-hole。它把53.7万个域名以40位FNV-1a哈希的形式存入闪存，通过二分查找实现拦截，无需PSRAM，仅占用约50KB内存即可在约10毫秒内响应被拦截的查询。
zh.content: 仓库包含C++固件源码、PlatformIO构建配置、Web仪表盘，以及一个可3D打印的C3 SuperMini外壳STL文件。
zh.stack: 基于C++与PlatformIO开发，面向ESP32-C3（也支持经典ESP32），使用UDP DNS sinkhole与闪存哈希表，依赖WiFi联网。
zh.hot: 上线即登上GitHub Trending日榜C++第2名，今日新增476星、总星2258。它被Tom's Hardware、XDA等媒体报道，用极低成本实现Pi-hole级拦截，极具话题性。
uses: 想低成本搭建家庭网络广告拦截的DIY爱好者
拥有ESP32-C3开发板、想折腾嵌入式网络项目的开发者
关注闪存哈希、内存优化等嵌入式技巧的工程师
希望用USB小棒即插即用拦截广告的普通用户

en.tag: A Pi-hole-class DNS ad-blocker on a $2 ESP32-C3, no PSRAM required
en.what: This is a DNS ad-blocker running on a cheap ESP32-C3 board, functionally similar to Pi-hole. It stores 537k domains as 40-bit FNV-1a hashes in flash and binary-searches them, requiring no PSRAM and using only ~50KB of RAM to answer blocked lookups in about 10ms.
en.content: The repo contains C++ firmware source, PlatformIO build configs, a web dashboard, and a printable STL enclosure for the C3 SuperMini.
en.stack: Built in C++ with PlatformIO for the ESP32-C3 (classic ESP32 also supported), using a UDP DNS sinkhole and a flash hash table, relying on WiFi connectivity.
en.hot: It hit #2 on GitHub Trending (C++) with 476 stars today and 2,258 total. Featured by Tom's Hardware and XDA, it's a buzzworthy feat of Pi-hole-class blocking at extremely low cost.
uses: DIY enthusiasts wanting low-cost home network ad blocking
Developers with an ESP32-C3 board looking for an embedded networking project
Engineers interested in flash hashing and memory optimization tricks
Everyday users wanting a plug-and-play USB dongle to block ads

zh.tag: 开源跨平台参数化 3D 建模软件官方源码
zh.what: FreeCAD 是一款免费开源的跨平台参数化 3D 建模软件，用于设计任意尺寸的真实物体。通过修改模型历史中的参数即可调整设计，并支持从 2D 草图构建 3D 模型、反向生成工程图纸。
zh.content: 仓库是 FreeCAD 的官方源代码，包含核心 C++ 代码、Qt 图形界面、Python API 以及各工作台模块，并附有构建脚本、图标资源与文档链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 OpenCASCADE 几何内核、Coin3D 场景库与 Qt 界面框架，并提供广泛的 Python API 用于脚本扩展。
zh.hot: 作为拥有 34089 颗星的老牌开源 CAD 项目，它今日再登 GitHub C++ 日榜第 10 名（新增 55 星），持续吸引工程师与创客关注。
uses: 机械工程师与产品设计师，用于参数化零件与装配体建模
建筑师与土木从业者，用于建筑与结构的三维设计
学生和教师，作为免费学习 CAD 与参数化建模的教学工具
程序员与爱好者，通过 Python API 扩展自定义工作台与自动化流程

en.tag: Official source of the free, open-source, cross-platform parametric 3D modeler
en.what: FreeCAD is a free, open-source, cross-platform parametric 3D modeler for designing real-life objects of any size. Designs can be modified by changing parameters in the model history, and it supports building 3D from 2D sketches and producing production drawings.
en.content: The repo hosts FreeCAD's official source code, including core C++ code, the Qt GUI, the Python API, workbench modules, build scripts, icon assets and documentation links.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++, it builds on the OpenCASCADE geometry kernel, the Coin3D scene library and the Qt GUI framework, with an extensive Python API for scripting.
en.hot: With 34,089 stars, this veteran open-source CAD project is back on GitHub's daily C++ trending list at No. 10 (+55 stars today), drawing steady attention from engineers and makers.
uses: Mechanical engineers and product designers for parametric part and assembly modeling
Architects and civil professionals for 3D building and structural design
Students and teachers as a free tool for learning CAD and parametric modeling
Programmers and hobbyists extending custom workbenches and automation via the Python API

zh.tag: 一站式单机游戏修改器下载与管理工具
zh.what: Game Cheats Manager 把来自 Fling、小幸、Cheat Engine 社区等多个来源的单机游戏修改器整合到一个开源桌面面板中，支持中英文搜索与一键下载。它会自动解压、打版本标签、归类文件夹并检测更新，省去在杂乱网站上翻找的麻烦。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 C++ 桌面应用，包含 src 源码目录、assets 资源（如 logo）、多语言 README（英/简中/繁中）以及发布版安装包，并配有官网、Discord 与 QQ 社区入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，面向 Windows 平台，依赖本地数据同步与解压逻辑，并集成 Windows Defender 相关处理以降低误报。
zh.hot: 凭借 15180 颗星和本周新增 186 星登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 第 5 名，说明单机玩家对安全、集中管理修改器的需求非常旺盛。
uses: 喜欢用修改器降低难度的单机游戏玩家，可集中管理各类 trainer
不想在杂乱网站中翻找下载链接、担心安全风险的用户
需要中英文双语搜索并自动更新修改器库的玩家
对开源工具感兴趣、愿意自行编译或提交社区修改器的开发者

en.tag: One-stop downloader and manager for single-player game trainers
en.what: Game Cheats Manager consolidates single-player game trainers from multiple sources—Fling, XiaoXing, Cheat Engine community tables and more—into one open-source desktop dashboard with bilingual search and one-click downloads. It automatically unzips, version-tags, organizes files into named folders and checks for updates, sparing users from hunting through sketchy websites.
en.content: The repo is a C++ desktop app containing a src directory, assets such as the logo, multilingual READMEs (EN/Simplified Chinese/Traditional Chinese) and release installers, plus links to its official site, Discord and QQ communities.
en.stack: Built mainly in C++ for Windows, it relies on local data syncing and unzip logic, and integrates Windows Defender handling to reduce false-positive antivirus alerts.
en.hot: With 15,180 stars and 186 added this week, it ranks 5th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list, showing strong demand among single-player gamers for a safe, centralized trainer manager.
uses: Single-player gamers who use trainers to lower difficulty and want centralized management
Users tired of hunting through sketchy sites and worried about download safety
Players needing bilingual search and automatic trainer library updates
Developers interested in open-source tools who may compile it or submit community trainers

zh.tag: 开源截图与看图工具套件，含 Snow Shot 与 Snow Image Viewer
zh.what: Snow Apps 是一个多项目仓库，提供 Snow Shot（截图/标注工具）和 Snow Image Viewer（图片查看器）的完整源码。支持 Windows x64/ARM64 与 macOS Apple Silicon，内置 OCR 资源，可通过 WinGet、Scoop、Homebrew 安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 snow_shot、snow_image_viewer、snow_image、snow-crates、snow_draw_engine_qt、snow_rust_ffi、ant_design_qt 等模块，另有 Windows ARM64 构建与发布文档。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，结合 Qt 界面框架与 Rust 组件（snow-crates、snow_rust_ffi），采用多许可证（Apache 2.0 与 GPLv3）。
zh.hot: 作为国产开源截图工具，5751 颗星、日增 28 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 11，说明跨平台截图与 OCR 需求旺盛。
uses: 需要轻量截图、标注与 OCR 的 Windows/macOS 用户
偏好开源、可自行编译的开发者与极客
想研究 Qt + Rust 混合桌面架构的工程师
需要 Windows ARM64 原生构建的开发者

en.tag: Open-source screenshot and image viewer suite: Snow Shot and Snow Image Viewer
en.what: Snow Apps is a multi-project repository providing full source code for Snow Shot (a screenshot/annotation tool) and Snow Image Viewer. It supports Windows x64/ARM64 and Apple Silicon macOS, ships with built-in OCR resources, and can be installed via WinGet, Scoop, or Homebrew.
en.content: The repo contains modules such as snow_shot, snow_image_viewer, snow_image, snow-crates, snow_draw_engine_qt, snow_rust_ffi, and ant_design_qt, plus docs for Windows ARM64 builds and releases.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with the Qt UI framework and Rust components (snow-crates, snow_rust_ffi), under a multi-license setup (Apache 2.0 and GPLv3).
en.hot: As a domestic open-source screenshot tool, 5,751 stars with 28 added today and #11 on the C++ daily trending list show strong demand for cross-platform screenshot and OCR tools.
uses: Windows/macOS users needing lightweight screenshot, annotation, and OCR
Developers and tinkerers who prefer open-source, self-compilable tools
Engineers studying hybrid Qt + Rust desktop architecture
Developers needing native Windows ARM64 builds

zh.tag: 跨平台高级剪贴板管理器，支持脚本与自定义命令
zh.what: CopyQ 是一款跨平台的剪贴板管理器，持续监控系统剪贴板并把内容保存到可自定义的标签页中。它支持文本、HTML、图片及任意自定义格式，并提供强大的编辑、搜索、过滤与脚本自动化能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++/Qt 源码、构建脚本、多语言翻译文件以及详尽的文档（ReadTheDocs）。同时提供 Linux、Windows、macOS 的安装包与 CI 构建配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 与 Qt 框架开发，使用 CMake 构建，依赖 Qt 的 GUI、网络与脚本模块，并集成 Weblate 翻译与 GitHub Actions 持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为一款成熟稳定的开源剪贴板工具，CopyQ 已积累超过 1.2 万 Star，本周新增 86 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 9 名，说明其在开发者与效率工具爱好者中持续受到关注。
uses: 需要频繁复制粘贴、管理多段剪贴板内容的开发者与文字工作者
希望用脚本自动化剪贴板操作、自定义快捷键的高级用户
在 Linux、Windows 或 macOS 上寻找跨平台剪贴板管理方案的用户

en.tag: Cross-platform advanced clipboard manager with scripting and custom commands
en.what: CopyQ is a cross-platform clipboard manager that monitors the system clipboard and saves its content into customizable tabs. It supports text, HTML, images, and any custom formats, with powerful editing, search, filtering, and scripting automation.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++/Qt source code, build scripts, multi-language translation files, and extensive documentation (ReadTheDocs). It also provides installers for Linux, Windows, and macOS along with CI build configurations.
en.stack: Built with C++ and the Qt framework, using CMake for building, relying on Qt's GUI, network, and scripting modules, with Weblate translations and GitHub Actions CI.
en.hot: As a mature and stable open-source clipboard tool, CopyQ has accumulated over 12,000 stars, gaining 86 stars this week and ranking 9th on the C++ weekly trending list, showing sustained interest from developers and productivity enthusiasts.
uses: Developers and writers who frequently copy/paste and manage multiple clipboard entries
Advanced users who want to automate clipboard operations with scripts and custom shortcuts
Users looking for a cross-platform clipboard manager on Linux, Windows, or macOS

zh.tag: 用 C++ 编写的跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器
zh.what: shadPS4 是一个用 C++ 编写的早期 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它专注于模拟 PS4 主机核心，让玩家能在 PC 上运行《血源诅咒》《如龙 0》等独占游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心代码、构建脚本、文档与截图，但不含图形界面；普通用户需搭配独立的 QtLauncher 使用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 CMake 构建，并涉及 Vulkan 图形后端与各平台系统库。
zh.hot: 作为少有的开源 PS4 模拟器，它已能运行《血源诅咒》等大作，吸引大量玩家关注，星标数已近 3.3 万，今日再登 C++ 日榜。
uses: 想在现代 PC 上重温 PS4 独占游戏的玩家
对主机模拟器开发感兴趣、想研究底层实现的技术爱好者
希望为开源模拟器项目贡献代码或测试兼容性的开发者

en.tag: A cross-platform PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++
en.what: shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS and FreeBSD. It focuses on emulating the PS4 core, letting players run exclusives like Bloodborne and Yakuza 0 on PC.
en.content: The repo contains the emulator core, build scripts, docs and screenshots, but no GUI; end users need the separate QtLauncher.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with CMake build system, a Vulkan graphics backend and platform-specific system libraries.
en.hot: As one of the few open-source PS4 emulators, it can already run hits like Bloodborne, drawing huge attention with nearly 33k stars and a spot on today's C++ trending list.
uses: Players who want to replay PS4 exclusives on modern PCs
Tech enthusiasts curious about console emulator internals
Developers looking to contribute code or test game compatibility

zh.tag: 开源高性能容错搜索引擎，Algolia 与 ElasticSearch 的轻量替代
zh.what: Typesense 是一个用 C++ 编写的高性能开源搜索引擎，主打毫秒级响应与容错模糊匹配，让开发者快速搭建顺滑的搜索体验。它定位为 Algolia 的开源替代品，同时比 ElasticSearch 更易上手，支持拼写纠错、即时搜索、语义与混合检索等能力。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++ 核心引擎为主体，包含构建脚本、Docker 配置、文档与大量演示资源（如 3200 万首歌曲、2800 万本书籍等在线 Demo 链接）。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 实现，提供 Docker 镜像与多语言官方客户端，依赖轻量、可单机或集群部署，并支持语义/向量混合搜索。
zh.hot: 凭借 26,840 颗星与今日新增 173 星冲上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 3，云服务月搜索量已达 100 亿次，开源搜索替代需求持续升温。
uses: 需要为网站或 App 快速接入搜索的开发者 —— 用少量代码即可获得容错即时搜索
想替换 Algolia 等付费搜索服务、控制成本的团队 —— 开源可自托管
觉得 ElasticSearch 配置复杂的中小项目 —— 更轻量、更易上手
需要语义/向量混合检索的 AI 应用 —— 支持现代检索场景

en.tag: Open-source, typo-tolerant search engine — a lighter Algolia/ElasticSearch alternative
en.what: Typesense is a high-performance open-source search engine written in C++, focused on millisecond latency and typo-tolerant fuzzy matching for delightful search experiences. Positioned as an open-source Algolia alternative and an easier-to-use ElasticSearch replacement, it supports spell correction, instant search, and semantic/hybrid retrieval.
en.content: The repo centers on a C++ core engine, plus build scripts, Docker configs, docs, and a rich set of demo assets (links to live demos over 32M songs, 28M books, and more).
en.stack: Built in C++ with Docker images and official multi-language clients; lightweight to deploy on a single node or cluster, with semantic/vector hybrid search support.
en.hot: With 26,840 stars and +173 today, it hit #3 on GitHub's C++ daily trending; its cloud handles 10 billion searches per month, riding the demand for open-source search alternatives.
uses: Developers adding search to a site or app — get typo-tolerant instant search with minimal code
Teams replacing paid services like Algolia to cut costs — open source and self-hostable
Small-to-mid projects finding ElasticSearch too complex — lighter and easier to run
AI apps needing semantic/vector hybrid retrieval — supports modern search use cases

zh.tag: 基于SQL与Parquet的开放湖仓格式，元数据存于目录数据库，数据存为Parquet文件。
zh.what: DuckLake 是一种开放的湖仓一体格式，它使用 SQL 数据库作为元数据目录，并将实际数据存储为 Parquet 文件。该扩展让 DuckDB 能够直接读写 DuckLake 数据，支持标准 SQL 操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的 DuckLake 扩展源码，提供安装、附加数据库、建表、查询、更新、时间旅行、模式演进和变更数据捕获等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 DuckDB 和 Parquet 格式，元数据可存储于多种 SQL 数据库（如 DuckDB、PostgreSQL 等）。
zh.hot: DuckLake 作为新兴的湖仓格式，凭借 DuckDB 的流行度和简洁设计，本周新增 284 stars，总 stars 达 3301，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 第 11 名。
uses: 数据工程师和分析师 —— 需要轻量级湖仓解决方案，用 SQL 管理数据。
DuckDB 用户 —— 希望扩展数据管理能力，直接读写湖仓数据。
数据科学家 —— 需要时间旅行和模式演进功能进行实验和回溯。
团队协作场景 —— 利用变更数据捕获跟踪数据变化，支持多版本管理。

en.tag: An open lakehouse format built on SQL and Parquet, storing metadata in a catalog database and data in Parquet files.
en.what: DuckLake is an open lakehouse format that uses a SQL database as its metadata catalog and stores data in Parquet files. The DuckDB extension enables direct read/write access to DuckLake data with standard SQL.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for the DuckDB DuckLake extension, offering features like installation, attaching databases, table creation, querying, updates, time travel, schema evolution, and change data feed.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, it depends on DuckDB and the Parquet format, with metadata storable in various SQL databases (e.g., DuckDB, PostgreSQL).
en.hot: As an emerging lakehouse format, DuckLake gains popularity from DuckDB's traction and its simple design, adding 284 stars this week to reach 3,301 total, ranking 11th on GitHub Trending weekly for C++.
uses: Data engineers and analysts — need a lightweight lakehouse solution to manage data with SQL.
DuckDB users — want to extend data management capabilities and directly read/write lakehouse data.
Data scientists — require time travel and schema evolution for experiments and rollbacks.
Team collaboration scenarios — use change data feed to track data changes and support multi-version management.

zh.tag: 开源AI代理团队管理平台，像运营公司一样管理代理。
zh.what: Paperclip 是一个开源应用，用于在工作场景中管理 AI 代理团队。它通过 Node.js 服务器和 React UI 编排多个代理，让用户设定业务目标、分配任务并跟踪工作与成本。

开发者 —— 希望集成不同代理提供商，构建自定义工作流。
产品经理 —— 通过仪表板监控代理工作，确保与业务目标对齐。

en.tag: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents, manage like a company.
en.what: Paperclip is an open-source app for managing AI agent teams at work. It orchestrates multiple agents via a Node.js server and React UI, letting users set business goals, assign tasks, and track work and costs.
en.content: The repo includes a Node.js server and React frontend, offering dashboards, org charts, budgets, and governance, with support for multiple agent providers.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Node.js and React, leveraging modern frontend and backend technologies.
en.hot: With 84,963 stars and 2,109 added today, it tops GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong demand for AI agent team management tools.
uses: AI team leads — need to manage multiple agents and track progress and costs.
Startups — want to automate operations with AI agents, from goal setting to execution monitoring.
Developers — wish to integrate various agent providers and build custom workflows.

zh.tag: 面向投行、研究与财富管理的金融工作流 AI 代理与技能库

zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，依赖 Claude Cowork 插件体系与 Claude Managed Agents API（/v1/agents）进行部署。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方发布的金融垂直代理库，它把大模型代理直接落到投行、PE 等高价值工作流，上线即冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5，今日新增 260 star，总 star 已达 35370。
uses: 投行、PE、股票研究与财富管理从业者，用于加速建模、备忘录与研究报告草拟

en.tag: Reference agents, skills, and data connectors for financial-services workflows
en.what: Anthropic's open-source reference implementation of AI agents for financial services, covering investment banking, equity research, private equity, and wealth management. The same system prompts and skills ship two ways: as a Claude Cowork plugin, or deployed via the Claude Managed Agents API behind your own workflow engine.

en.stack: Primary language is Python, built around the Claude Cowork plugin system and the Claude Managed Agents API (/v1/agents) for deployment.
en.hot: As Anthropic's official vertical agent library for finance, it lands LLM agents directly in high-value workflows like investment banking and PE, debuting at #5 on GitHub Trending with 260 stars added today and 35,370 total.
uses: Investment banking, PE, equity research, and wealth management professionals drafting models, memos, and research notes
Financial-institution AI/platform teams building custom agent workflows on official templates
Developers needing finance skills and data connectors like /comps, /dcf, and /earnings
Researchers assessing compliance and human-in-the-loop boundaries for LLM agents in finance

zh.tag: 让智能体真正学会学习的长期记忆系统
zh.what: Hindsight 是一个面向 AI 智能体的记忆系统，目标不是简单回放对话历史，而是让智能体随时间积累经验、持续学习。它声称克服了 RAG 和知识图谱在长期记忆任务上的缺陷，并在相关基准上达到领先水平。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 服务端与客户端 SDK、NPM 客户端包、文档站点（hindsight-docs）、集成示例与 Cookbook，并提供 MCP 服务器、LLM Wrapper 及编码智能体接入方式。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，发布到 PyPI（hindsight-api、hindsight-client）与 NPM（@vectorize-io/hindsight-client），采用 MIT 许可，支持独立服务器、嵌入式运行及多种平台集成。
zh.hot: 上线即获 27785 颗星、单日新增 1668 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2，说明智能体长期记忆正是当下最受关注的痛点方向。
uses: 构建需要跨会话记住用户偏好并持续进化的 AI 智能体开发者
希望替代 RAG 或知识图谱方案、提升长期记忆准确率的团队
为编码助手、客服机器人等产品接入记忆能力的工程团队
想通过 MCP 或 LLM Wrapper 快速试水智能体记忆的研究者

en.tag: Agent memory system that makes agents learn, not just remember
en.what: Hindsight is an agent memory system designed to make agents learn over time rather than merely recall conversation history. It claims to overcome the shortcomings of RAG and knowledge graphs, delivering state-of-the-art results on long-term memory benchmarks.
en.content: The repo ships a Python server and client SDK, an NPM client package, a docs site (hindsight-docs), integration examples and a cookbook, plus an MCP server, an LLM wrapper, and coding-agent integrations.
en.stack: Primarily Python, published on PyPI (hindsight-api, hindsight-client) and NPM (@vectorize-io/hindsight-client) under MIT license, supporting standalone server, embedded mode, and multi-platform integrations.
en.hot: With 27,785 stars and 1,668 added in a single day, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending daily, it shows agent long-term memory is one of today's hottest pain points.
uses: Developers building AI agents that must remember user preferences across sessions and keep improving
Teams looking to replace RAG or knowledge-graph approaches with higher long-term memory accuracy
Engineering teams adding memory to coding assistants, support bots, and similar products
Researchers wanting to try agent memory quickly via MCP or the LLM wrapper

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 终端里的智能体编程助手，用自然语言写代码
zh.what: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 推出的智能体编程工具，常驻终端，能理解你的代码库。它通过自然语言指令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码并处理 git 工作流，帮助开发者更快编码。
