uses: 希望用自然语言加速日常编码与重构的开发者
需要在终端内处理 git 工作流和代码解释的工程师
想通过插件扩展自定义命令与智能体的进阶用户

en.tag: An agentic coding tool living in your terminal, coding via natural language
en.what: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal and understands your codebase. It executes routine tasks, explains complex code, and handles git workflows through natural language commands, helping developers code faster.
en.content: The repo mainly contains install scripts, a plugins directory (offering custom commands and agent extensions), and a demo GIF, with official docs hosted externally.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, it requires Node.js 18+ and supports multiple install methods like curl, Homebrew, WinGet, and PowerShell (npm is deprecated).
en.hot: As Anthropic's official agentic coding tool, it has amassed 145,507 stars, gaining 165 more today and ranking 11th on the daily trending list, drawing steady developer attention.

Engineers handling git workflows and code explanations inside the terminal
Advanced users extending custom commands and agents via plugins

zh.tag: 腾讯云开源的自托管多用户多智能体 AI 助手
zh.what: Octop 是腾讯云开源的自托管 AI 助手，主打多用户与多智能体并行协作，可为团队、家庭和个人搭建独立又协同的智能环境。它完全运行在本地，隐私不外泄，单进程启动即可用。

zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，采用 Ruff 代码风格，通过 PyPI 分发，支持 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 接口，并集成 MCP、OAuth 与 ACP 协议。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 6，累计约 2950 star、单日新增 396，腾讯云背书加上自托管多智能体定位正好切中隐私与协作需求。
uses: 注重数据隐私、希望本地自托管 AI 助手的团队与个人
需要多用户共享、多智能体协作的家庭或小型组织
想通过飞书、钉钉、QQ、Discord、企业微信等 IM 接入 AI 的用户
希望用专家库、Connectors 与 ACP 扩展 IDE 工作流的开发者

en.tag: Tencent Cloud's self-hosted multi-user, multi-agent AI assistant
en.what: Octop is an open-source, self-hosted AI assistant from Tencent Cloud built around multi-user and multi-agent parallelism, creating an intelligent environment that is both independent and collaborative for teams, families, and individuals. It runs entirely on your own machine, so privacy is never compromised, and a single process brings up the whole stack.
en.content: The repo ships a full Python 3.12+ implementation with a web console, CLI and IM integrations, plus extension modules such as an expert library, Connectors (OAuth + MCP) and ACP, along with bilingual READMEs and a roadmap.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, styled with Ruff and distributed via PyPI, it exposes HTTP/SSE/WebSocket interfaces and integrates MCP, OAuth and ACP protocols.
en.hot: It hit No.6 on GitHub Trending's Python daily list with roughly 2,950 stars and 396 gained in a single day, as Tencent Cloud's backing plus a self-hosted multi-agent angle taps straight into privacy and collaboration needs.
uses: Teams and individuals who value privacy and want a self-hosted AI assistant
Families or small organizations needing multi-user sharing and multi-agent collaboration
Users who want AI access via Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, Discord or WeCom
Developers extending IDE workflows with the expert library, Connectors and ACP

zh.tag: 面向自主智能体的高密度安全沙箱运行时
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个默认安全的智能体执行运行时，能在标准容器运行时基础上以 10 倍密度运行数百万个沙箱。它把大量「actor」（如智能体应用）映射到少量就绪的「worker」上，利用智能体大部分时间空闲的特性实现重度多路复用，并支持 microVM、gVisor 等多种沙箱技术。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的核心系统，提供 actor 生命周期管理（创建/销毁、挂起/恢复）、实时调度到 worker 以及流量路由；还附带演示视频和集群复现指南，展示约 250 个有状态 actor 在 8 个物理 Pod 上的多路复用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 worker（Pod）生命周期管理，并集成 microVM、gVisor 等沙箱技术，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 今日新增 498 星、总星数 2606，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 4 名；其「10 倍密度、亚 500ms 恢复、每秒 500+ 挂起/恢复」的指标切中了智能体规模化运行的基础设施痛点。
uses: 需要大规模运行自主智能体、追求高密度与低延迟的 AI 基础设施团队
在 Kubernetes 上构建端到端智能体部署、希望统一调度与隔离的平台工程师
研究 RL 场景中智能体、推理与训练循环协同优化的研究人员
关注零信任内核与网络隔离、需要安全沙箱运行不可信代码的开发者

en.tag: A secure-by-default, high-density sandbox runtime for autonomous agents
en.what: Agent Substrate is a secure-by-default agent execution runtime engineered to run millions of sandboxes at 10x the density of standard container runtimes. It maps many 'actors' (agent-like applications) onto a smaller pool of ready 'workers', exploiting the fact that agents are idle most of the time to achieve heavy multiplexing, and supports multiple sandbox technologies including microVMs and gVisor.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core system offering actor lifecycle management (create/destroy, suspend/resume), real-time assignment to workers, and traffic routing, plus a demo video and cluster walkthrough showing ~250 stateful actors multiplexed across 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it builds on Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker (Pod) lifecycle management, integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: It gained 498 stars today (2,606 total) and ranked #4 on GitHub Trending's Go daily list; its metrics—10x density, sub-500ms resume, and 500+ suspend/resume activations per second—hit the infrastructure pain point of running agents at scale.
uses: AI infrastructure teams needing to run autonomous agents at scale with high density and low latency
Platform engineers building end-to-end agent deployments on Kubernetes who want unified scheduling and isolation
Researchers optimizing RL scenarios that span agentic, inference, and training cycles
Developers needing secure sandboxes with zero-trust kernel and network isolation for untrusted code

zh.tag: NVIDIA 出品的自主 AI 代理安全私有运行时
zh.what: OpenShell 为自主 AI 代理提供隔离沙箱运行时，让代理能读文件、装包、调 API、用凭证，但不会获得对数据、密钥和网络的无限访问权。用户通过策略声明每个代理能触碰什么，OpenShell 在内核层强制执行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的 CLI 与本地 gateway、内核级沙箱与 supervisor 组件、策略定义与形式化验证模块，以及文档、品牌资源和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，提供 PyPI 包 openshell，依赖 Docker、Podman 或主机虚拟化，支持 Linux、Apple Silicon macOS 和 WSL 2。
zh.hot: 凭借 NVIDIA 品牌背书和「代理安全」这一 2025 年最热议题，项目单日新增 990 star、总数达 10622，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2。
uses: 需要让 AI 代理安全访问文件、API 和凭证的企业开发团队
构建多代理系统、关注沙箱隔离与权限治理的平台工程师
研究代理安全、策略形式化验证的安全与合规人员

en.tag: NVIDIA's safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents
en.what: OpenShell is a runtime that sandboxes autonomous AI agents so they can read files, install packages, call APIs and use credentials without gaining unrestricted access to your data, secrets or network. You declare what each agent may touch in a policy, and OpenShell enforces it.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust-based CLI and local gateway, kernel-level sandbox and supervisor components, policy definitions with formal verification, plus docs, brand assets and an install script.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, distributed as the openshell PyPI package, and relies on Docker, Podman or host virtualization across Linux, Apple Silicon macOS and WSL 2.
en.hot: Backed by NVIDIA and riding the hottest 2025 topic of agent safety, it gained 990 stars in a single day to reach 10,622 and hit #2 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Enterprise teams that need AI agents to safely access files, APIs and credentials
Platform engineers building multi-agent systems with sandboxing and permission governance
Security and compliance staff researching agent safety and formal policy verification

zh.tag: 给 AI 代理一台可用的电脑：开源驱动、跨系统机群与评测基准
zh.what: Cua 是一套面向 computer-use 代理的开源基础设施，让 AI 代理能像人一样操作桌面应用。它提供桌面自动化驱动、隔离的云端桌面机群、本地 macOS 虚拟机、专用决策模型以及评测基准，覆盖训练、评估与数据生成全流程。
zh.content: 仓库按模块组织：Cua Driver（跨 macOS/Windows/Linux 的应用操作驱动）、Cua Fleets（隔离云桌面）、Lume（Apple Silicon 上的本地 macOS/Linux 虚拟机）、CUA-S1 小模型以及 Cua Bench 评测工具，另含文档与示例。
zh.stack: 以 HTML 为主要呈现语言，核心为 Python/TypeScript SDK，依赖虚拟化（Apple Silicon 上的 Lume）、容器化云桌面与多模态模型推理；提供 Docker 与云端部署路径。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1211 star、总数突破 2.7 万并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 15，说明 computer-use 代理正从演示走向可规模化的基础设施，开发者对开源替代方案需求强烈。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理接入真实桌面操作能力与评测闭环
研究者：用 Cua Bench 生成轨迹数据、评估 computer-use 模型
企业团队：在隔离云桌面上批量运行自动化任务与回归测试
Mac 用户：用 Lume 在 Apple Silicon 上跑本地 macOS/Linux 虚拟机

en.tag: Give AI agents computers they can use: open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks
en.what: Cua is an open-source infrastructure stack for computer-use agents, letting AI agents operate desktop applications like a human. It ships desktop automation drivers, isolated cloud desktop fleets, local macOS VMs, specialist decision models, and benchmarks spanning training, evaluation, and data generation.
en.content: The repo is organized into modules: Cua Driver (cross-platform app operation on macOS/Windows/Linux), Cua Fleets (isolated cloud desktops), Lume (local macOS/Linux VMs on Apple Silicon), the CUA-S1 small model, and Cua Bench for evaluation, plus docs and examples.
en.stack: HTML-heavy presentation with Python/TypeScript SDKs at the core, relying on virtualization (Lume on Apple Silicon), containerized cloud desktops, and multimodal model inference; offers Docker and cloud deployment paths.
en.hot: With 1,211 stars added this week, a total past 27k, and a #15 spot on the GitHub Trending weekly chart, it shows computer-use agents moving from demos to scalable infrastructure and strong demand for open-source alternatives.
uses: AI agent developers: give agents real desktop control plus an evaluation loop
Researchers: generate trajectory data and benchmark computer-use models with Cua Bench
Enterprise teams: run automation and regression tests at scale on isolated cloud desktops
Mac users: run local macOS/Linux VMs on Apple Silicon with Lume

zh.tag: 美国国家安全局开源的顶级软件逆向工程框架
zh.what: Ghidra 是由美国国家安全局（NSA）研究部门创建并维护的软件逆向工程（SRE）框架，提供反汇编、汇编、反编译、图形化与脚本等完整分析能力。它支持多种处理器指令集与可执行格式，可在 Windows、macOS、Linux 上以交互或自动化模式运行，用户还能用 Java 或 Python 开发扩展与脚本。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Ghidra 源码、Gradle 构建脚本、各功能模块（Features/Base 等）与官方文档，可自行编译开发版或下载官方多平台发布包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Java 编写，构建依赖 JDK 25、Gradle 9.1.0+ 与 Python3（3.9–3.14），Linux/macOS 下还需 GCC/Clang 和 make。
zh.hot: 作为 NSA 开源的免费逆向工程利器，Ghidra 长期是安全研究者的首选，本月新增 7897 星、总数达 82753，稳居 GitHub Trending 月榜第 21 名。
uses: 安全研究员与逆向工程师分析恶意软件、漏洞与闭源二进制
CTF 选手与网络安全学习者练习逆向与漏洞挖掘
企业安全团队在授权范围内审计第三方软件与固件
开发者用 Java/Python 编写 Ghidra 扩展或自动化分析脚本

en.tag: NSA's open-source, high-end software reverse engineering framework
en.what: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework created and maintained by the NSA Research Directorate, offering disassembly, assembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting. It supports a wide range of processor instruction sets and executable formats, runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux in both interactive and automated modes, and lets users build extensions or scripts in Java or Python.
en.content: The repo contains the full Ghidra source tree, Gradle build scripts, feature modules (such as Features/Base), and official documentation, letting you build a development version or grab the official multi-platform release.
en.stack: Primarily written in Java, with builds requiring JDK 25, Gradle 9.1.0+, and Python3 (3.9–3.14); GCC/Clang and make are needed on Linux/macOS.
en.hot: As a free, NSA-backed reverse engineering powerhouse, Ghidra remains a top choice for security researchers, gaining 7,897 stars this month for a total of 82,753 and ranking 21st on GitHub Trending monthly.
uses: Security researchers and reverse engineers analyzing malware, vulnerabilities, and closed-source binaries
CTF players and cybersecurity learners practicing reverse engineering and exploit discovery
Enterprise security teams auditing third-party software and firmware within authorized scope
Developers writing Ghidra extensions or automation scripts in Java/Python

zh.tag: 纯 C 无依赖，从磁盘流式加载专家，在自有硬件上跑前沿 MoE 大模型
zh.what: colibri 是一个用纯 C 编写的极简推理引擎，让普通电脑也能运行数百亿参数级别的开源 MoE 大模型。它利用 MoE 每个 token 只激活一小部分专家的特性，把常驻部分放在内存、其余专家按需从磁盘流式读取，因此无需 GPU。
zh.content: 仓库按模型家族组织，每个家族一个 C 文件，目前包含 13 个引擎：10 个语言模型引擎（GLM、Kimi、DeepSeek、Qwen、OLMoE 等）、1 个图像引擎（Qwen-Image）和 2 个决策模型引擎，另有网站、多语言 README 与一键启动脚本。
zh.stack: 纯 C 实现，无外部依赖，仅需 8GB 以上内存、约 22GB 磁盘空间和 Python 构建脚本；支持 Windows、Linux、macOS，GPU 可选。
zh.hot: 本月新增 13446 star、总数突破 4 万，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 18 名；它把「本地跑百亿级 MoE」从口号变成一行命令，直击显存焦虑与隐私需求。
uses: 想在普通笔记本或旧台式机上本地体验大模型的开发者
关注隐私、不愿把数据发给云端 API 的个人与团队
研究 MoE 推理与磁盘流式加载机制的系统工程师
需要低成本离线部署语言、图像或决策模型的爱好者

en.tag: Pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk — run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own
en.what: colibri is a tiny pure-C inference engine that runs very large open MoE models on ordinary machines. Exploiting the fact that a mixture-of-experts model only uses a small part of itself per token, it keeps that part in RAM and streams the remaining experts from disk, so no GPU is required.
en.content: The repo is organized one C file per model family, shipping 13 engines today: ten for language models (GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, OLMoE and more), one for images (Qwen-Image) and two decision models, plus a website, multilingual READMEs and one-step launch scripts.
en.stack: Written in pure C with zero dependencies; needs 8GB+ RAM, about 22GB free disk and Python for the build script, and runs on Windows, Linux and macOS with an optional GPU.
en.hot: It gained 13,446 stars this month for a total past 40k, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending monthly; it turns 'run hundred-billion-parameter MoE locally' into a single command, hitting both VRAM anxiety and privacy needs.
uses: Developers who want to run large models locally on a laptop or older desktop
Individuals and teams with privacy concerns who avoid cloud APIs
Systems engineers studying MoE inference and disk-streaming techniques
Hobbyists needing low-cost offline language, image or decision models

zh.tag: 523 节课、20 阶段的 AI 工程从零到上线开源课程
zh.what: 这是一套系统性的 AI 工程学习课程，覆盖从基础原理到实际部署的完整链路，强调「学它、造它、交付它」。每节课都产出一个可复用产物，如提示词、技能、智能体或 MCP 服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 523 节课、20 个阶段、约 342 小时内容，配有网站、路线图、多语言 README 与 i18n 翻译分支，以及 assets 中的横幅等资源。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，课程同时覆盖 TypeScript、Rust 和 Julia，采用 MIT 许可证，配套静态网站与构建脚本。
zh.hot: 凭借 53694 颗星、今日新增 343 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名，它切中了「84% 学生用 AI 但仅 18% 自认能专业使用」的痛点。
uses: 想系统入门 AI 工程的学生与转行者，按阶段循序渐进学习
需要把 AI 能力落地到产品的开发者，直接复用课程产出的提示词与智能体
团队技术负责人，用课程作为内部培训与工程规范参考
希望用多语言材料教学的教师，可借助 i18n 分支与翻译页面

en.tag: A 523-lesson, 20-phase open-source curriculum for AI engineering from scratch
en.what: A systematic AI engineering curriculum covering the full path from fundamentals to deployment, built around the motto 'Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.' Every lesson ships a reusable artifact such as a prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server.
en.content: The repo holds 523 lessons across 20 phases (~342 hours), plus a website, roadmap, multilingual READMEs, an i18n translations branch, and assets like the banner.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with lessons also covering TypeScript, Rust, and Julia; MIT-licensed with a companion static site and build scripts.
en.hot: With 53,694 stars, +343 today, and #11 on GitHub Trending daily, it hits the gap that '84% of students use AI tools but only 18% feel prepared to use them professionally.'
uses: Students and career switchers wanting a structured, phase-by-phase intro to AI engineering
Developers shipping AI features who can reuse the prompts, skills, and agents each lesson produces
Tech leads using it as an internal training and engineering-standards reference
Instructors teaching in multiple languages via the i18n branch and translated pages

zh.tag: 把自然语言指令变成可靠的安卓自动化操作
zh.what: ARTEMIS 是 Google 开源的安卓自动化代理，能把自然语言指令转化为可靠的端到端手机操作。它可跨应用执行测试与日常任务，捕获日志与截图，并在 AndroidWorld 基准上达到 99%+ 任务完成率。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 实现的代理核心、MCP 服务器、多模态定位模块、AndroidWorld 评测脚本，以及演示 GIF、文档（含中文 README）和 Discord 社区入口。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，采用 Apache-2.0 许可，原生支持 MCP，可调用 Gemini、Claude、GPT-4o、Qwen-VL 等多模态模型。
zh.hot: 本月新增 7039 星、总数 11549，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 22 名；Google 出品加上 99%+ AndroidWorld 成绩与 MCP 生态整合，正好切中 AI 编程助手操控真机的需求。
uses: 移动端 QA 与测试工程师，用自然语言驱动真机端到端测试
使用 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity 等 AI 编程助手的开发者，通过 MCP 接入设备调试
需要自动化跨应用日常任务或稳定性探索测试的团队
研究安卓 GUI 代理与多模态定位的 AI 研究者

en.tag: Turn natural-language instructions into reliable Android automation
en.what: ARTEMIS is Google's open-source Android automation agent that turns natural-language instructions into reliable end-to-end phone operations. It runs cross-app tests and everyday tasks, captures logs and screenshots, and hits 99%+ task completion on the AndroidWorld benchmark.
en.content: The repo ships the Python agent core, an MCP server, multimodal targeting modules, AndroidWorld evaluation scripts, plus demo GIFs, docs (including a Chinese README), and a Discord community link.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+ under Apache-2.0, MCP-native, and works with multimodal models like Gemini, Claude, GPT-4o, and Qwen-VL.
en.hot: It gained 7,039 stars this month (11,549 total), ranking #22 on GitHub Trending monthly; Google's backing, 99%+ AndroidWorld results, and MCP integration tap right into the demand for AI coding assistants driving real devices.

Developers using Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity who want MCP-based device debugging
Teams automating cross-app daily tasks or long-running stability exploration
AI researchers studying Android GUI agents and multimodal targeting

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个子 crate：gpui-base（无样式行为、状态和基础设施）、gpui-shell（JavaScript 扩展）、gpui-component（完整样式化 UI 系统）。主 crate 重新导出所有层，应用只需依赖 gpui-kit 即可。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。
希望复用 Zed 编辑器 UI 能力但不想直接依赖 Zed 的团队。
对 GPUI 感兴趣，想学习其架构或基于 gpui-base 自定义 UI 系统的开发者。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.
uses: Rust developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps with high performance and native feel.
Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.
Developers interested in GPUI, learning its architecture, or building custom UI systems on gpui-base.

zh.tag: 给 AI Agent 一键装上全网读取与搜索能力的 CLI 工具
zh.what: Agent Reach 是一个命令行工具，让 AI Agent 能够读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等主流平台的内容。它把当下最稳定的接入方式替你选好、装好并做好体检，且完全零 API 费用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式提供统一 CLI，包含多平台适配器、接入方式自动选择与体检逻辑，以及中英日韩多语言文档和赞助商展示。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，采用 MIT 许可，通过 CLI 封装各平台抓取与搜索接口，屏蔽底层接入方式的迭代变化。
zh.hot: 本周新增 6912 star，总量达 93593，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜第 6，并曾获 Trendshift 日榜第一，切中了 Agent 联网刚需。
uses: AI Agent 开发者，为智能体快速补齐多平台联网读取与搜索能力
做舆情、内容或竞品调研的团队，用一条 CLI 跨平台采集公开信息
想零 API 成本接入社交与视频平台数据的个人研究者与独立开发者

en.tag: A CLI that gives your AI agent eyes to read and search the entire internet
en.what: Agent Reach is a CLI that lets AI agents read and search content across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu and more. It picks, installs and health-checks the most reliable access methods for you, with zero API fees.
en.content: The repo ships a unified Python CLI with multi-platform adapters, automatic access-method selection and health checks, plus multilingual docs (EN/JP/KR) and sponsor sections.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+ under the MIT license, it wraps each platform's scraping and search interfaces behind a CLI that hides underlying access-method churn.
en.hot: It gained 6,912 stars this week to reach 93,593 total, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending weekly and previously #1 daily on Trendshift, hitting the core need for agent internet access.
uses: AI agent developers who need to quickly add multi-platform internet reading and search to their agents
Teams doing sentiment, content or competitor research who want cross-platform public data via one CLI
Individual researchers and indie developers wanting zero-API-cost access to social and video platform data

zh.tag: 用树形索引与推理取代向量检索的无向量 RAG 方案
zh.what: PageIndex 是一个面向长文档与专业文档的 RAG 框架，主张「相似度不等于相关性」，用 LLM 推理替代向量相似度检索。它先为每篇文档生成层级树状索引，再让智能体在树上推理式地定位并阅读正确章节，像人类专家翻阅长报告那样完成检索。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 实现为主，包含 PageIndex SDK（pip 安装，支持本地模式与云端模式）、面向文本 PDF 的快速树索引生成器 PageIndex Flash、可扩展到百万文档的文件系统级索引层，以及长文档分析应用 PageIndex App。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，通过 pip 安装 pageindex 包；本地模式需自备 LLM API Key，也可切换到 PageIndex Cloud 使用 API Key，配套网站、文档与博客。
zh.hot: 项目已积累 37390 颗星，今日新增 835 星并冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名，说明「无向量、无分块、靠推理检索」这一反主流思路正切中长文档 RAG 精度痛点。
uses: 需要处理合同、财报、论文等长专业文档的 RAG 开发者
对向量检索精度不满、想尝试推理式检索的研究与工程团队
希望本地私有化部署文档索引与问答的企业用户
想了解无向量 RAG 架构思路的 AI 应用学习者

en.tag: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG that replaces vector search with a hierarchical tree index
en.what: PageIndex is a RAG framework for long, professional documents that argues similarity is not relevance, replacing vector similarity search with LLM reasoning. It first builds a hierarchical tree index for each document, then lets an agent reason its way through that tree to find and read the right section, much like a human expert navigating a long report.
en.content: The repo is primarily Python and ships the PageIndex SDK (pip-installable, with local and cloud modes), PageIndex Flash for fast tree index generation on text-based PDFs, a file-level indexing layer that scales to millions of documents, and the PageIndex App for long-document analysis.
en.stack: Written in Python and installed via pip as the pageindex package; local mode requires your own LLM API key, while the same client can point at PageIndex Cloud with an API key, backed by a website, docs, and blog.
en.hot: With 37,390 stars and 835 added today, landing at #11 on GitHub Trending, it shows the contrarian 'no vector DB, no chunking, reasoning-based retrieval' idea resonates with pain points in long-document RAG accuracy.
uses: RAG developers working with long professional documents like contracts, financial reports, and papers
Research and engineering teams frustrated with vector retrieval accuracy who want reasoning-based retrieval
Enterprises needing locally deployed, private document indexing and Q&A
AI application learners curious about vectorless RAG architectures

zh.tag: 配置与监控 Claude Code 的 CLI 工具
zh.what: 这是一个用于配置和监控 Claude Code 的命令行工具，帮助用户管理 Claude Code 的模板、设置和运行状态。它提供了便捷的安装、配置和监控功能，提升 Claude Code 的使用体验。

zh.hot: 凭借近 3.1 万星标和日增 33 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Python 第 13 名，反映出 Claude Code 生态的高关注度。

开发者 —— 集成 Claude Code 到开发工作流中

en.tag: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code
en.what: A CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code, helping users manage templates, settings, and runtime status. It provides convenient installation, configuration, and monitoring to enhance the Claude Code experience.

Teams — uniformly manage Claude Code templates and settings

zh.tag: AI 代理技能安装前的安全扫描器
zh.what: SkillSpector 是 NVIDIA 推出的 AI 代理技能安全扫描器，在安装 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 和 MCP 技能前检测漏洞、恶意模式、提示注入、数据外泄与供应链风险。它属于 NVIDIA Verified Skills 流水线，用于扫描、评估并签名代理技能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 扫描器源码、71 种漏洞模式的分析规则、两阶段分析流水线、多格式报告输出，以及 docs 下的开发指南、资源边界、Pi/OpenCode 扩展和误报抑制文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，结合静态分析、AST、污点追踪、YARA 签名与可选 LLM 语义评估，并接入 OSV.dev 实时 CVE 查询。
zh.hot: 随着代理技能生态爆发，其研究数据显示 31,132 个技能中 26.1% 含漏洞、5.2% 疑似恶意，切中安装前的安全刚需，因而迅速登上 GitHub 日榜 Python 第 5 名，收获 17,770 星。
uses: AI 代理用户：在安装 Claude Code、Codex 或 MCP 技能前做安全体检
平台与安全团队：为技能市场建立扫描、签名与准入流水线
开发者：用 SARIF/JSON 报告集成 CI，拦截供应链风险
安全研究者：分析提示注入、数据外泄等代理特有攻击面

en.tag: Security scanner for AI agent skills before installation
en.what: SkillSpector is NVIDIA's security scanner for AI agent skills, detecting vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks before you install skills for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and MCP. It is part of the NVIDIA Verified Skills pipeline that scans, evaluates, and signs agent skills before publication.
en.content: The repo contains the Python scanner source, analysis rules for 71 vulnerability patterns, a two-stage analysis pipeline, multi-format report output, and docs covering development, resource bounds, Pi/OpenCode extensions, and false-positive suppression.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+ under Apache 2.0, combining static analysis, AST, taint tracking, YARA signatures, optional LLM semantic evaluation, and live CVE lookups via OSV.dev.
en.hot: As the agent-skill ecosystem explodes, its research showing 26.1% of 31,132 skills contain vulnerabilities and 5.2% show likely malicious intent addresses a pressing pre-install security need, propelling it to No.5 on GitHub's Python daily trending with 17,770 stars.
uses: AI agent users: vet Claude Code, Codex, or MCP skills before installing them
Platform and security teams: build scanning, signing, and gating pipelines for skill marketplaces
Developers: integrate SARIF/JSON reports into CI to block supply-chain risks
Security researchers: study agent-specific attack surfaces like prompt injection and data exfiltration

zh.tag: 自适应网页抓取框架，从单次请求到大规模爬取
zh.what: Scrapling 是一个自适应的网页抓取框架，能够处理从单个请求到全站爬取的各种任务。它旨在简化现代网页的抓取工作，提供高效且灵活的数据提取方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心抓取引擎、自适应解析器、爬虫调度模块、命令行工具以及丰富的文档和示例。还提供了 Docker 镜像和多种语言 README。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 开发，依赖包括 requests、lxml、parsel 等常见抓取库，并支持异步和分布式爬取。
zh.hot: 凭借其自适应能力和易用性，Scrapling 在 GitHub 上获得了 84536 颗星，本月新增 7665 星，位列 Python 月榜第 11 名，深受开发者欢迎。
uses: 数据工程师和爬虫开发者 —— 需要高效抓取网页数据
数据科学家和分析师 —— 快速获取网络数据用于分析
初创公司和中小企业 —— 构建数据采集管道

en.tag: Adaptive web scraping framework from single request to full-scale crawl

en.tag: NVIDIA's unified library for model compression and inference acceleration

en.hot: As an official NVIDIA library, it bridges training and deployment quantization pipelines for TensorRT-LLM/vLLM, meeting the pressing need to cut LLM inference costs. It gained 44 stars today to rank #5 on GitHub Trending, with about 4,081 stars total.
uses: LLM inference deployment engineers who need to quantize models for TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and similar frameworks
Model compression and optimization researchers reproducing SOTA quantization, distillation, pruning, and NAS techniques

Application developers aiming to reduce memory footprint and inference cost while preserving accuracy

构建高并发、可观测服务的平台与基础设施工程师
希望统一 schema 校验与追踪的 Node.js 应用开发者
评估 Effect 4.x LTS 并计划长期生产落地的技术负责人

en.tag: A full-featured effect system for production-grade TypeScript apps
en.what: Effect is a library for building robust, maintainable, type-safe, and production-grade applications in TypeScript. It unifies hard problems at scale—typed errors, dependency injection, structured concurrency, scheduling, tracing, and unified schema validation—into one set of abstractions.
en.content: The repo is a monorepo centered on the core effect package, plus many integration packages such as @effect/sql and @effect/platform, along with docs, migration guides, and examples.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript 5.9+ (TS 7 recommended), runs on Node.js 18+ with some integrations requiring newer runtimes, and requires strict type-checking enabled.
en.hot: With 896 stars added this week and over 17k total, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending's TypeScript weekly list, it reflects strong demand for production-grade error handling and concurrency abstractions in the TS community.
uses: TypeScript backend teams needing typed errors and dependency injection
Platform and infrastructure engineers building concurrent, observable services
Node.js developers wanting unified schema validation and tracing
Tech leads evaluating Effect 4.x LTS for long-term production adoption

zh.tag: 开源多模型 AI 聊天平台，支持 Agents、MCP 与自托管
zh.what: LibreChat 是一个增强版 ChatGPT 克隆，把 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、DeepSeek 等多家模型统一到一个界面中。它支持 Agents、MCP、技能、代码解释器、Artifacts 与多用户安全认证，可完全自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 前端 client、Node 后端 api、packages 共享模块、配置文件与 Docker 部署脚本，并提供完整文档与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为主，前端使用 React，后端基于 Node.js/Express，集成 LangChain、MCP 与多家模型 API，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.hot: 凭借多模型聚合、Agents/MCP 新特性与活跃更新，项目已获 45,135 星，本月新增 2,899 星，位列 GitHub Trending TypeScript 月榜第 7。
uses: 希望统一管理多家大模型 API 的个人开发者与团队
需要私有化部署 AI 聊天平台的企业与组织
想体验 Agents、MCP、代码解释器等高级功能的 AI 爱好者
为多用户提供安全 AI 服务的自托管运维人员

en.tag: Open-source multi-model AI chat platform with Agents, MCP and self-hosting
en.what: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that unifies models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek and more into one interface. It supports Agents, MCP, Skills, Code Interpreter, Artifacts and secure multi-user auth, and can be fully self-hosted.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript client, Node api backend, shared packages, config files and Docker deployment scripts, along with full docs and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built mainly with TypeScript, using React on the frontend and Node.js/Express on the backend, integrating LangChain, MCP and multiple model APIs, with Docker self-hosting support.
en.hot: With multi-model aggregation, new Agents/MCP features and active updates, it has reached 45,135 stars, adding 2,899 this month and ranking 7th on GitHub Trending TypeScript monthly.
uses: Individual developers and teams wanting to manage multiple LLM APIs in one place
Enterprises and organizations needing a privately deployed AI chat platform
AI enthusiasts eager to try Agents, MCP, Code Interpreter and other advanced features
Self-hosting operators providing secure AI services to multiple users

zh.tag: GitHub PR/Issue 上的通用 Claude Code 自动化代理
zh.what: 这是一个 GitHub Action，把 Claude Code 接入 PR 和 Issue 流程，能回答问题、审查代码并直接实现代码修改。它会根据工作流上下文智能判断激活时机，比如 @claude 提及、Issue 指派或显式自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 源码为主，包含 GitHub Action 定义、文档目录（迁移指南、云厂商配置、解决方案示例）以及测试与工作流配置。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 GitHub Actions 构建，依赖 Claude Code SDK，支持 Anthropic 直连 API、Amazon Bedrock、Google Vertex AI 和 Microsoft Foundry 等多种认证方式。
zh.hot: 近万 star 且本月新增 658，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 TypeScript 第 13 名，反映出开发者对把 AI 代理嵌入 PR/Issue 自动化流程的强烈需求。
uses: 希望在 PR 和 Issue 中自动获得代码审查与修复建议的开发者
想用 @claude 提及方式让 AI 直接实现小功能或重构的团队
需要为外部贡献者或关键路径变更定制自动化审查流程的维护者
使用 Bedrock、Vertex AI 或 Foundry 等企业云环境并希望自托管运行的团队

en.tag: A general-purpose Claude Code action for GitHub PRs and issues
en.what: A GitHub Action that brings Claude Code into PR and issue workflows to answer questions, review code, and implement changes. It intelligently detects when to activate based on workflow context, such as @claude mentions, issue assignments, or explicit automation prompts.
en.content: The repo is primarily TypeScript source, with the GitHub Action definition, docs (migration guide, cloud provider setup, solutions examples), tests, and workflow configs.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and GitHub Actions, powered by the Claude Code SDK, and supports multiple auth methods including Anthropic direct API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry.
en.hot: With nearly 9.5k stars and 658 added this month, it ranks 13th on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript list, reflecting strong demand for embedding AI agents into PR/issue automation.
uses: Developers who want automated code review and fix suggestions in PRs and issues
Teams that want to mention @claude to have AI implement small features or refactors directly
Maintainers needing custom automated review flows for external contributors or critical path changes
Teams on Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Foundry that want self-hosted execution on their own runners

zh.tag: 修复 X/Twitter 与 Bluesky 链接预览的嵌入服务
zh.what: FxEmbed 通过在链接前加前缀（如 fixup、fx）把 X/Twitter 和 Bluesky 的帖子转换成富媒体嵌入，让 Discord、Telegram 等平台能显示多图、视频、投票、引用和翻译。它同时提供 FxTwitter、FixupX 和 FxBluesky 三个域名服务。
zh.content: 仓库是 TypeScript 编写的 Cloudflare Worker 项目，包含 API 路由、各域名 realm 处理、品牌与本地化配置，以及 Docker/Wrangler 自托管文件和测试工作流。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Cloudflare Workers，使用 esbuild 构建，通过 Wrangler 部署，支持 Docker Compose 自托管，并接入 Crowdin 做多语言翻译。
zh.hot: 它解决了社交平台链接预览长期残缺的痛点，已获 5367 星，今日新增 182 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6 名。
uses: Discord 与 Telegram 社区管理员，希望频道内 X/Bluesky 链接能完整显示媒体内容
普通用户想在不离开聊天软件的情况下查看推文的多图、视频和投票
开发者可基于其公开 API 或自托管方案，把嵌入能力集成进自己的应用
关注链接预览与社交数据抓取的技术爱好者，可参考其 Worker 架构与多域名路由设计

en.tag: Embed fixer for X/Twitter and Bluesky link previews
en.what: FxEmbed rewrites X/Twitter and Bluesky links with prefixes like fixup and fx to produce rich embeds, so Discord, Telegram and others can show multiple images, videos, polls, quotes and translations. It powers the FxTwitter, FixupX and FxBluesky domains.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript Cloudflare Worker project with API routes, per-domain realm handling, branding and localization configs, plus Docker/Wrangler self-hosting files and test workflows.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Cloudflare Workers, bundled with esbuild, deployed via Wrangler, self-hostable with Docker Compose, and localized through Crowdin.
en.hot: It solves the long-standing pain of broken social link previews, with 5,367 stars, 182 added today, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Discord and Telegram community admins who want X/Bluesky links to show full media in channels
Everyday users who want to view tweet images, videos and polls without leaving their chat app
Developers who can integrate embed capabilities into their own apps via the public API or self-hosting
Link-preview and social-scraping enthusiasts interested in its Worker architecture and multi-domain routing

zh.tag: 开源自主编码代理，覆盖 IDE、终端与桌面
zh.what: Cline 是一个开源的自主编码代理，能读写文件、执行命令、浏览网页并调用工具，全程可人工审批。它以 VS Code/JetBrains 插件、CLI、桌面应用和 SDK 多种形态提供同一套代理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库按产品线组织：sdk/ 提供 Node.js 编程式代理 API，apps/cli/ 是终端 UI 与无头模式，另有 VS Code 扩展、JetBrains 插件和 macOS/Windows 桌面应用。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 生态；CLI 通过 npm 全局安装，SDK 以 @cline/sdk 包发布，支持 MCP 服务器与自定义工具。
zh.hot: 68,377 颗星、日增 112 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 20，说明多形态统一代理引擎的定位持续吸引开发者。
uses: 想在 VS Code 或 JetBrains 里获得可审批自主编码助手的开发者
需要在 CI/CD 或脚本中使用无头编码代理的工程团队
希望基于同一引擎构建自定义 AI 代理与集成的开发者
偏好桌面应用管理模型、插件与 MCP 服务器的进阶用户

en.tag: Open-source autonomous coding agent for IDE, terminal, and desktop
en.what: Cline is an open-source autonomous coding agent that can create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval. It ships the same agent engine as VS Code/JetBrains extensions, a CLI, a desktop app, and an SDK.
en.content: The repo is organized by product line: sdk/ offers a Node.js programmatic agent API, apps/cli/ holds the terminal UI and headless mode, plus VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and macOS/Windows desktop app.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript on the Node.js ecosystem; the CLI installs globally via npm and the SDK ships as @cline/sdk, with support for MCP servers and custom tools.
en.hot: With 68,377 stars, +112 today, and a #20 spot on GitHub Trending daily, its multi-surface unified agent engine keeps drawing developers.
uses: Developers wanting an approval-gated autonomous coding assistant in VS Code or JetBrains
Engineering teams needing a headless coding agent for CI/CD or scripting
Developers building custom AI agents and integrations on the same engine
Power users preferring a desktop app to manage models, plugins, and MCP servers

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的一体化 Office 运行时 SDK
zh.what: Univer 是一个开源 Office SDK，让开发者把电子表格、文档、演示、看板、关系表与 PDF 等办公能力嵌入到自己的产品中。它定位为「AI 代理的 Office 载体」，为智能体提供可编程的办公文档运行时。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 包形式组织，包含核心引擎、插件模块、公式引擎、Canvas 渲染层与统一 Facade API，并配有 docs 文档、示例与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，基于 Canvas 渲染与插件化架构，提供浏览器与 Node.js 通用的 Facade API，依赖 pnpm 工作区与 CI/CD 工具链。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1082 star、总数 17654，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3，AI 代理与办公自动化结合是当前热点，Univer 正好卡住这一需求。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为智能体提供可读写电子表格与文档的运行时
SaaS 产品团队：在自有应用中嵌入表格、文档与演示编辑能力
低代码/协作平台：基于插件架构定制办公组件
研究者与学习者：研究 Canvas 渲染、公式引擎与 Office 文档模型

en.tag: The Office Harness for AI Agents — one runtime for docs, sheets, slides
en.what: Univer is an open-source Office SDK that lets developers embed spreadsheet, document, presentation, board, relational-table and PDF experiences directly into their own products. Positioned as the Office Harness for AI Agents, it gives agents a programmable runtime for office documents.
en.content: The repo is organized as TypeScript packages: a core engine, plugin modules, a formula engine, a Canvas rendering layer and a unified Facade API, plus docs, examples and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript with Canvas-based rendering and a plugin architecture, exposing one Facade API for both browser and Node.js, managed via pnpm workspaces and CI/CD tooling.
en.hot: With 1,082 stars added today and 17,654 total, it hit #3 on GitHub Trending daily — riding the hot intersection of AI agents and office automation.
uses: AI agent developers: give agents a runtime to read and write spreadsheets and docs
SaaS product teams: embed spreadsheet, document and presentation editing in their apps
Low-code/collaboration platforms: customize office components via the plugin architecture
Researchers and learners: study Canvas rendering, formula engines and office document models

zh.tag: 开源免费的实时行情追踪与公司洞察平台
zh.what: OpenStock 是昂贵金融行情平台的开源替代品，支持追踪实时股价、设置个性化提醒，并查看详细的公司信息。项目由 Open Dev Society 公开构建，承诺永久免费，面向所有投资者开放。
zh.content: 仓库为 TypeScript 前端项目，包含仪表盘等界面资源（如 public/assets/images/dashboard.png），并配有 Star History、Trendshift 等徽章展示热度。整体以 Web 应用形态呈现，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，属于前端/全栈 Web 应用，依赖现代 JS 生态构建界面与数据展示。采用 AGPL-3.0 许可，修改或部署为服务需开源并署名。
zh.hot: 已获约 16,050 颗星，今日新增 472 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6。免费替代付费行情平台的定位切中痛点，加上开源社区运营，推动其快速走红。
uses: 个人投资者：免费追踪实时股价并设置价格提醒
开发者：基于 TypeScript 二次开发或自建行情看板
开源爱好者：参与 Open Dev Society 的公开协作项目
预算有限的小团队：替代昂贵的商业行情平台

en.tag: A free, open-source alternative to pricey market data platforms
en.what: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms, letting users track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights. Built openly by Open Dev Society, it is promised to stay free forever for everyone.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript web app containing UI assets such as the dashboard screenshot in public/assets/images, plus Star History and Trendshift badges. It ships as a web application under the AGPL-3.0 license.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, it is a front-end/full-stack web app built on the modern JS ecosystem for UI and data display. Licensed AGPL-3.0, requiring source release and attribution if modified or deployed as a service.
en.hot: It has around 16,050 stars with 472 added today, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending daily. Its pitch as a free replacement for paid market platforms hits a real pain point, and open community building fuels the surge.
uses: Individual investors: track real-time prices and set alerts for free
Developers: fork or extend the TypeScript codebase for custom dashboards
Open-source enthusiasts: contribute to Open Dev Society's public project
Budget-limited small teams: replace costly commercial market platforms

zh.tag: 终端里的视频下载器，粘贴链接即可保存 1800+ 网站视频
zh.what: yoinks 是一个命令行视频下载工具，支持 YouTube、X/Twitter、Instagram、Threads、TikTok 等 1800 多个网站。粘贴链接后选择分辨率或纯音频 mp3，即可直接下载到本地，全程无广告弹窗和诱导按钮。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 TypeScript CLI 项目，核心是 Ink 构建的全屏终端界面（含格式选择器、主题切换、鼠标点击支持），底层调用 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，并附带 logo 与界面截图等资源。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Node 18+，UI 用 Ink（终端版 React），下载依赖 yt-dlp 独立二进制，ffmpeg 取自 PATH 或以 ffmpeg-static 兜底，构建用 tsup。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2732 star、总数 5197，冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 8。它精准击中「网页下载站广告满天飞」的痛点，用 npx 一行即可零安装体验，加上精致的终端 UI，传播力极强。
uses: 经常从视频网站存档素材、需要批量保存内容的自媒体与研究者
讨厌网页下载站广告和假按钮、偏好命令行的开发者
想在服务器或无图形界面环境里下载视频的用户
需要把视频转成 mp3 音频做播客或听书素材的人

en.tag: Terminal video downloader — paste a link, yoink it from 1,800+ sites
en.what: yoinks is a command-line video downloader supporting YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, Threads, TikTok and 1,800+ other sites. Paste a URL, pick a resolution or audio-only mp3, and it downloads straight to your machine — no popups, fake buttons, or sketchy redirects.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript CLI project whose core is a full-screen Ink terminal UI (format picker, theme cycling, mouse-clickable controls) wrapping yt-dlp and ffmpeg, plus logo and screenshot assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript on Node 18+, UI via Ink (React for the terminal), downloads powered by the standalone yt-dlp binary, ffmpeg from PATH or bundled ffmpeg-static, bundled with tsup.
en.hot: It gained 2,732 stars this week (5,197 total), landing at #8 on GitHub Trending weekly. It nails the pain of ad-ridden download sites, runs instantly via npx with zero install, and pairs that with a polished terminal UI — a highly shareable combo.
uses: Creators and researchers who archive video content and need to save media regularly
Developers who hate ad-filled download sites and prefer the command line
Users downloading videos on servers or headless environments without a GUI
Anyone extracting mp3 audio from videos for podcasts or listening material

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理直接操控你已登录的真实浏览器
zh.what: BrowserSkill 把 AI 代理连接到 Chrome 或 Microsoft Edge，直接复用你已登录的账号状态，完成读页面、填表单、走流程、长截图和排查请求等任务。任务在独立的可见 Agent Window 中运行，必要时可临时借用并归还你现有的标签页。
zh.content: 仓库包含 bsk CLI（内置后台守护进程）、浏览器扩展和教代理如何使用它的 skill，另附 DeepSeek Harness 专用插件、文档与变更日志。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，CLI/守护进程支持 macOS、Linux 与 Windows，扩展基于 Chromium 125+ 的 Chrome 与 Edge。
zh.hot: 本月新增 6788 颗星，总量达 8644，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 TypeScript 第 18 名，切中了代理需要真实登录态浏览器的刚需。
uses: 想让 AI 代理代操作内网或需登录网站的开发者
用 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等 shell 代理做网页自动化的人
需要带证据排查前端请求、慢接口与重复请求的工程师
希望代理任务可见、可接管登录验证的谨慎用户

en.tag: Let AI agents drive your real, logged-in browser
en.what: BrowserSkill connects AI agents to Chrome or Microsoft Edge and reuses your existing logged-in accounts to read pages, fill forms, complete web workflows, take long screenshots, and investigate failing requests. Tasks run in a separate visible Agent Window, and an existing tab can be borrowed and returned when the task ends.
en.content: The repo ships a bsk CLI with a built-in background daemon, a browser extension, and a skill that teaches agents how to use it, plus a dedicated DeepSeek Harness plugin, docs, and a changelog.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript; the CLI/daemon supports macOS, Linux, and Windows, while the extension targets Chrome and Edge on Chromium 125+.
en.hot: It gained 6,788 stars this month for a total of 8,644, landing at #18 on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript chart by solving agents' need for a real logged-in browser.
uses: Developers who want AI agents to operate internal or login-gated sites
Users of shell-capable agents like Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex doing web automation
Engineers debugging frontend requests, slow APIs, and duplicate calls with evidence
Cautious users who want visible agent tasks and human takeover for login or verification

zh.tag: 让智能体与 UI 共享同一套动作层的 TypeScript 框架
zh.what: Agent-Native 是一个开源 TypeScript 框架，用于构建既有自主执行能力、又配有专用界面的智能体应用。它把每项能力定义成一次 action，智能体将其当作工具调用，UI 则从代码中调用同一实现。
zh.content: 仓库提供核心包 @agent-native/core 与 CLI 脚手架，含 actions 定义、服务端数据库、上下文感知等模块，并附带 chat 等起步模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Node.js，使用 zod 做参数校验，动作可同时暴露为 HTTP、MCP、A2A 与 CLI 接口，前端以 React 的 useActionQuery 调用。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2443 star、总数达 7131，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 月榜第 22 名，反映出开发者对「智能体 + 界面」一体化开发范式的强烈需求。
uses: 想为智能体产品快速搭建可视化界面的前端与全栈开发者
需要让 AI 能力同时被智能体和用户界面复用的团队
希望用统一动作层对接 MCP、A2A、HTTP 与 CLI 多端出口的工程师
正在评估智能体应用架构、寻找开箱即用脚手架的技术负责人

en.tag: A TypeScript framework where agents and UI share one action layer
en.what: Agent-Native is an open-source TypeScript framework for building agents that pair autonomous work with a purpose-built UI. Each capability is defined once as an action: the agent uses it as a tool, and the UI calls it from code.
en.content: The repo ships the @agent-native/core package and CLI scaffolding, with modules for action definitions, server database, and context awareness, plus starter templates such as chat.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript and Node.js with zod for validation; actions can be exposed over HTTP, MCP, A2A, and CLI, while React calls them via useActionQuery.
en.hot: It gained 2,443 stars this month for a total of 7,131, ranking 22nd on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript list, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent-plus-UI development paradigm.
uses: Frontend and full-stack developers who want a visual UI for their agent products
Teams that need AI capabilities reused by both agents and user interfaces
Engineers wanting one action layer exposed over MCP, A2A, HTTP, and CLI
Tech leads evaluating agent app architecture and seeking ready-made scaffolding

zh.tag: 并行编码代理的桌面编排工作台
zh.what: Orca 是一个面向 AI 代理的 ADE（代理开发环境），让你同时运行 Codex、ClaudeCode、OpenCode、Pi 等多个编码代理，每个代理在独立的 git worktree 中工作，并在统一界面里追踪进度。它支持桌面端、移动端与远程运行时，并可直接使用你自己的订阅。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面应用（macOS/Windows/Linux）、iOS/Android 移动伴侣应用、远程运行时，以及多语言 README 与文档站点资源。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 为主，基于 Electron 风格的桌面应用与移动端伴侣应用，围绕 git worktree 隔离与多代理进程编排构建。
zh.hot: 本月新增 24293 star、总量突破 9.1 万，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 月榜第 21 名，反映出开发者对“并行代理编排”这一刚需的强烈关注。
uses: 同时管理多个编码代理、需要并行对比结果的开发者
希望用自己订阅运行代理、避免额外 API 费用的团队
需要在手机上监控和跟进代理进度的远程工作者
想用 git worktree 隔离实验、快速合并优胜方案的工程师

en.tag: A desktop ADE for orchestrating fleets of parallel coding agents
en.what: Orca is an ADE (Agent Development Environment) that lets you run multiple coding agents such as Codex, ClaudeCode, OpenCode and Pi side-by-side, each in its own isolated git worktree, all tracked in one place. It works on desktop, mobile and remote runtimes, and runs on your own subscription.
en.content: The repo contains a cross-platform desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), an iOS/Android mobile companion app, a remote runtime, plus multilingual READMEs and docs site assets.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built as a desktop app with a mobile companion, centered on git worktree isolation and multi-agent process orchestration.
en.hot: It gained 24,293 stars this month, pushing the total past 91k and landing at #21 on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript list, reflecting strong demand for parallel agent orchestration.
uses: Developers who run multiple coding agents and want to compare results in parallel
Teams that prefer using their own subscriptions instead of paying extra API costs
Remote workers who want to monitor and steer agents from their phones
Engineers who isolate experiments with git worktrees and merge the winning branch

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理跨平台操控 iOS/Android 设备的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: mobile-mcp 是一个基于 Model Context Protocol 的服务器，为 AI 代理和 LLM 提供统一的移动端自动化接口。它屏蔽了 iOS 与 Android 的差异，让代理通过无障碍快照或基于截图的坐标点击来操作原生应用与设备。支持模拟器、仿真器和真机。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 TypeScript 实现的 MCP 服务器，包含 iOS/Android 设备控制工具、无障碍快照与截图点击逻辑，并提供多语言 README、Wiki 文档和 npm 包 @mobilenext/mobile-mcp。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，通过 npm 分发（npx 即可运行），依赖 MCP 协议与各平台设备控制接口，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、GitHub Copilot 等 MCP 客户端。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2444 star，总 star 达 9101，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 TypeScript 第 22 名。移动端自动化与 AI 代理结合是当下热点，而它用一个统一接口解决了 iOS/Android 双端适配的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者，想让 LLM 直接操作移动应用
移动端测试与自动化工程师，需要跨 iOS/Android 的统一脚本
做移动端爬虫或数据采集的团队
想快速在模拟器/真机上验证 AI 交互原型的产品团队

en.tag: An MCP server that lets AI agents drive iOS and Android devices cross-platform
en.what: mobile-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents and LLMs a unified interface for mobile automation. It hides iOS/Android differences, letting agents interact with native apps and devices via accessibility snapshots or screenshot-based coordinate taps. It works on simulators, emulators, and real devices.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript MCP server containing iOS/Android device-control tools, accessibility-snapshot and screenshot-tap logic, plus multilingual READMEs, a wiki, and the npm package @mobilenext/mobile-mcp.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript and distributed via npm (runnable with npx), it relies on the MCP protocol and platform device-control interfaces, and works with MCP clients like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and GitHub Copilot.
en.hot: It gained 2,444 stars this month, reaching 9,101 total and ranking 22nd on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript list. Mobile automation plus AI agents is a hot area, and it solves the pain of dual iOS/Android support with one unified interface.
uses: AI agent developers who want LLMs to operate mobile apps directly
Mobile test and automation engineers needing unified iOS/Android scripts
Teams doing mobile scraping or data collection
Product teams prototyping AI interactions on simulators or real devices

zh.tag: 把 ChatGPT 网页版（含 Pro）接入 Codex 原生模型选择器，不消耗 Codex 额度
zh.what: 这是一个让 Codex 直接调用 ChatGPT 网页版模型的桥接工具，包括 Pro 档位，走 ChatGPT 网页版独立的用量额度，不占用 Work 或 Codex 配额。它保留 Codex 原有界面、任务、图片与流式输出，并通过 MCP 的 Full harness 模式把当前任务的文件夹、终端、工具和审批流程接给 ChatGPT。
zh.content: 仓库提供 Windows/macOS/Linux 三平台启动器安装包（exe/dmg/AppImage），内置浏览器与运行时，无需另装 Chrome、Node 或 Bun；另含架构文档、故障排查文档和多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，通过 MCP 与 Codex 集成，内置浏览器运行时用于登录 ChatGPT 网页版；提供终端安装、更新与修复流程。
zh.hot: 本月新增 10765 star、总量 12844，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 TypeScript 第 8 名，核心吸引力在于用网页版额度跑 Codex 任务、省下 Codex 配额。
uses: 已有 ChatGPT 订阅（含 Pro）但 Codex 额度紧张的开发者
希望在 Codex 工作流里直接使用网页版模型与图片、流式输出的用户
需要让 ChatGPT 访问本地文件、终端和工具链的 MCP 玩家
想省下 Codex/Work 配额、把网页版额度用于编码任务的重度用户

en.tag: Use ChatGPT Web (incl. Pro) as a native model in Codex, without burning Codex quota
en.what: A bridge that lets Codex call ChatGPT Web models, including Pro, using ChatGPT Web's separate usage limits instead of your Work or Codex quota. It keeps Codex's native interface, tasks, images and streaming, and its Full harness mode wires ChatGPT to the current task's files, terminal, tools and approvals via MCP.
en.content: It ships launcher installers for Windows, macOS and Linux (exe/dmg/AppImage) with a bundled browser and runtime, so no separate Chrome, Node or Bun install is needed, plus architecture docs, a troubleshooting guide and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript, integrated with Codex through MCP, with an embedded browser runtime for signing in to ChatGPT Web; also offers terminal-based install, update and repair flows.
en.hot: It gained 10,765 stars this month for a total of 12,844, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript list, mainly because it lets you run Codex tasks on web-plan quota and save Codex credits.
uses: Developers with a ChatGPT plan (including Pro) who are short on Codex quota
Users who want web models with images and streaming inside the Codex workflow
MCP tinkerers who need ChatGPT to reach local files, terminal and tools
Heavy users who want to save Codex/Work credits by spending web-plan quota on coding

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: Vercel 出品的全栈 React 生产级框架
zh.what: Next.js 是构建全栈 Web 应用的主流 React 框架，在最新 React 特性之上提供路由、渲染、数据获取与构建等一体化能力。它集成基于 Rust 的 JavaScript 工具链，追求更快的构建与更完整的生产部署体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心源码、编译器与构建工具、示例项目、文档与测试套件，并配有贡献指南和 good first issues 列表。整体是一个由 Vercel 主导、社区共同维护的大型 monorepo。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript/TypeScript 为主，核心依赖 React，并内置基于 Rust 的 SWC 编译器与 Turbopack 构建工具。
zh.hot: 作为 React 生态的默认生产框架，它已积累 14.2 万+ star，本周仍新增 217 星并进入 JavaScript 周榜第 18 名。持续迭代与庞大企业采用度让它长期保持热度。
uses: 前端/全栈开发者构建 SSR、SSG 与混合渲染的 React 应用
需要 SEO 友好、首屏性能优秀的营销站与电商站点
团队希望用统一框架覆盖 API 路由与前端页面
想学习现代 React 工程化与生产部署的进阶学习者

en.tag: Vercel's production-grade full-stack React framework
en.what: Next.js is the leading React framework for building full-stack web applications, layering routing, rendering, data fetching and build tooling on top of the latest React features. It integrates Rust-based JavaScript tooling for faster builds and a more complete production deployment experience.
en.content: The repo holds the framework core, compiler and build tooling, examples, docs and test suites, plus contribution guidelines and a good first issues list. It is a large Vercel-led monorepo maintained together with the community.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript/TypeScript, built on React and shipping Rust-based tooling such as SWC and Turbopack.
en.hot: As the default production framework in the React ecosystem, it has accumulated over 142k stars, adding 217 this week to rank 18th on the JavaScript weekly chart. Continuous releases and heavy enterprise adoption keep it consistently hot.
uses: Frontend/full-stack developers building SSR, SSG and hybrid React apps
Marketing and e-commerce sites needing SEO-friendly, fast first paint
Teams wanting one framework for both API routes and frontend pages
Advanced learners studying modern React engineering and production deployment

zh.tag: 将编码代理转变为多阶段安全审计员的技能
zh.what: 这是一个编码代理技能，通过侦察、覆盖导向狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录验证和目标中立报告六个阶段，将代理转变为安全审计员。它编排隔离的代理进行漏洞发现，并生成机器可读的发现记录。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SKILL.md 主技能文件，以及针对不同阶段的提示文件如 RECONNAISSANCE.md、HUNTING.md、ATTACK-CLASSES.md，还有针对特定领域的 MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md、AI-AND-LLM.md、WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md、CLIENT-SIDE.md 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 运行验证脚本（如 validate-coverage-ledger.cjs 和 validate-findings.cjs），并遵循 JSON 模式进行结构化输出。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 1434 颗星，总星数达 5126，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 JavaScript 第 9 名。它源自 Cloudflare 的漏洞发现工具链，提供了可复用的安全审计技能，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 安全工程师和渗透测试人员 —— 利用代理自动化多阶段安全审计，提高漏洞发现效率。
AI 代理开发者 —— 集成此技能到编码代理中，增强其安全审计能力。
DevSecOps 团队 —— 在 CI/CD 流程中自动执行安全审计，生成结构化报告。
安全研究人员 —— 基于此技能构建自定义漏洞挖掘工具链。

en.tag: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a multi-phase security auditor
en.what: This is a coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor by orchestrating isolated agents through six phases: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. It produces machine-readable findings with independently verified claims.
en.content: The repo contains SKILL.md as the main skill file, along with phase-specific prompt files like RECONNAISSANCE.md, HUNTING.md, ATTACK-CLASSES.md, and domain-specific files such as MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md, AI-AND-LLM.md, WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md, and CLIENT-SIDE.md.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, it relies on Node.js for validation scripts (e.g., validate-coverage-ledger.cjs and validate-findings.cjs) and uses JSON schemas for structured output.
en.hot: It gained 1,434 stars today, reaching 5,126 total, and ranked 9th on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). It originated from Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, offering a reusable security audit skill that has attracted significant attention.
uses: Security engineers and penetration testers — automate multi-phase security audits with agents to improve vulnerability discovery efficiency.
AI agent developers — integrate this skill into coding agents to enhance their security auditing capabilities.
DevSecOps teams — automate security audits in CI/CD pipelines and generate structured reports.
Security researchers — build custom vulnerability hunting harnesses based on this skill.

zh.tag: Vercel 官方 AI 编码代理技能合集
zh.what: 这是 Vercel 官方推出的 AI 编码代理技能集合，把指令和脚本打包成可复用的技能，用来扩展代理的能力。技能遵循 Agent Skills 格式，覆盖 Vercel 项目优化、React/Next.js 最佳实践、Web 设计规范与写作规范等场景。
zh.content: 仓库以技能为单位组织，目前包含 vercel-optimize、react-best-practices、web-design-guidelines、writing-guidelines 等技能，每个技能由说明文档和配套脚本组成，并附有 skills.sh 徽章。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，围绕 Agent Skills 格式构建，技能内容以 Markdown 指令和脚本为主，主要面向 Vercel、React 与 Next.js 生态。
zh.hot: 作为 Vercel 官方出品，它把大厂工程经验直接封装成代理可用的技能，加上 3.2 万 star 和本月 1201 新增，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 JavaScript 第 16 名，热度很高。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理并希望扩展其能力的开发者
需要优化 Vercel 项目成本与性能的团队
编写 React/Next.js 代码并关注性能最佳实践的工程师
想用代理自动审查 UI、无障碍与文档写作规范的团队

en.tag: Vercel's official collection of agent skills for AI coding agents
en.what: This is Vercel's official collection of skills for AI coding agents, packaging instructions and scripts into reusable capabilities that extend what agents can do. The skills follow the Agent Skills format and cover areas like Vercel project optimization, React/Next.js best practices, web design guidelines, and writing guidelines.
en.content: The repo is organized by skill, currently including vercel-optimize, react-best-practices, web-design-guidelines, and writing-guidelines. Each skill consists of documentation and supporting scripts, with a skills.sh badge included.
en.stack: The primary language is JavaScript, built around the Agent Skills format. Skill content is mainly Markdown instructions and scripts, targeting the Vercel, React, and Next.js ecosystem.
en.hot: As an official Vercel release, it packages big-company engineering know-how directly into agent-ready skills. With 32k stars and 1,201 added this month, it ranks 16th on GitHub Trending's monthly JavaScript list, showing strong momentum.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents who want to extend their capabilities
Teams needing to optimize Vercel project cost and performance
Engineers writing React/Next.js code with a focus on performance best practices
Teams wanting agents to auto-review UI, accessibility, and documentation writing standards

zh.tag: 小说家打造的无干扰写作软件，专注写书本身
zh.what: NEO 是一款专为写小说设计的本地写作软件，从安装起就假定你只写书，界面像书稿而非文档列表。它完全离线运行，稿件以纯文本文件保存在本地，无需账号、订阅，且免费。
zh.content: 仓库包含 macOS（.dmg/arm64）、Windows（安装版与便携版 .exe）和 Linux（.AppImage）的安装包与发布文件，以及应用源码。核心功能有书架式书库、自动章节编号、Darlings 暂存区、占位符待办和进度条。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，基于 Electron 构建跨平台桌面应用，本地文件存储，无后端服务或云依赖。
zh.hot: 本周新增 222 星、总计 1340 星，登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 周榜第 7 名；由小说家亲自打造、免费无订阅的定位，加上对写作者痛点的精准回应，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 小说与长篇虚构写作者，需要沉浸式无干扰环境
厌倦订阅制与云同步、重视本地纯文本存稿的作者
想用书架式管理多部作品、系列与笔名的写手
对 Electron 桌面应用或写作工具设计感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A distraction-free word processor for novelists, built by a novelist
en.what: NEO is a local writing app built specifically for novelists, assuming from install that you only write books, with manuscripts that look like books. It runs fully offline, saves drafts as plain files on your disk, and needs no accounts, subscriptions, or fees.
en.content: The repo holds installers and release files for macOS (.dmg/arm64), Windows (setup and portable .exe), and Linux (.AppImage), plus the app source. Core features include a bookshelf-style library, auto-numbered chapters, a Darlings holding area, placeholder to-dos, and progress bars.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript and built as a cross-platform desktop app with Electron, using local file storage with no backend or cloud dependency.
en.hot: It gained 222 stars this week for a total of 1,340, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's weekly JavaScript chart. Being built by a novelist, free with no subscription, and sharply tuned to writers' pain points has drawn wide attention.
uses: Novelists and long-form fiction writers who need a distraction-free environment
Authors tired of subscriptions and cloud sync who value local plain-text drafts
Writers managing multiple books, series, or pen names with a bookshelf view
Developers curious about Electron desktop apps or writing-tool design

zh.tag: 模块化物流与供应链操作系统
zh.what: Fleetbase 是一个模块化的物流与供应链操作系统，覆盖运输管理、调度派单、路径优化与实时追踪等环节。它面向电商、餐饮、快递、现场服务等需要自建物流能力的组织，提供可扩展的开源平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心后端服务、控制台界面与模块化扩展体系，配套完整的 API 文档、云版本入口和 Discord 社区，整体以可插拔模块组织物流功能。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主，采用模块化架构，提供 REST API 与可扩展的插件机制，依赖现代 Node.js 生态与前端控制台框架。
zh.hot: 今日新增 530 star，登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 6 名，说明开发者对可自托管的开源物流系统需求旺盛。
uses: 电商与零售团队：管理配送、追踪订单并优化最后一公里物流
餐饮与快递企业：调度司机、规划路线并提供客户实时追踪
现场服务与运维团队：安排技师、管理服务区域并跟踪工单完成
开发者与企业：基于模块化架构和完整 API 构建定制供应链方案

en.tag: Modular logistics and supply chain operating system
en.what: Fleetbase is a modular logistics and supply chain operating system covering transportation management, dispatching, route optimization, and real-time tracking. It targets e-commerce, food and beverage, courier, and field service organizations that need to build their own logistics capabilities on an extensible open-source platform.
en.content: The repo contains the core backend services, a console UI, and a modular extension system, along with full API docs, a cloud version entry point, and a Discord community, organizing logistics features as pluggable modules.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript with a modular architecture, exposing REST APIs and an extensible plugin mechanism, built on the modern Node.js ecosystem and a frontend console framework.
en.hot: It gained 530 stars today and ranked 6th on the GitHub Trending JavaScript daily list, showing strong developer demand for self-hostable open-source logistics systems.
uses: E-commerce and retail teams: manage deliveries, track orders, and optimize last-mile logistics
Food, beverage, and courier businesses: dispatch drivers, plan routes, and offer real-time customer tracking
Field service and operations teams: schedule technicians, manage service areas, and track job completion
Developers and enterprises: build custom supply chain solutions with a modular architecture and full API access

zh.tag: AI时代终身学习指南，助普通人持续成长
zh.what: 这是一份持续更新的开源书稿，旨在帮助普通人在AI时代通过英语学习、AI应用、项目实践和人生复盘实现终身成长。它强调发现问题、主动学习、与AI协作、完成真实任务并保存证据的循环。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 1.91+，依赖 SlateDB 做持久化、SuiteSparse GraphBLAS 做稀疏遍历，支持 S3 兼容对象存储、Neo4j Bolt 5.x 驱动与 HTTPS JSON/NDJSON API，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。

en.tag: A Rust distributed graph database built on object storage
en.what: HydraDB is an object-store-native distributed graph database written in Rust, keeping durable graph data on S3-compatible object storage with fully disaggregated storage and compute. It offers snapshot-consistent OpenCypher queries, GraphBLAS traversal, Neo4j-compatible Bolt connectivity, and an HTTPS query API.
en.content: The repo contains two compute roles (graph-node and graph-indexer), a SlateDB storage layer, an OpenCypher query engine, GraphBLAS traversal, Bolt/HTTP interfaces, plus container images, OpenCypher TCK tests, and live benchmark setup.
en.stack: Built in Rust 1.91+, it relies on SlateDB for durability and SuiteSparse GraphBLAS for sparse traversal, supports S3-compatible object storage, Neo4j Bolt 5.x drivers, and HTTPS JSON/NDJSON APIs, under AGPL-3.0.
en.hot: Its novel "graph database on object storage" architecture addresses cloud-native graph computing pain points, and with 1,344 stars added today it tops the GitHub Trending Rust daily chart, reaching 5,906 total stars.
uses: Architects and backend engineers needing a cloud-native, low-cost graph database
Teams using the Neo4j ecosystem looking to move to an object-storage approach
Developers researching disaggregated storage/compute and distributed graph queries
Applications building large knowledge graphs or relationship networks on S3

zh.tag: 开源间隔重复记忆卡片软件，用算法帮你高效背东西

Engineers using MCP clients to run tests, debug failures, and perform Git operations

zh.tag: 用 Web 前端构建更小、更快、更安全的桌面与移动应用

en.hot: With roughly 6,984 stars, +44 today, and a No. 18 spot on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list, it rides strong demand in the hot area of parallel AI agent development.

Engineers developing several branches or features in parallel and switching contexts frequently
Teams wanting a CLI to simplify creating, switching, and cleaning up Git worktrees
Tool authors building agent orchestration or automation pipelines that need reliable workspace management

zh.tag: Cloudflare 出品的 Rust QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 实现
zh.what: quiche 是 Cloudflare 用 Rust 编写的 QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 实现，遵循 IETF 规范。它提供处理 QUIC 数据包和连接状态的底层 API，由应用层自行负责 I/O、事件循环与定时器。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 quiche 库、提供命令行客户端与服务端的 quiche-apps crate，以及示例证书和构建脚本。

uses: 网络协议开发者，需要实现或研究 QUIC/HTTP/3 底层逻辑
希望为服务端或客户端添加 HTTP/3 支持的 Rust 工程师

en.tag: Cloudflare's Rust implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3
en.what: quiche is Cloudflare's Rust implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3 as specified by the IETF. It offers a low-level API for processing QUIC packets and managing connection state, leaving I/O, event loops and timers to the application.
en.content: The repo contains the core quiche library, a quiche-apps crate with command-line client and server, plus sample certificates and build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust and published on crates.io, it relies on Rust crypto and networking crates and also ships C bindings.
en.hot: As the engine behind Cloudflare's edge HTTP/3 and adopted by Android's DNS resolver and curl, it holds 11,847 stars and ranks 8th on the Rust daily trending list.

Rust engineers adding HTTP/3 support to servers or clients

Researchers and educators focused on high-performance transport and congestion control
