zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方项目，它把 AI 代理安全地引入 Actions 生态，5389 星且本月新增 286，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 第 19 名，反映开发者对可控代理自动化的强烈需求。
uses: 希望用 AI 自动处理 issue 分类、PR 审查的仓库维护者
需要在 CI/CD 中安全引入代理推理能力的 DevOps 工程师
想用 Markdown 快速定义并复用 AI 工作流的开发者
关注代理安全与权限控制、研究 safe-outputs 模式的技术团队

en.tag: Define AI agent workflows in Markdown, compiled into secure GitHub Actions
en.what: gh-aw is GitHub's official CLI extension that lets developers define AI-powered repository automation in Markdown with YAML frontmatter, then compile it into standard GitHub Actions workflows. It targets reasoning-heavy tasks like issue triage, PR review, CI failure investigation, docs maintenance, and dependency analysis, complementing rather than replacing existing CI/CD.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based gh-aw CLI extension source, workflow compilation logic, built-in AI engine adapters, plus agent quick-start docs (create/install/package) and a full documentation site.
en.stack: Written in Go and distributed as a GitHub CLI extension; it runs on GitHub Actions and ships with built-in support for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, and Pi.
en.hot: As an official GitHub project, it brings AI agents safely into the Actions ecosystem; with 5,389 stars and 286 added this month, it ranks 19th on GitHub Trending's monthly Go list, reflecting strong demand for controllable agent automation.
uses: Maintainers who want AI to auto-triage issues and review pull requests
DevOps engineers adding safe agent reasoning into CI/CD pipelines
Developers defining and reusing AI workflows quickly in Markdown
Teams studying agent security and the safe-outputs permission model

zh.tag: 面向开发者的开源身份与访问管理基础设施
zh.what: ZITADEL 是一个开源的身份与访问管理（IAM）平台，为需要超越基础认证的团队而设计。它开箱即用地提供 SSO、MFA、Passkeys、OIDC、SAML、SCIM 以及经过实战检验的多租户模型，可用于保护 SaaS 产品、构建 B2B 平台或自托管生产级 IAM 栈。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的核心身份服务、面向用户的控制台与管理界面、文档站点以及部署配置，整体是一个 API 优先、可自托管的多组件平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，遵循 OIDC 等开放标准并已通过 OpenID Connect 认证，配套有 Dev Containers、语义化发布与 CI 工作流。
zh.hot: 凭借开源、无厂商锁定且功能完整的 IAM 能力，该项目已积累约 15,280 颗星，本月新增 309 颗，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 语言第 20 名。
uses: 需要为 SaaS 或 B2B 产品接入 SSO、MFA 与多租户的开发者
希望自托管生产级身份认证栈、避免厂商锁定的团队
需要 OIDC/SAML/SCIM 等标准协议支持的企业 IT 与平台工程师

en.tag: Open-source identity and access management infrastructure for developers
en.what: ZITADEL is an open-source identity and access management (IAM) platform built for teams that need more than basic auth. It ships out of the box with SSO, MFA, Passkeys, OIDC, SAML, SCIM and a battle-tested multi-tenancy model, suitable for securing SaaS products, building B2B platforms or self-hosting a production IAM stack.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core identity service, user-facing console and admin UIs, documentation site and deployment configs, forming an API-first, self-hostable multi-component platform.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it follows open standards like OIDC (OpenID Connect certified) and ships with Dev Containers, semantic-release and CI workflows.
en.hot: With open-source, vendor-lock-in-free and feature-complete IAM capabilities, it has gathered about 15,280 stars, adding 309 this month and ranking 20th on the GitHub Trending monthly list for Go.
uses: Developers adding SSO, MFA and multi-tenancy to SaaS or B2B products
Teams wanting to self-host a production-grade auth stack without vendor lock-in
Enterprise IT and platform engineers needing OIDC/SAML/SCIM standard protocol support

zh.tag: 谷歌开源的高效编程语言 Go 的官方主仓库
zh.what: Go 是一门开源编程语言，旨在让构建简单、可靠、高效的软件变得容易。它由谷歌主导开发，广泛用于云原生、后端服务与基础设施领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言的完整源代码、编译器、标准库、运行时以及官方文档与贡献指南，是 Go 项目的权威 Git 主仓库（另有 googlesource 官方源）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 自身编写（自举），辅以汇编与 C；采用 BSD 风格许可证，依赖极少，构建工具链自成体系。
zh.hot: 作为拥有 13.8 万+ star 的语言级项目，它长期稳居热门，今日再登 Go 日榜第 14 名，反映开发者对 Go 生态的持续关注。
uses: 后端与微服务开发者，用 Go 构建高并发服务
云原生与 DevOps 工程师，开发 Kubernetes、Docker 等基础设施
编程语言爱好者与研究者，学习语言设计与编译器实现
学生与初学者，通过官方源码与文档系统学习 Go

en.tag: The official repository of Go, Google's open-source programming language
en.what: Go is an open-source programming language designed to make it easy to build simple, reliable, and efficient software. Backed by Google, it is widely used in cloud-native, backend, and infrastructure development.
en.content: The repo holds the complete Go source code, compiler, standard library, runtime, plus official docs and contribution guidelines — the canonical Git mirror of the Go project.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go itself (self-hosted), with some assembly and C; BSD-style license, minimal external dependencies, and a self-contained toolchain.
en.hot: With over 138k stars, this language-level project stays perpetually popular, again ranking 14th on the Go daily trending list, reflecting sustained interest in the Go ecosystem.
uses: Backend and microservice developers building high-concurrency services in Go
Cloud-native and DevOps engineers working on Kubernetes, Docker, and infra tooling
Programming language enthusiasts and researchers studying language and compiler design
Students and beginners learning Go through official source and docs

zh.tag: 任天堂 Switch 自定义固件，支持自制系统与虚拟 NAND
zh.what: Atmosphère 是一个针对任天堂 Switch 的开源自定义固件项目，通过替换和修改系统各层组件，实现自制系统功能。它支持运行自制程序、使用虚拟 NAND（emuNAND）以及应用级系统补丁，是 Switch 破解社区的核心项目之一。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：Fusée（第一阶段加载器）、Exosphère（自定义 TrustZone）、Thermosphère（emuNAND 支持）、Stratosphère（自定义系统模块）和 Troposphère（应用层补丁），以及相关文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 libnx、devkitA64 工具链、FatFs 等库，并基于 hekate 的硬件初始化代码。
zh.hot: 作为 Switch 破解领域最知名的自定义固件，Atmosphère 拥有超过 2 万星标，本月新增 562 星，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第一，反映了社区对 Switch 自制系统的持续热情。
uses: 任天堂 Switch 用户希望运行自制程序或备份游戏
开发者研究 Switch 系统架构或开发自制软件
安全研究人员分析 Switch 系统安全机制

en.tag: A work-in-progress custom firmware for the Nintendo Switch, enabling CFW and emuNAND
en.what: Atmosphère is an open-source custom firmware for the Nintendo Switch that replaces and modifies various system components to enable CFW features. It supports running homebrew, using emulated NAND (emuNAND), and applying application-level patches, making it a cornerstone of the Switch hacking community.
en.content: The repository contains multiple components: Fusée (first-stage loader), Exosphère (custom TrustZone), Thermosphère (emuNAND support), Stratosphère (custom sysmodules), and Troposphère (application-level patches), along with documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on libnx, the devkitA64 toolchain, FatFs, and other libraries, building upon hekate's hardware initialization code.
en.hot: As the most well-known custom firmware in the Switch hacking scene, Atmosphère has over 20,000 stars, with 562 added this month, ranking first on GitHub Trending monthly for C++, reflecting sustained community enthusiasm for Switch CFW.
uses: Nintendo Switch users who want to run homebrew or backup games
Developers researching Switch system architecture or building homebrew
Security researchers analyzing Switch system security

zh.tag: 苹果平台 Firebase 官方开源 SDK，覆盖认证、数据库、推送与 AI 能力
zh.what: 这是 Firebase 面向 Apple 平台（iOS/macOS/tvOS/watchOS）的官方开源 SDK 源码仓库，除 FirebaseAnalytics 外几乎所有 Firebase 产品库都在这里。它为开发者提供认证、云数据库、推送、崩溃分析、性能监控等后端服务的客户端接入能力。
zh.content: 仓库按产品拆分为多个子模块，如 FirebaseAI、FirebaseAuth、FirebaseFirestore、FirebaseMessaging、FirebaseCrashlytics 等，并配有 Package.swift、Podspec 及示例与测试代码。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 与 Objective-C/Swift 混合实现，支持 Swift Package Manager 与 CocoaPods 两种集成方式，依赖 Apple 各平台原生框架。
zh.hot: 作为苹果生态最主流的后端服务 SDK，长期保持稳定关注度，累计 6767 星；此次登上日榜第 11 名，与 AI Logic 接入 Gemini 及 Foundation Models 的预览发布密切相关。
uses: iOS/macOS 开发者需要快速接入认证、数据库、推送等后端能力时
团队希望用一套 SDK 统一管理崩溃分析、性能监控与远程配置
想在 Apple 应用中集成 Gemini 等 AI 能力的开发者
从 CocoaPods 迁移到 Swift Package Manager 的项目维护者

en.tag: The official open-source Firebase SDK for Apple platforms, covering auth, databases, messaging and AI
en.what: This is the official open-source SDK repository for Firebase on Apple platforms (iOS/macOS/tvOS/watchOS), containing nearly all Firebase product libraries except FirebaseAnalytics. It gives developers client-side access to backend services such as authentication, cloud databases, push messaging, crash reporting and performance monitoring.
en.content: The repo is split into per-product modules such as FirebaseAI, FirebaseAuth, FirebaseFirestore, FirebaseMessaging and FirebaseCrashlytics, along with Package.swift, podspecs, samples and tests.
en.stack: Implemented in a mix of C++, Objective-C and Swift, it supports both Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods integration and relies on native Apple platform frameworks.
en.hot: As the dominant backend-service SDK in the Apple ecosystem it holds steady long-term attention with 6,767 stars; its No.11 daily trending spot ties to the preview of AI Logic with Gemini and Foundation Models support.
uses: iOS/macOS developers who need to quickly add auth, database and push backends
Teams wanting one SDK for crash reporting, performance monitoring and remote config
Developers integrating Gemini and other AI capabilities into Apple apps
Maintainers migrating projects from CocoaPods to Swift Package Manager

zh.tag: 纯 C/C++ 实现的多模型扩散推理引擎
zh.what: stable-diffusion.cpp 用纯 C/C++ 实现扩散模型推理，覆盖 Stable Diffusion、Flux、Wan、Qwen Image、Z-Image 等图像与视频生成模型。它基于 ggml 构建，思路与 llama.cpp 一致，追求轻量、无外部依赖的本地部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C/C++ 推理核心、命令行工具、嵌入式 Web UI，以及按模型划分的 docs 文档（sd.md、flux.md、qwen_image.md 等）和 assets 资源。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 C/C++ 与 ggml 张量库，无外部依赖，可编译为独立可执行文件；支持 CPU 及多种后端加速。
zh.hot: 凭借 7246 星、日增 36 星登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 14 名，其持续 Day-0/Day-1 跟进 Qwen-Image、Flux、Wan 等新模型，让本地低配设备也能跑扩散模型，是热度主因。
uses: 想在本地或离线环境运行扩散模型、注重隐私与零依赖的开发者
需要在 C/C++ 项目中集成图像/视频生成能力的工程师
关注 ggml/llama.cpp 生态、希望复现轻量推理方案的研究者
在低配硬件或边缘设备上部署 AI 生成功能的爱好者

en.tag: Pure C/C++ diffusion inference engine for many model families
en.what: stable-diffusion.cpp implements diffusion model inference in pure C/C++, covering Stable Diffusion, Flux, Wan, Qwen Image, Z-Image and more image/video generation models. Built on ggml and modeled after llama.cpp, it aims for lightweight, dependency-free local deployment.
en.content: The repo contains the C/C++ inference core, a CLI tool, an embedded web UI, plus per-model docs (sd.md, flux.md, qwen_image.md, etc.) and assets.
en.stack: Tech stack is C/C++ with the ggml tensor library, no external dependencies, compilable into a standalone binary; supports CPU and multiple acceleration backends.
en.hot: With 7,246 stars and +36 today, it ranks #14 on GitHub Trending; its continuous Day-0/Day-1 support for new models like Qwen-Image, Flux and Wan lets low-end local devices run diffusion models, driving its popularity.
uses: Developers who want to run diffusion models locally or offline with privacy and zero dependencies
Engineers integrating image/video generation into C/C++ projects
Researchers following the ggml/llama.cpp ecosystem and lightweight inference
Hobbyists deploying AI generation on low-end or edge hardware

zh.tag: 专为 RTX 5090 打造的单卡 C++/CUDA 推理引擎
zh.what: NInfer 是一个从零编写的 C++/CUDA 推理引擎，专门针对单张 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 上的特定 Qwen 检查点进行极致优化。它支持文本、图像和视频输入，可通过本地 CLI 或兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 HTTP API 调用。运行时高度特化：单 GPU、单常驻模型、启动时固定 1 到 8 个并发请求容量。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++/CUDA 源码、CMake 构建系统，以及五个预注册的模型工件（Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 groupwise-int 与 nvfp4 版本）。每个工件内嵌 tokenizer、聊天模板和媒体前端资源，需从 Hugging Face 单独下载。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 C++20、CUDA 13.1+（仅支持 sm_120a 架构）、CMake 3.28+、Ninja，并依赖 FFmpeg 开发库（libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale）和 libcurl。要求 64 位 Linux 系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1306 颗星，总星数达 1600，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 10 名。它精准切中了 RTX 5090 用户对本地高性能单卡推理的需求，且以极致特化换取性能，在 AI 推理社区引发关注。
uses: 拥有 RTX 5090 并希望在本地运行 Qwen 大模型的开发者
需要低延迟、高吞吐单卡推理服务的 AI 应用部署者
对 C++/CUDA 推理引擎实现感兴趣的系统级工程师
想通过 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 接入本地模型的研究人员

en.tag: A from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine tuned for single-GPU RTX 5090
en.what: NInfer is a from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine purpose-built for explicitly registered Qwen checkpoints on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090. It handles text, image, and video prompts via a local CLI or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs. The runtime is deliberately specialized: one GPU, one resident model, and a startup-fixed capacity of one to eight active requests.
en.content: The repo contains C++/CUDA source code, a CMake build system, and five pre-registered model artifacts (groupwise-int and nvfp4 variants of Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.8-27B, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Each artifact embeds its tokenizer, chat template, and media frontend resources, and must be downloaded separately from Hugging Face.
en.stack: Tech stack: C++20, CUDA 13.1+ (sm_120a only), CMake 3.28+, Ninja, plus FFmpeg dev libraries (libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale) and libcurl. Requires a 64-bit Linux system.
en.hot: It gained 1,306 stars this month (1,600 total), ranking #10 on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list. It hits a sweet spot for RTX 5090 owners seeking high-performance local single-GPU inference, and its extreme specialization for speed has caught the AI inference community's attention.
uses: Developers with an RTX 5090 who want to run Qwen models locally
AI application deployers needing low-latency, high-throughput single-GPU inference
Systems engineers interested in C++/CUDA inference engine implementation
Researchers wanting to access local models via OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务端，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将 PC 上的游戏和应用串流到其他设备，支持低延迟和高画质。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、文档和图标资源。提供多种安装方式，如 Docker、Flatpak、Windows 安装包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA 等编解码库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 4 万星标，本月新增 1103 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其受欢迎程度源于对 NVIDIA GameStream 的替代需求，以及开源社区对自托管串流方案的青睐。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到局域网内的其他设备，如笔记本、手机或电视。
远程办公或学习：远程访问高性能 PC 上的应用，实现移动办公。
开源爱好者：自建串流服务，摆脱对商业服务的依赖，保障隐私和自由度。

en.tag: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It enables users to stream games and applications from their PC to other devices with low latency and high quality.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation, and icon assets. Multiple installation methods are available, including Docker, Flatpak, Windows installers, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on FFmpeg, CUDA, and other codec libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.hot: With over 40,000 stars and 1,103 new stars this month, ranking 22nd on the C++ monthly trending list, its popularity stems from the need for a replacement for NVIDIA GameStream and the community's preference for self-hosted streaming solutions.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to other devices on the local network, such as laptops, phones, or TVs.
Remote work or study: remotely access applications on a high-performance PC for mobile productivity.
Open-source enthusiasts: self-host streaming services to avoid commercial dependencies, ensuring privacy and freedom.

zh.tag: 跨电脑共享键鼠的软件 KVM，支持剪贴板与 TLS 加密
zh.what: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键盘鼠标共享工具，让你用一套键鼠控制多台电脑，像软件 KVM 一样无缝切换。它默认启用 TLS 加密，支持 Wayland 和剪贴板共享。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源码、构建脚本、各平台打包配置（Windows/macOS/Linux/Flathub）以及文档和社区讨论入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Qt 等跨平台库，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Wayland，并提供 Homebrew 和 Flathub 安装方式。
zh.hot: 凭借近 3 万 star 和本月 889 新增，Deskflow 在 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 分类中排名第 17，反映出远程办公和多设备协同的强劲需求。
uses: 多台电脑办公的用户 —— 用一套键鼠无缝控制所有设备，提升效率。
远程办公与居家办公者 —— 在个人电脑和工作电脑间快速切换，无需额外硬件。
开发者与运维人员 —— 管理多台服务器或测试机时，共享剪贴板和键鼠。
注重隐私与安全的用户 —— 默认 TLS 加密，开源可审计。

en.tag: Software KVM to share one keyboard and mouse across computers, with clipboard sharing and TLS encryption
en.what: Deskflow is a free and open source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you control multiple computers with one set of peripherals, like a software KVM. It enables TLS encryption by default and supports Wayland and clipboard sharing.
en.content: The repo contains full C++ source code, build scripts, packaging configs for Windows/macOS/Linux/Flathub, plus documentation and community discussion links.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ with cross-platform libraries like Qt, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux and Wayland, with installation via Homebrew and Flathub.
en.hot: With nearly 30k stars and 889 added this month, Deskflow ranks 17th on GitHub Trending monthly for C++, reflecting strong demand for remote work and multi-device setups.
uses: Users with multiple computers — control all devices with one keyboard and mouse seamlessly.
Remote and home office workers — switch between personal and work computers without extra hardware.
Developers and IT pros — manage multiple servers or test machines with shared clipboard and input.
Privacy-conscious users — TLS encryption by default and open-source auditability.

zh.tag: 通用列式内存格式与多语言工具箱，加速数据交换与分析
zh.what: Apache Arrow 定义了一种高效的列式内存格式，并提供了多语言库，用于在系统间快速交换数据并加速内存分析。它包含 IPC 格式、Flight RPC 协议、ADBC 数据库连接等组件，旨在消除数据序列化开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心库、GLib 绑定、Gandiva 表达式编译器，以及 Python、Java、Go、JavaScript、Julia、.NET 等语言的实现和 Arrow IPC/Flight 格式定义。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 LLVM（用于 Gandiva）、CMake 构建系统，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为大数据和 AI 领域的基础设施，Arrow 被众多项目采用，本月新增 163 stars，位列 C++ 月榜第 7，持续受到关注。
uses: 数据工程师和分析师 —— 用于构建高效的数据管道和内存分析应用。
数据库和查询引擎开发者 —— 集成 Arrow 格式以加速数据交换和查询处理。
AI/ML 工程师 —— 利用 Arrow 在训练和推理中高效处理列式数据。
跨语言系统开发者 —— 使用 Arrow 的多语言库实现异构环境下的数据互操作。

en.tag: Universal columnar format and multi-language toolbox for fast data interchange and in-memory analytics
en.what: Apache Arrow defines an efficient columnar in-memory format and provides multi-language libraries for fast data interchange and in-memory analytics. It includes the IPC format, Flight RPC protocol, ADBC database connectivity, and more, aiming to eliminate data serialization overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the C++ core library, GLib bindings, Gandiva expression compiler, and implementations for Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, Julia, .NET, along with Arrow IPC/Flight format definitions.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on LLVM (for Gandiva) and CMake build system, with multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As foundational infrastructure in big data and AI, Arrow is adopted by many projects; it gained 163 stars this month, ranking 7th in the C++ monthly trending list, maintaining steady attention.
uses: Data engineers and analysts — for building efficient data pipelines and in-memory analytics applications.
Database and query engine developers — integrate Arrow format to accelerate data exchange and query processing.
AI/ML engineers — leverage Arrow for efficient columnar data processing in training and inference.
Cross-language system developers — use Arrow's multi-language libraries for data interoperability in heterogeneous environments.

zh.tag: 谷歌开源的端到端机器学习框架，人人可用
zh.what: TensorFlow 是谷歌 Brain 团队打造的端到端开源机器学习平台，覆盖从研究到生产的全流程。它提供稳定的 Python 与 C++ API，以及工具、库和社区资源组成的完整生态，帮助研究者推进 SOTA、开发者快速构建并部署 ML 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架源码（C++/Python）、Keras 高层 API、各语言绑定、编译构建脚本与大量测试，并配有官方文档、安装指南与贡献规范。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 与 Python 为主，依赖 Bazel 构建系统，支持 CUDA/GPU 加速、Docker 部署，并提供 pip 包与多语言 API 绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最主流的框架之一，它已累积约 20 万 star，今日再增 46 星并登上 GitHub 日榜第 5，长期热度与生态惯性使其持续被关注。
uses: 机器学习初学者与研究者，用于学习与实验神经网络模型
需要将模型部署到生产环境的工程师与数据科学家
在移动端、浏览器或云端构建 AI 应用的开发者
希望基于成熟生态做二次开发的企业与团队

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open source machine learning framework for everyone
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source machine learning platform originally built by Google Brain, covering the full path from research to production. It offers stable Python and C++ APIs plus a broad ecosystem of tools, libraries and community resources so researchers can push the state of the art and developers can build and deploy ML-powered applications.
en.content: The repo holds the core framework source (C++/Python), the Keras high-level API, language bindings, build scripts and extensive tests, along with official docs, install guides and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily C++ and Python, built with Bazel, with CUDA/GPU acceleration, Docker deployment, pip packages and multi-language API bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most mainstream deep learning frameworks, it has accumulated about 200k stars, adding 46 more today to rank 5th on GitHub Trending, sustained by long-term momentum and ecosystem gravity.
uses: ML beginners and researchers learning and experimenting with neural networks
Engineers and data scientists deploying models to production
Developers building AI apps for mobile, browser or cloud
Enterprises and teams extending a mature ecosystem

zh.tag: GTA:SA 1.0 US 的完整逆向重写与文档化工程
zh.what: 该项目对《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》1.0 US 版进行完整逆向工程，逐函数重写并记录游戏逻辑。编译产物是一个 DLL，可通过 ASI 加载器注入游戏，用逆向代码替换原版函数，最终目标是拼出可独立运行的可执行文件。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 C++ 源码与逆向后的类实现，配有 docs/ReversedClasses.md 追踪各类的逆向进度，以及 CMake/Conan 构建脚本和 GitHub Actions 构建流水线。
zh.stack: 使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Visual Studio 2026、CMake（>=4.2.0）、Conan 2.x 与 Python 3.x 进行依赖管理和构建，目标平台为 Windows x86。
zh.hot: 本周新增 54 star、总数达 999，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 14 名；经典游戏的逆向工程兼具技术挑战与情怀，且项目已宣称完成约 50-60% 的代码，进展可见。
uses: 对游戏逆向工程与底层 C++ 感兴趣的开发者，可阅读并贡献逆向代码
GTA:SA 模组作者，希望基于重写后的函数开发更稳定的 MOD
想学习大型 C++ 项目构建（CMake + Conan）与二进制逆向流程的技术爱好者

en.tag: A full reverse-engineering and rewrite of GTA: San Andreas 1.0 US
en.what: This project reverse-engineers Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas 1.0 US completely, rewriting and documenting every function. It builds a DLL that can be injected via any ASI loader, replacing in-game functions with reversed code, with the end goal of compiling a standalone executable.
en.content: The repo contains C++ source and reversed class implementations, a docs/ReversedClasses.md progress tracker, plus CMake/Conan build scripts and a GitHub Actions build pipeline.
en.stack: Written in C++, it relies on Visual Studio 2026, CMake (>=4.2.0), Conan 2.x and Python 3.x for dependency management and building, targeting Windows x86.
en.hot: It gained 54 stars this week for a total of 999, ranking 14th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list; reverse-engineering a beloved classic blends technical challenge with nostalgia, and the project claims roughly 50-60% completion.
uses: Developers interested in game reverse engineering and low-level C++, who can read and contribute reversed code
GTA:SA modders who want to build more stable mods on top of rewritten functions
Tech enthusiasts learning large-scale C++ builds (CMake + Conan) and binary reverse-engineering workflows

zh.tag: 跨平台开源密码管理器，离线加密存储你的所有敏感信息
zh.what: KeePassXC 是 Windows 版 KeePass Password Safe 的社区驱动跨平台移植版，用于安全地存储和管理用户名、密码、URL、附件与笔记等敏感信息。所有数据保存在本地加密的 KDBX 文件中，可放在任意位置，包括私有或公有云盘。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面应用源码，覆盖 KDBX3/KDBX4 数据库读写、密码生成器、TOTP、搜索、分组管理、浏览器集成与自动填充等模块，并配有 CMake 构建脚本、测试与多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 Qt 框架开发，依赖 libgcrypt、Argon2、zlib 等加密与压缩库，通过 CMake 构建，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源密码管理器，它已积累 29123 颗星，本月再增 476 星，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 18 名，反映出用户对本地优先、可审计安全工具持续增长的需求。
uses: 注重隐私、希望密码完全离线自管的个人用户
需要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 多设备间同步加密数据库的用户
想审计或二次开发密码管理器的安全研究者与开发者
为团队或家庭统一管理凭据、TOTP 与附件的管理员

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source password manager with offline encrypted storage
en.what: KeePassXC is a community-driven, cross-platform port of the Windows KeePass Password Safe, built to store and manage sensitive data such as usernames, passwords, URLs, attachments, and notes. Everything lives in a local encrypted KDBX file that can be kept anywhere, including private or public cloud storage.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ desktop application source, covering KDBX3/KDBX4 database read/write, password generator, TOTP, search, group management, browser integration, and auto-type, along with CMake build scripts, tests, and translation files.
en.stack: Built mainly in C++ with the Qt framework, depending on libgcrypt, Argon2, zlib, and other crypto/compression libraries, built via CMake for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source password manager, it has accumulated 29,123 stars with 476 added this month, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list, reflecting growing demand for local-first, auditable security tools.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want fully offline, self-hosted password storage
Users who need to sync an encrypted database across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Security researchers and developers who want to audit or extend a password manager
Admins managing credentials, TOTP, and attachments for a team or family

zh.tag: 微软官方 WSL 仓库，在 Windows 上原生运行 Linux 命令行工具
zh.what: WSL（Windows Subsystem for Linux）让你无需传统虚拟机或双系统，就能直接在 Windows 上原封不动地运行 Linux 命令行工具、实用程序和应用程序。只需在 Windows 命令行执行 wsl --install 即可安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WSL 的源码、开发者文档（doc/docs/dev-loop.md）、贡献指南、行为准则、隐私与遥测说明，以及配套的 WSL2-Linux-Kernel、WSLg 和文档仓库链接。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主语言，深度集成 Windows 内核与虚拟化技术，并配套 Linux 内核（WSL2-Linux-Kernel）和 GUI 支持组件（WSLg）。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，WSL 拥有约 3.4 万 star，本周新增 162 并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 第 5 名，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 需要在 Windows 上使用 Linux 命令行工具的开发者和运维人员
想避免双系统或虚拟机开销、追求轻量 Linux 环境的用户
希望为 WSL 贡献代码、文档或设计提案的开源贡献者
需要运行 Linux GUI 应用或定制 Linux 内核的高级用户

en.tag: Microsoft's official WSL repo for running Linux tools natively on Windows
en.what: WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) lets you run Linux command-line tools, utilities and applications unmodified and directly on Windows, without the overhead of a traditional VM or dual boot. You can install it right away by running wsl --install in a Windows command line.
en.content: The repo contains WSL source code, developer docs (doc/docs/dev-loop.md), a contributor guide, code of conduct, privacy/telemetry notes, and links to companion repos WSL2-Linux-Kernel, WSLg and the docs repo.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, deeply integrated with the Windows kernel and virtualization, with companion components including a Linux kernel (WSL2-Linux-Kernel) and GUI support (WSLg).
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, WSL has about 34k stars, gained 162 this week and ranked 5th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list, keeping strong developer attention.
uses: Developers and ops engineers who need Linux CLI tools on Windows
Users wanting a lightweight Linux environment without dual boot or VM overhead
Open-source contributors adding code, docs or design proposals to WSL
Advanced users running Linux GUI apps or customizing the Linux kernel

zh.tag: 跨平台开源游戏串流客户端，支持 NVIDIA GameStream 与 Sunshine
zh.what: Moonlight PC 是一个开源的游戏串流客户端，可以把 PC 上的游戏画面低延迟串流到 Windows、Mac、Linux 以及 Steam Link 等设备上。它既支持 NVIDIA 官方的 GameStream，也支持开源的 Sunshine 串流服务端。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 C++/Qt 编写的桌面客户端源码，包含构建脚本、CI 工作流与多平台打包配置，另有 Weblate 翻译资源和发布用的安装包（Snap、Flatpak、AppImage、Deb 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 Qt 框架，依赖 FFmpeg 做硬件加速解码，支持 H.264/HEVC/AV1 编解码，并通过 GitHub Actions 构建多平台产物。
zh.hot: 作为老牌串流方案，Moonlight 在自建云游戏和远程游玩圈子里口碑稳定，近 1.9 万 star 且本周新增 152，说明随着 Sunshine 生态升温仍持续吸引新用户。
uses: 想在电视、笔记本或 Steam Link 上远程玩自己 PC 游戏的玩家
用 Sunshine 自建云游戏/远程串流服务、追求低延迟的折腾党
需要在 Linux、树莓派或 ARM 设备上做游戏串流的开发者与极客
想研究跨平台音视频串流与硬件解码实现的 C++/Qt 开发者

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform game streaming client for NVIDIA GameStream and Sunshine
en.what: Moonlight PC is an open-source game streaming client that lets you play PC games remotely on Windows, Mac, Linux, and Steam Link devices with low latency. It works with both NVIDIA GameStream and the open-source Sunshine host.
en.content: The repo holds the C++/Qt desktop client source, build scripts, CI workflows, and multi-platform packaging configs, plus Weblate translation resources and release artifacts (Snap, Flatpak, AppImage, Deb, etc.).
en.stack: Built mainly with C++ and the Qt framework, relying on FFmpeg for hardware-accelerated decoding, supporting H.264/HEVC/AV1, and using GitHub Actions for multi-platform builds.
en.hot: As a veteran streaming solution, Moonlight has a solid reputation in the self-hosted cloud gaming and remote play community; with nearly 19k stars and 152 added this week, it keeps attracting users as the Sunshine ecosystem grows.
uses: Gamers who want to play their PC games remotely on a TV, laptop, or Steam Link
Enthusiasts self-hosting cloud gaming/remote streaming with Sunshine and low latency
Developers and tinkerers streaming games on Linux, Raspberry Pi, or ARM devices
C++/Qt developers studying cross-platform audio/video streaming and hardware decoding

zh.tag: Windows 磁盘占用分析与清理工具，支持交互式矩形树图
zh.what: WinDirStat 是一款面向 Microsoft Windows 的磁盘占用分析与清理助手。它可以扫描驱动器、文件夹、网络共享或 MTP 设备，并通过可排序文件列表、文件类型统计和交互式矩形树图、旭日图、火焰图来展示磁盘使用情况。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源码、资源文件、构建脚本以及文档（README、CHANGELOG、Wiki 链接）。主要模块涵盖扫描引擎、可视化视图、重复文件检测、权限查看、文件系统监控和命令行导出功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Windows API（如 NTFS 扫描、MTP 设备访问），可能使用 MFC 或 Win32 进行界面开发，并支持 CSV/JSON 导出。
zh.hot: 该项目拥有 4243 颗星，本月新增 240 星，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（C++）第 17 名。作为一款经典且持续维护的 Windows 磁盘清理工具，其丰富的功能和活跃的更新吸引了大量用户关注。
uses: 适合需要清理磁盘空间、分析大文件或重复文件的 Windows 用户
适合系统管理员进行存储成本估算、权限检查和文件系统监控
适合开发者通过命令行导出扫描报告或集成到自动化脚本中
适合从 NTFS、exFAT、FAT 驱动器恢复已删除文件的用户

en.tag: Windows disk usage analyzer and cleanup tool with interactive treemaps
en.what: WinDirStat is a disk usage analyzer and cleanup assistant for Microsoft Windows. It scans drives, folders, network shares, or MTP devices and visualizes disk usage through sortable file lists, file-type statistics, and interactive treemaps, sunbursts, or flame graphs.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, resource files, build scripts, and documentation (README, CHANGELOG, Wiki links). Main modules cover the scanning engine, visualization views, duplicate detection, permission inspection, file-system monitoring, and command-line export.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on Windows APIs (e.g., NTFS scanning, MTP device access), likely using MFC or Win32 for the UI, with CSV/JSON export support.
en.hot: With 4,243 stars and 240 added this month, it ranks 17th on GitHub Trending monthly (C++) list. As a classic, actively maintained Windows disk cleanup tool, its rich features and ongoing updates attract significant attention.
uses: For Windows users needing to free up disk space or analyze large/duplicate files
For system administrators doing storage cost estimation, permission checks, and file-system monitoring
For developers exporting scan reports via command line or integrating into automation scripts
For users recovering deleted files from NTFS, exFAT, or FAT drives

zh.tag: 以源码为文档、保存数十年软硬件历史的模拟器框架
zh.what: MAME 是一个多用途模拟框架，目标是保存数十年的电子软硬件历史。它通过记录硬件及其运作方式来防止老旧的街机、电脑、主机和计算器软件被遗忘，软件可运行本身只是验证模拟准确性的手段。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++ 源码为主体，包含各机种的驱动、设备模拟、CPU 核心、文档与构建脚本，并配有 CI、Coverity 扫描和 UI 翻译流程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 SDL 2.0 等库，支持在 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 上通过 make 或官方工具链编译。
zh.hot: 作为拥有 10593 颗星的老牌项目，本月新增 141 星并登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 19 名，说明复古游戏保存与模拟话题持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 复古游戏爱好者，想在现代设备上运行经典街机与主机游戏
软件历史与数字保存研究者，需要了解硬件文档与模拟实现
模拟器开发者，可参考其驱动、设备与 CPU 核心的实现方式
C++ 学习者，可研究大型跨平台项目的架构与构建流程

en.tag: An emulation framework preserving decades of software and hardware history through source-as-documentation
en.what: MAME is a multi-purpose emulation framework dedicated to preserving decades of electronic software and hardware history. By documenting hardware and how it functions, it keeps vintage arcade games, computers, consoles and calculators from being lost; the fact that the software runs mainly validates the accuracy of that documentation.
en.content: The repository is primarily C++ source code containing per-system drivers, device emulation, CPU cores, documentation and build scripts, along with CI, Coverity scanning and UI translation workflows.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with dependencies such as SDL 2.0, buildable on Linux, macOS and Windows via make or the official toolchain.
en.hot: With 10,593 stars and 141 added this month, it ranks 19th on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list, showing sustained interest in retro gaming preservation and emulation.
uses: Retro gaming fans who want to run classic arcade and console titles on modern devices
Software historians and digital preservation researchers studying hardware documentation and emulation
Emulator developers looking at driver, device and CPU core implementations
C++ learners exploring the architecture and build process of a large cross-platform project

zh.tag: 免费开源跨平台的专业地理信息系统
zh.what: QGIS 是一套功能完整、免费开源的地理信息系统（GIS），支持在 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 上运行。它可用于空间数据的浏览、编辑、制图与地理空间分析，并提供服务端组件 QGIS Server。
zh.content: 仓库为 QGIS 主代码库，包含 C++ 核心源码、Python 插件与处理框架、测试工作流、Docker 镜像及构建脚本等。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，依赖 Qt、GDAL/OGR、GEOS、PROJ、GRASS、PostGIS 等地理空间库，并提供 Python 与 PyQGIS 扩展接口。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源 GIS 标杆，本月新增 196 star 登上 C++ 月榜第 19 名，累计 14553 star，反映地理信息与空间数据需求持续升温。
uses: 地理信息、测绘与遥感专业的学生和研究人员
城市规划、环境与资源管理领域的从业者
需要处理空间数据的开发者与数据科学家
希望自建地图服务或替换商业 GIS 的团队

en.tag: Free, open-source, cross-platform professional GIS
en.what: QGIS is a full-featured, free and open-source geographic information system (GIS) that runs on Linux, Windows, and macOS. It handles spatial data viewing, editing, cartography, and geospatial analysis, and also ships a server component, QGIS Server.
en.content: The repo is the main QGIS codebase, containing the C++ core source, Python plugin and processing framework, test workflows, Docker images, and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt, GDAL/OGR, GEOS, PROJ, GRASS, and PostGIS, plus Python and PyQGIS extension APIs.
en.hot: A long-standing open-source GIS flagship, it gained 196 stars this month to rank 19th on the C++ monthly trending list, with 14,553 total stars, reflecting steady demand for geospatial data tooling.
uses: Students and researchers in GIS, surveying, and remote sensing
Professionals in urban planning, environment, and resource management
Developers and data scientists working with spatial data
Teams wanting self-hosted map services or a commercial GIS alternative

zh.tag: 极速小型构建系统，专注速度与效率
zh.what: Ninja 是一个专注于速度的小型构建系统，旨在快速执行构建任务。它通过简洁的构建文件描述依赖关系，并高效地调度编译过程，常用于大型项目的增量构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ninja 的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本（Python 和 CMake）、文档（AsciiDoc 和 Doxygen）以及辅助文件（如 shell 补全和编辑器模式）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Python 和 CMake 进行构建，文档生成需要 AsciiDoc、xsltproc 和 Doxygen。
zh.hot: Ninja 因其极快的构建速度被广泛采用，是许多大型项目（如 Chromium、LLVM）的默认构建工具，GitHub 上已获得超过 13,000 颗星，本月新增 91 颗。
uses: C/C++ 开发者，需要快速增量构建大型项目
构建系统开发者，希望集成或扩展 Ninja
DevOps 工程师，优化 CI/CD 流水线构建速度
开源项目维护者，寻求高效可靠的构建工具

en.tag: A small build system with a focus on speed
en.what: Ninja is a small build system with a focus on speed. It executes build tasks quickly by using a simple build file to describe dependencies and efficiently scheduling compilation, often used for incremental builds in large projects.
en.content: The repository contains Ninja's C++ source code, build scripts (Python and CMake), documentation (AsciiDoc and Doxygen), and auxiliary files (such as shell completion and editor modes).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with build dependencies on Python and CMake; documentation generation requires AsciiDoc, xsltproc, and Doxygen.
en.hot: Ninja is widely adopted for its extremely fast build speed and is the default build tool for many large projects (e.g., Chromium, LLVM). It has over 13,000 stars on GitHub, with 91 added this month.
uses: C/C++ developers who need fast incremental builds for large projects
Build system developers looking to integrate or extend Ninja
DevOps engineers optimizing build speed in CI/CD pipelines
Open-source maintainers seeking an efficient and reliable build tool

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

en.tag: A set of UI Agent Skills for design engineers

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing

zh.tag: 让编程 Agent 先给答案、别绕弯子的输出规范技能
zh.what: 这是一个给编程助手（coding agent）用的输出风格技能，强制它先给行动、再给解释，用编号步骤代替长篇铺垫。它不改变模型能力，只改变回答的组织方式，让结果像给 ADHD 用户看的一样直接。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md 里的 10 条规则，外加 INSTALL.md 安装说明、AGENTS.md 给 agent 的指引，以及多语言 README 和 logo。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，本质是 Markdown 技能文件，通过 Claude 插件市场（claude plugin marketplace）安装，可 fork 后自行改规则。
zh.hot: 它精准戳中「AI 回答又长又绕」的痛点，用极简规则给出可感知的前后对比，今日新增 4650 star、总数 34632，直接冲上 GitHub 日榜第一。
uses: 每天被 AI 长回复淹没、只想快速拿到下一步操作的开发者
用 Claude 等 coding agent 写代码、希望输出更紧凑的团队
想自定义 agent 输出规范、愿意 fork 改 SKILL.md 的进阶用户

en.tag: A skill that stops your coding agent from burying the answer
en.what: It's an output-style skill for coding agents that forces action-first answers with numbered steps instead of long preambles. It doesn't change model capability, only how responses are organized, making them ADHD-friendly and to the point.
en.content: The core is a 10-rule SKILL.md under skills/i-have-adhd/, plus INSTALL.md, an AGENTS.md for agents, multilingual READMEs, and a logo.
en.stack: Python is the listed language, but it's essentially a Markdown skill file installed via the Claude plugin marketplace and forkable for custom rules.
en.hot: It nails the pain of bloated AI answers with a simple rule set and a clear before/after demo, gaining 4,650 stars today to 34,632 total and hitting #1 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers drowning in long AI replies who just want the next action
Teams using coding agents like Claude who want tighter, more actionable output
Advanced users who want to fork and customize the SKILL.md rules

en.tag: A multitasking macOS terminal built for AI coding agents
